jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: AI Infrastructure Engineer **Company:** Amaara Networks **Location:** Livermore, CA — Hybrid, with regular onsite work at our data center facility **Job Type:** Full\-Time **Experience Level:** 4–7 years **Travel:** Occasional travel, up to 10–15% **Reports To:** Manager, Data Center Operations About Amaara Networks Amaara Networks builds and operates the physical and systems infrastructure that supports modern AI workloads. Our teams deploy, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot high\-performance GPU clusters and the networking infrastructure that enables customers to train and run AI models. We are looking for an **AI Infrastructure Engineer** who enjoys working across hardware, Linux systems, high\-performance networking, and GPU infrastructure. This is a hands\-on engineering position with responsibility for complex Tier 2/Tier 3 escalations, deployments, troubleshooting, automation, and continuous improvement. Position Summary As an AI Infrastructure Engineer, you will support the full lifecycle of high\-performance GPU infrastructure—from physical installation and commissioning through Linux configuration, GPU validation, networking, troubleshooting, and production operations. You will be responsible for resolving complex infrastructure issues, identifying root causes, working directly with vendors and customers, and developing the documentation and automation that makes our infrastructure more reliable and scalable. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys both **working in the data center and solving problems from the terminal**. Key ResponsibilitiesInfrastructure Troubleshooting \& Escalation * Own Tier 2 and Tier 3 infrastructure escalations from investigation through resolution. * Perform root\-cause analysis on server and infrastructure failures using BMC/IPMI logs, kernel messages, MCE/EDAC records, thermal and power telemetry, and vendor diagnostics. * Identify recurring hardware and infrastructure issues and develop permanent corrective actions. * Participate in post\-incident reviews and translate findings into monitoring improvements, runbooks, and operational standards. * Work directly with hardware vendors on diagnostics, RMAs, firmware issues, and field\-service activities. * Communicate clearly with customers during incidents and scheduled maintenance windows. * Coordinate remote hands and field technicians during work performed at remote sites. * Participate in an infrastructure on\-call rotation. GPU Infrastructure * Deploy, administer, and troubleshoot high\-performance GPU compute systems. * Support NVIDIA H100/H200/B200/B300 SXM and PCIe platforms, AMD Instinct, or comparable accelerator platforms. * Use tools such as **nvidia\-smi, DCGM, and DCGM diagnostics** to troubleshoot GPU health and performance issues. * Analyze XID errors, ECC events, NVLink/NVSwitch health, thermal conditions, and power\-related throttling. * Install and maintain GPU drivers, CUDA toolkits, Fabric Manager, and container runtimes. * Manage software and driver compatibility across the GPU fleet. * Perform GPU stress testing, burn\-in, NCCL testing, bandwidth testing, and all\-reduce benchmarking. * Investigate performance issues including straggler nodes, reduced collective bandwidth, PCIe degradation, NUMA configuration, and topology problems. High\-Performance Networking * Configure and support **InfiniBand and RoCEv2** high\-performance AI networking environments. * Configure switches, manage firmware, and validate network topology. * Support InfiniBand subnet management, partitioning, routing, and topology validation. * Use tools such as **UFM, OFED, ibdiagnet, ibnetdiscover, and perfquery** to troubleshoot network issues. * Diagnose link flaps, symbol errors, degraded optics, cabling issues, and port\-level failures. * Configure and troubleshoot RoCE environments, including PFC, ECN, lossless queues, and congestion control. * Administer RDMA/OFED stacks, NIC/HCA firmware, bonding, VLANs, and management networks. * Support enterprise networking, including L2/L3 networking, VLANs, LACP, MLAG/VLT, firewalls, NAT, VPN, DHCP, and DNS. * Validate network performance following deployments and infrastructure changes. * Maintain accurate network topology, port maps, and infrastructure documentation. Linux Systems Administration * Administer Linux systems including **RHEL, Rocky Linux, and Ubuntu**. * Manage provisioning, patching, kernels, drivers, storage, filesystems, networking, users, and access. * Operate bare\-metal provisioning platforms such as **MAAS, Foreman, Ironic, or similar technologies**. * Troubleshoot PXE, commissioning, enrollment, deployment, and image\-related issues. * Configure cloud\-init, netplan, bonded networking, and storage layouts. * Tune Linux hosts for GPU and HPC workloads, including NUMA, CPU pinning, IRQ affinity, and I/O configuration. * Monitor hosts, GPUs, networking, and environmental conditions. * Develop monitoring, dashboards, and alerts to identify issues before they  erational runbooks. Qualifications * **4–7 years of experience** combining data center operations, infrastructure engineering, and Linux systems administration. * Strong production Linux administration experience with RHEL, Rocky Linux, or Ubuntu. * Experience managing Linux kernels, drivers, storage, networking, and shell\-level diagnostics. * Hands\-on experience operating a bare\-metal provisioning platform. * Experience with PXE, node commissioning, deployment, and provisioning troubleshooting. * Experience using **Redfish and IPMI** for hardware management, power control, boot configuration, and firmware operations. * Demonstrated Tier 2/Tier 3 escalation and incident\-resolution experience. * Strong server hardware troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis skills. * Experience with BMC/IPMI logs, system event logs, and Linux kernel diagnostics. * Experience with high\-performance networking, including **InfiniBand, RoCE, or high\-speed Ethernet**. * Working knowledge of production L2/L3 networking. * Experience supporting GPU or accelerated\-computing systems. * Understanding of data center fundamentals including power, cooling, airflow, cabling, and rack layouts. * Scripting experience with **Python or Bash**. * Familiarity with configuration management tools such as **Ansible**. * Strong technical writing and documentation skills. * Ability to communicate directly with customers during infrastructure incidents. * Ability to coordinate remote technicians and field\-service personnel. * Willingness to participate in an on\-call rotation and occasional after\-hours maintenance windows. Preferred Qualifications * Experience supporting large\-scale, multi\-rack GPU clusters. * Experience with NVIDIA SXM systems, NVLink/NVSwitch, or rail\-optimized network architectures. * Deep InfiniBand experience, including UFM, subnet management, ibdiagnet, adaptive routing, or SHARP. * Experience with Slurm, Kubernetes GPU Operators, Run:ai, or similar workload schedulers. * Experience with high\-performance storage such as Lustre, GPFS, WEKA, VAST, or NFS over RDMA. * Experience with liquid\-cooled or high\-density data center infrastructure. * Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, DCGM Exporter, Elasticsearch, or similar observability platforms. * RHCSA, RHCE, NVIDIA networking/InfiniBand certifications, CompTIA Server\+/Network\+, or Uptime Institute certifications. * Experience working in a growth\-stage environment where processes and standards are being developed. Working Conditions \& Physical Requirements This position includes regular work inside an operating data center. Candidates must be able to, with or without reasonable accommodation: * Lift and maneuver equipment weighing up to 50 lbs. unassisted and heavier equipment with team or lift assistance. * Work on ladders and in confined areas, including under raised floors and in overhead cable trays. * Stand, walk, kneel, and reach for extended periods. * Work in environments with sustained equipment noise, cold aisles, and limited natural light. * Wear required personal protective equipment (PPE). * Follow all electrical, data center, and site safety procedures. Compensation \& Benefits * **Compensation:** Negotiable, depending on experience * 401(k) * Healthcare reimbursement * Paid holidays * Flexible time off / flex\-time Why Join Amaara Networks? This is an opportunity to work directly with the infrastructure powering modern AI workloads. You'll have the opportunity to work across **GPU systems, Linux, high\-performance networking, automation, hardware, and data center operations** while helping build reliable infrastructure at scale. If you enjoy solving difficult infrastructure problems, working hands\-on with cutting\-edge technology, and turning recurring problems into permanent solutions, we'd like to hear from you. **Apply today to join Amaara Networks as an AI Infrastructure Engineer.** Pay: $1\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Paid time off Work Location: In person

jobs.title: AI Software Engineer | LLMs, RAG & Private AI - Interview Today - Start Tomorrow
jobs.description: **Job details** * **Company:** MemeHouse, LA * **Location:** Beverly Hills, CA In Person and Remote * **Employment type:** Full\-time, Part\-Time, W\-2 employee, or Contract * **Annual base salary:** $130,000–$180,00 * **Additional compensation:** $5,000 performance\-based signing incentive, earned through two initial\-delivery milestones targeted for the first 90 days **About us** At MemeHouse LA, we build AI software that helps businesses turn their information into useful decisions and reliable workflows. Our focus is practical: secure AI deployments, connected business systems, and applications that deliver measurable value. We are looking for an engineer who wants to build more than demonstrations. You will help create dependable AI capabilities, from model selection and data integration through deployment, evaluation, security, and ongoing improvement. **About the role** As an AI Software Engineer, you will design, build, and deploy AI\-powered applications using large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, and modern software engineering practices. You will work across the application and infrastructure stack, helping translate business requirements into systems that users can trust. This is a hands\-on role with ownership of meaningful technical deliverables. You will collaborate with product and business stakeholders, explain technical trade\-offs, and help establish repeatable practices as the team grows. **What you will do** * **Build AI applications:** Develop production\-oriented LLM features, retrieval systems, workflow automations, and APIs that address defined business needs. * **Deploy private models:** Evaluate and serve appropriately licensed open\-weight models on private, dedicated, or customer\-controlled infrastructure. * **Connect business data:** Integrate approved documents, databases, CRMs, business applications, and other structured or unstructured data sources. * **Engineer reliable retrieval:** Build ingestion, indexing, embedding, retrieval, and citation workflows with appropriate access controls. * **Evaluate quality:** Create repeatable tests for response quality, groundedness, latency, cost, and failure modes; use results to guide improvements. * **Operate dependable systems:** Implement deployment pipelines, observability, error handling, versioning, rollback procedures, and operational documentation. * **Protect sensitive information:** Apply least\-privilege access, secrets management, tenant separation where applicable, and safeguards against prompt injection and unintended data disclosure. * **Improve the engineering function:** Participate in code reviews, document architectural decisions, share findings, and help mentor additional engineers as the team expands. **What we are looking for** * **Software engineering ability:** Strong Python skills and demonstrated experience building maintainable software, APIs, automated tests, and data integrations. * **Applied AI experience:** Hands\-on work with LLM applications, embeddings, RAG, model evaluation, or fine\-tuning when appropriate. * **Relevant tooling:** Experience with tools such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, vLLM, LangChain, or LlamaIndex. We value sound engineering judgment over familiarity with every listed tool. * **Backend and deployment fundamentals:** Comfort with SQL, Git, Linux, Docker, API authentication, and CI/CD workflows. * **Data engineering knowledge:** Experience processing business data and designing reliable ingestion or transformation pipelines. * **Security awareness:** Ability to reason about data privacy, permissions, model limitations, and secure deployment. * **Ownership and communication:** Ability to scope work, communicate blockers early, document decisions, and deliver usable results. * **Demonstrated capability:** Relevant professional experience, substantial project work, or equivalent evidence of technical proficiency. A specific degree is not required. **Helpful additional experience** * **GPU and inference optimization:** CUDA, quantization, batching, GPU memory management, or inference benchmarking. * **Infrastructure:** Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, private networking, or on\-premises deployments. * **Business integrations:** CRM, ERP, finance, document\-management, or analytics platforms. * **Advanced evaluation:** Permission\-aware retrieval testing, adversarial testing, or production AI observability. * **Team contribution:** Open\-source work, technical writing, or mentoring other engineers. **Your first 90 days** * **First 30 days:** Understand the architecture, security requirements, and priority use case; establish the development environment and evaluation approach. * **Target by day 45:** Deliver a working AI prototype connected to an approved data source, with reproducible setup instructions and initial evaluation results. * **Target by day 90:** Deliver a production\-ready version of the agreed feature in an approved staging or production environment, supported by automated tests, monitoring, and a deployment and rollback runbook. **Compensation and $5,000 signing incentive** The annual base salary range is $130,000–$180,000\. The starting offer will reflect the responsibilities of the position, demonstrated skills, relevant experience, and internal pay equity; the $5,000 incentive is separate from base salary. We offer a **$5,000 gross performance\-based signing incentive**, structured as a new\-hire milestone bonus rather than an upfront payment: * **Milestone one: $2,500\.** Earned upon completion of the agreed prototype, data integration, and initial evaluation deliverables, targeted for day 45\. * **Milestone two: $2,500\.** Earned upon completion of the agreed production\-readiness, testing, monitoring, and documentation deliverables, targeted for day 90\. Written milestone requirements and objective acceptance criteria will be provided before employment begins. Each installment is earned when its criteria are satisfied and will be paid on the next regular payday, or earlier if required by applicable law, less required tax withholdings. The 45\- and 90\-day dates are delivery targets, not minimum\-service or automatic\-forfeiture dates. Once earned, an installment is not conditioned on continued employment through its payment date and does not have to be repaid if employment later ends. **Benefits** * **Health coverage:** Employer\-sponsored health insurance, subject to plan eligibility and terms. * **Retirement benefits:** 401(k) participation, subject to plan eligibility and terms. * **Time off:** Unlimited paid time off under the company’s written policy, plus applicable paid sick leave and other legally protected leave. **Why join us?** You will have direct ownership of useful AI capabilities and the opportunity to shape how they are built and operated. We value clear thinking, candid communication, responsible handling of customer information, and engineering that holds up beyond the demo. **Equal opportunity and accommodations** MemeHouse LA is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without discrimination based on any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law and provide reasonable accommodations during the application process and employment. **How to apply** Submit your resume and, if available, a GitHub profile, portfolio, or short description of a relevant AI project to us. Please do not submit confidential information belonging to a current or former employer or client.

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer

We're hiring an early AI/ML engineer who wants real ownership (not another big\-company role) and is ready to prove it. What you'll do \- Take ambiguous problems from idea to production across LLM features, agent workflows, retrieval, and memory \- Build async Python services, including streaming and real\-time interactions \- Design short\-term, long\-term, and episodic memory for persistent conversational state \- Build evaluation datasets, catch regressions, and improve quality, latency, and cost \- Document decisions and own your work from design through delivery What you'll bring \- Strong Python (asyncio, FastAPI) plus working knowledge of C\+\+, Rust, or Go \- Solid CS foundations: graphs, relational theory, algorithmic complexity \- Hands\-on experience shipping LLM features: RAG, tool use, agent frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, or custom) \- Practical deep learning: transformers and PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow \- Fine\-tuning / post\-training (SFT, LoRA/QLoRA, preference optimization), and the judgment to know when not to \- Production infrastructure: containers, Kubernetes, cloud, CI/CD, observability Nice to have: real\-time voice/speech, LLM serving (vLLM, TensorRT\-LLM, Triton), distributed training, open\-source work or shipped AI products. jobs.description: NOW HIRING: Preconstruction Manager \- Commercial Construction — Design/Build LOCATION: Raleigh, NC EXPERIENCE: 8\+ Years Commercial Construction MARKETS: Mission Critical, Financial, Health, Energy \& More **About McFarland Construction** McFarland Construction is a full\-service commercial construction firm specializing in general contracting, design/build, and construction management services. We deliver high\-quality projects across a wide range of markets, including Financial Services, Health Sciences, Energy, Mission Critical, and the Public Sector. Founded in 2010, McFarland has grown to become the largest African American\-owned general contractor in the Carolinas. Headquartered in Charlotte, NC, with regional offices in Raleigh, NC and Indianapolis, IN, we continue to expand our footprint and impact throughout the Southeast and Midwest. **We're proud to be ranked \#18 Largest General Contractor in Charlotte, \#4 Fastest\-Growing Private Company in the region, and among the Top General Contractors in U.S., Southeast, and Midwest** If you're looking for your next career move and want to be part of a dynamic, forward\-thinking, and fast\-growing company, McFarland Construction is the place for you. The ideal candidate will possess expertise in conceptual and cost estimation, bid analysis, and preconstruction management, particularly within a commercial and municipality construction environment. This role requires a collaborative, partnering approach to engage directly with owners, joint venture partners, trade partners, public municipalities and project stakeholders. The Preconstruction Manager will lead the preconstruction phase of a project from inception through turnover to Operations, ensuring accurate project cost forecasting, and procurement schedule development, and strategies to drive project success. **Key Responsibilities** **Cost Estimation \& Analysis:** * Review project plans, specifications, and contracts to develop comprehensive and periodic support provided to the design team between milestones to assist with key design element decisions. * Analyze historical data, market trends, and industry standards to ensure precise pricing estimates to support decision\-making. * Demonstrated ability to independently develop conceptual and detailed cost estimates consistent with Estimator III\-level complexity, deployed flexibly to support budget deadlines across multiple pursuits and to provide core business estimating coverage during gaps between CMAR cycles. **Bid Solicitation \& Evaluation:** * Solicit and evaluate bids from review and approval durations associated with CmaR pursuits. * Prepare bid package scope checklist and/or bid tabs in preparation of leading post bid interviews. **Collaborative Approach with Owners \& Joint Ventures:** * Act as a trusted partner with project owners, joint venture teams, architects, engineers, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment throughout the preconstruction phase. * shared understanding of project budgets and goals. * Foster strong relationships with project owners and joint venture partners to promote effective teamwork, shared success, and transparency. * Lead pre\-bid meetings, facilitate site visits, and conduct client presentations to provide expertise and build trust with project stakeholders. **Risk Management \& Cost Control:** * Identify and evaluate potential risks and value enhancement opportunities in project proposals, offering creative solutions to mitigate risks. * Work closely with project managers and senior leadership to monitor project scope, schedule, and budget during the preconstruction phase to ensure project goals are met. * Provide detailed justifications to support cost breakdowns and ensure favorable terms and conditions. **Database providing feedback to the scheduling lead and incorporating current market conditions and trade partner input gathered during budgeting efforts. * Assist with procurement planning to ensure materials, labor, and equipment are sourced efficiently and on time. **Trade Partner Relationships** * Develop new relationships with local trade partners and supply houses and maintain existing relationships. * Update and maintain trade partner bid list database for different regions serviced by the Raleigh office. * Schedule, conduct and assist with trade partner outreach sessions. **Project Procurement** * Attend interview meetings with project teams to secure new work. * Assist marketing with slides associated with Precon services and deliverables. * Assist Operation team in developing front end documents for CmaR pursuits. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field (preferred). * A minimum of eight (8\) years extensive experience in preconstruction management and estimating, specifically in commercial construction. * Proven experience working directly with owners, joint ventures, and project stakeholders jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer & Architect
jobs.description: **Job Overview** At **Qidds.com**, we are on a mission to transform how K\-12 students and parents navigate educational resources, extracurricular opportunities, and personalized advisory services. Backend:** Solid expertise in **Java** and the **Spring Boot** framework (RESTful services, microservices/monolith architecture, data processing pipelines). **b. Frontend:** Highly proficient with **Next.js**, React, and modern TypeScript environments. **c. Databases:** Strong relational database design, query optimization, and schema modeling (e.g., PostgreSQL). **d. DevOps/Cloud:** Solid hands\-on experience deploying, hosting, and maintaining applications on **AWS** (e.g., EC2, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS, CloudFront). * **AI \& Agentic Systems Knowledge:** Very solid knowledge and hands\-on experience in **AI Agent development** (LLM orchestrations, RAG architectures, tool calling, automated web/data extraction, conversational AI). * **Strategic Vision:** A clear understanding and visionary perspective on how AI is shaping industries—especially K\-12 education and guidance. * **Mission\-Driven Passion:** Super passionate about empowering K\-12 students and parents by building an innovative, impactful educational platform. **Why Join Qidds.com?** * **High Impact \& Ownership:** Serve as the core architect behind a high\-growth, mission\-driven EdTech platform. * **Purpose\-Driven Work:** Help shape the future for students and simplify educational navigation for parents. * **Cutting\-Edge Tech Stack:** Work at the intersection of full\-stack web platforms and multi\-agent AI technologies. Join us if you're ready to lead innovative projects that push technological boundaries! We value energetic professionals who thrive in collaborative environments and are eager to make a meaningful impact through cutting\-edge software solutions. Pay: From $40\.00 per hour Expected hours: 5\.0 – 10\.0 per week Application Question(s): * Do you have a CS/AI/Software Engineering Degree from a very selective US college? Education: * Bachelor's (Required) Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **About Sonari** Sonari is a well\-funded startup and the world's first company to deploy AI\-powered ultrasound in professional sports, converting a fast, portable scan into objective data on an athlete's tissue health, performance and endurance over time. We're working toward an unprecedented goal: predicting soft\-tissue and non\-contact injuries. Our technology is grounded in peer\-reviewed research. We're backed by a global investment firm ($70B\+ AUM), and we're already in partnership with a Major League Baseball team and a Premier League club. Our aim is to put this capability in the hands of every sports organization in the world, from championship rosters to the academies where the next generation is coming up. We're mission\-driven and looking for like\-minded top engineers who want to build at the intersection of AI, medical imaging and sports. **The role** You own the **platform end to end** — the backend API and data model *and* the web frontend that clinicians and team staff use. The platform is the hub: it authenticates devices and users, ingests the ultrasound the tablet app uploads, stores it in a multi\-tenant, de\-identified data store, dispatches analysis jobs, and gives clinicians and team staff a web application to review images, add annotations, and track athlete metrics over time. If the app is the point of capture and the models are the intelligence, the platform is where it all lands and becomes useful. Much of the stack is still being decided, so you'll help choose it. You'll work in a fast\-paced, hands\-on environment, reporting directly to the CTO. *Stack note*: we've settled on Django / Django REST Framework for the backend. Most other choices — cloud provider, database, frontend framework, auth provider, image viewer — are not locked in. The role is described tech\-agnostically on purpose; strong opinions and the willingness to help make these calls are a plus.What you'll work onBackend * **Greenfield backend in Django \+ DRF** (our chosen framework), backed by a **relational database** and **cloud object storage**. A batteries\-included stack for a multi\-tenant athlete\-data app: ORM, migrations, admin, auth. * **Multi\-tenancy with strict isolation.** Tenant (org/team) is part of every key. Enforce isolation defense\-in\-depth: **row\-level isolation** *and* service\-layer ownership checks. Strict cross\-team isolation is a top requirement. * **Ingest.** Implement the device upload contract — an upload\-intent step that mints presigned upload URLs and a complete step that verifies the objects landed — including clip and sampling\-stream routing. * **Auth.** Validate tokens from a **managed auth provider** (whichever we adopt — the provider may change over time) in the backend, for both web users (team / clinician / admin roles, invite\-only, MFA for sensitive data) and the device upload path. * **The annotation \& analysis layer.** Persist the platform's canonical **annotation / measurement / report** records; expose the read API for the frontend; dispatch **analysis jobs** to the ML services and ingest their results (metrics \+ annotation overlays); fire **"new images/results"** alerts to staff (event\-driven). * **Privacy\-ready seams from day one.** A separate identifier store keyed server\-side, a single audit chokepoint, org\-keying everywhere, encryption/TLS throughout — built now so turning on stricter privacy controls later is configuration and paperwork, not a rewrite. Export de\-identified images \+ labels to the model factory. **Frontend** * **Build the web frontend from the ground up.** The framework and layout are still open — it may be a single\-page app or a multi\-page app — so you'll help decide the front\-end architecture and information design, not just implement a fixed spec: roster and player management, player profiles, **longitudinal analytics and trend charts**, and a **Team Command Center** dashboard. * **Front\-end UX/UI.** The layout and look\-and\-feel are greenfield; you'll shape them (with design input) so clinicians and team staff can move quickly through review and reporting. * **Embed a web\-based medical image viewer** (e.g. OHIF / Cornerstone3D, or another) for reviewing ultrasound and adding annotations and measurements, with **DICOM interop** (DICOMweb, PNG↔DICOM conversion). * Org\-admin and super\-admin provisioning/settings UIs. **Required skills** * Strong **Python** and **Django \+ Django REST Framework** (models, migrations, DRF serializers/views, auth). * **Relational database** depth (e.g. PostgreSQL): schema design, query performance, and ideally row\-level isolation and JSONB/array usage for a multi\-tenant app. * A **modern web frontend framework** (React, Vue, Svelte, or similar) with **TypeScript** — building real data\-dense UIs (tables, forms, dashboards, charts), plus the judgment to shape UX where the design is greenfield. * **Cloud infrastructure** on a major provider: object storage, a managed database, a managed auth provider, secrets management; comfort owning your own infrastructure early. * **Contract\-driven development**: building against **OpenAPI / JSON\-Schema** definitions and generated types, with additive\-only, versioned API discipline. * A **security mindset**: multi\-tenant isolation, least privilege, auth token handling, and keeping identifying data out of logs and objects. * **AI\-assisted development** as a daily habit: you use tools like Claude Code, Codex or Cursor to move faster, and you have the judgment to know when their output is right and when it isn't. **Nice to have** * **DICOM / PACS / medical imaging** on the web — e.g. OHIF, Cornerstone3D, DICOMweb, DICOM SR/SEG. * **Infrastructure\-as\-code** and CI/CD (this role initially stretches to cover DevOps; a dedicated DevOps hire is planned). * Experience handling **sensitive health data** and awareness of privacy/regulatory architecture (audit logging, field encryption) — depth is a plus; we retain regulatory specialists separately. * Event\-driven / queue\-based backends (job dispatch, alerting). * Data visualization for longitudinal / time\-series metrics, and general product/UX sensibility. **Tech stack you'll touch** Python · **Django \+ DRF** (chosen) · a relational database (e.g. PostgreSQL) · a major cloud provider (object storage, managed DB, managed auth, secrets) · a modern web frontend framework \+ TypeScript · OpenAPI / JSON\-Schema contracts · a web\-based medical image viewer (e.g. OHIF / Cornerstone3D) \+ DICOMweb · presigned\-upload API · event\-driven alerting. *(Backend framework aside, most of this is still open.)* How this role fits the team You'll be one of the first members of our engineering team, and the platform is the connective tissue between the other two roles. You consume the **iOS Engineer's** uploads and define the API they build against; you dispatch jobs to and display results from the **Machine Learning Engineer's** analysis services, and feed their model factory with labeled, de\-identified data. Every seam is a shared, versioned contract, so the parts of the system move independently without breaking each other. As our first Senior Site Reliability Engineer, you'll harden the systems behind order execution and market data delivery — designing for fault tolerance, closing gaps in our telemetry, and making sure our HashiCorp Nomad\-based service fabric scales cleanly as trading volume grows. You'll work embedded alongside our infrastructure and application engineering teams, contributing directly to our Ruby, Java, and Elixir services. This is a rare opportunity to shape a practice and a culture from day one, on a platform where every order, quote, and position has to be right, because real client capital is on the line. **What You'll Do (Job Responsibilities)** * Build self\-healing, fault\-tolerant infrastructure and internal tooling that automates repetitive operational work and reduces toil for Platform and Application teams. * Run gap analysis across our observability stack to find blind spots in telemetry, logging, and alerting coverage, then close them so failures surface before customers feel them. * Own scalability work across our HashiCorp Nomad service fabric: capacity planning, load testing, and identifying architectural bottlenecks before they become incidents. * Extend our observability stack jobs.title: Senior iOS Engineer
jobs.description: **About Sonari** Sonari is a well\-funded startup and the world's first company to deploy AI\-powered ultrasound in professional sports, converting a fast, portable scan into objective data on an athlete's tissue health, performance and endurance over time. We're working toward an unprecedented goal: predicting soft\-tissue and non\-contact injuries. Our technology is grounded in peer\-reviewed research. We're backed by a global investment firm ($70B\+ AUM) and partnered with a Major League Baseball team and a Premier League club. Our aim is to put this capability in the hands of every sports organization worldwide, from championship rosters to academies where the next generation is emerging.We're mission\-driven and looking for like\-minded top engineers who want to build at the intersection of AI, medical imaging and sports. **The role** You own the **iPad app**: the capture experience and UX, the real\-time imaging pipeline from a handheld ultrasound probe, on\-device ML inference, and the secure, de\-identified upload path to the backend. The app is the point of capture and the edge of the whole system — everything downstream starts with the images it captures. You'll work in a fast\-paced, hands\-on environment, reporting directly to the CTO. **What you'll work on** * **A native iPad app** (Swift / SwiftUI, iOS 17\+) with a clean, testable separation between UI, imaging, and services. We lean on modern Swift Concurrency; the exact architecture is yours to shape. * **Capture UX \& UI.** Design and build the real\-time capture experience — navigation/guidance overlays, quality prompts, and capture confirmation — in close collaboration with design and the clinical team. Good UX is what lets a non\-expert user capture a good image, so this is core to the role, not an afterthought. * **Live ultrasound imaging** from a **handheld ultrasound probe** via its vendor imaging SDK \- typically BLE discovery → joining the probe's Wi\-Fi → streaming B\-mode imaging. The imaging boundary sits behind a protocol so the app develops and tests in the simulator against a **mock imaging source**, with the device\-only vendor framework isolated behind a single adapter. * **On\-device ML.** Run on\-device (e.g. CoreML) navigation and segmentation models to recognize views, score image quality, and drive the guidance overlays in real time. * **Two capture streams.** A user\-confirmed **diagnostic** stream and a consent\-gated background **sampling** stream for model improvement — each handled appropriately. * **Secure upload to the cloud.** Upload captured data to the cloud securely and reliably, ensuring it stays **de\-identified** — no athlete\-identifying information (name, DOB, operator, comments) ever leaves the device in image metadata, keys, filenames, logs, or crash reports; images carry only UUIDs and a numeric research ID. * **Secure device auth**, with tokens held in the Keychain. **Required skills** * Strong **Swift** and **SwiftUI**, with real experience shipping iPad/iOS apps — including a good sense for **UX/UI** on touch devices. * **Swift Concurrency**: async/await, actors, structured concurrency — you can reason about a real\-time streaming pipeline without data races. * A **testable, decoupled architecture**; comfort developing against mocks and abstractions rather than requiring hardware to make progress. * **On\-device ML** integration (e.g. CoreML): loading models, running them on image frames, and handling outputs for overlays. * Networking against **REST APIs** (secure uploads, token auth) and **Swift Package Manager** for dependency and shared\-contract consumption. * Testing with **XCTest**; a habit of keeping simulator builds green. * **AI\-assisted development** as a daily habit: you use tools like Claude Code, Codex or Cursor to move faster, and you have the judgment to know when their output is right and when it isn't. **Nice to have** * **Hardware / peripheral SDK** integration — **BLE / CoreBluetooth**, Wi\-Fi peripheral joining, or streaming\-media pipelines. * Prior work with **ultrasound, medical devices, or imaging** apps. * Strong visual/interaction **design** instincts, or experience partnering closely with designers. * **XcodeGen** or other project\-generation / reproducible\-project tooling. * Experience with de\-identified / regulated data handling on device (Keychain, excluding data from backups, no\-identifier logging). * Metal / Accelerate or performance tuning for real\-time image display. **Tech stack you'll touch** Swift · SwiftUI · Swift Concurrency · on\-device ML (CoreML) · a handheld\-ultrasound\-probe SDK (device\-only) · BLE \+ Wi\-Fi networking · **Swift Package Manager** · **XcodeGen** · XCTest · secure cloud uploads · a shared Swift\-package contract library generated from the platform's API/schema definitions. How this role fits the team You'll be one of the first members of our engineering team. The **Machine Learning Engineer** trains and packages the on\-device models you run; the **Full\-stack Engineer** operates the backend your uploads land in. The seams between you \- the imaging\-source protocol, the frame/metadata types, and the upload API \- are defined as shared, versioned contracts so the parts of the system can evolve independently. Pay: $150,000\.00 \- $180,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Cambridge, MA 02142

jobs.title: Software Engineer I
jobs.description: Software Engineer I : **APPLY at**: **https://virnous.com/careers/** Department: Engineering Reports to: Director of Engineering / Chief Technology Officer Employment type: Full\-time Level: Entry level (1 to 3 years of experience) Position Summary Virnous builds software for the people who work criminal cases: detectives, crime analysts, and prosecutors. Our main product, CANDOR, takes the raw data that shows up in a modern investigation, such as phone carrier records, cell site location information (CSLI), device extractions, and social media returns, and turns it into maps, timelines, and reports that an investigator can use and defend in court. We also build a public tip line, a training platform, and CANDOR Edge, a self\-contained version of CANDOR for agencies whose data can’t leave their building. As a Software Engineer I, you’ll be working on real features and bug fixes from your first few weeks. Most of our code is Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL, with a good amount of JavaScript on the front end. You’ll get code review, pairing, and plenty of room to ask questions. In return, we need you to be careful. The files our customers upload are evidence, and what our software shows them can end up in front of a jury. Getting it right matters more to us than getting it done fast. Key Duties \& Responsibilities Build and maintain features across CANDOR and our other Rails applications, from the database migration through the view, along with the tests that cover them. Write and improve the importers that read what investigators bring us: carrier call detail records, tower lists, spreadsheets, PDFs, and phone extraction reports. These files are often messy, and carriers change their formats without telling anyone**.\* Track down bugs reported by customers and our support team. Reproduce the problem, find the real cause, fix it, and add a test that would have caught it. Work on the front end with Hotwire (Turbo and Stimulus) and plain JavaScript, including maps, timelines, and charts that sometimes have to draw hundreds of thousands of records. Write and maintain automated tests, and help keep the CI pipeline passing. Help move code from development to test to production, and keep an eye on it after it goes live. Work with our support staff and investigators, many of whom come from law enforcement, to learn how the software is used on real cases. Use AI coding tools as part of your daily work, and review what they produce as closely as you would review a teammate’s pull request**.\* Update documentation and runbooks when you change how something works. What You’ll Work With * Ruby 3\.x and Rails 8, with Hotwire (Turbo and Stimulus), import maps, and Solid Queue for background jobs. PostgreSQL, S3\-compatible object storage, and Apache Arrow for large datasets. JavaScript with D3, deck.gl, Google Maps, and Sigma.js for maps, charts, and link\-analysis graphs. Minitest and Capybara for application tests, and Playwright with TypeScript for end\-to\-end tests. Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, and Ansible for builds and deployments. Self\-hosted language models (vLLM, Ollama, and LiteLLM) that run features like our Ask Sarge assistant. Required Qualifications * 1 to 3 years of professional experience building web applications. A strong internship or co\-op can count toward this. Working knowledge of a server\-side web framework. Rails is ideal, but if you know Django, Laravel, Express, or something similar, you can pick up Rails here. Comfortable writing SQL and working with a relational database, preferably PostgreSQL. Solid fundamentals in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Everyday comfort with Git: commits, pull requests, and resolving merge conflicts. The habit of writing tests as part of the work, not after it. A methodical approach to debugging: read the logs, form a theory, check it, and say so plainly when you don’t know yet. Clear writing. You’ll write tickets, commit messages, and explanations for people who aren’t engineers. Good judgment and discretion with sensitive information. Our customers trust us with active criminal case data. Ability to pass a criminal background check. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with Ruby on Rails, especially Rails 7 or 8 and Hotwire. Experience with Docker. Exposure to Kubernetes, Jenkins, or another CI/CD system is a plus. Experience parsing and cleaning messy real\-world data in CSV, Excel, XML, JSON, or PDF form. Familiarity with geospatial data (coordinates, bearings, distance math) or with charting and mapping libraries like D3 or deck.gl. Curiosity about how large language models and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) work in practice. We run our own models in\-house. Any exposure to digital forensics, cellular networks, or the criminal justice system. It isn’t required. We’ll teach you the domain. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. *This job description outlines the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Duties may be modified at any time based on business needs.* Pay: $60,742\.41 \- $106,872\.57 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Phoenix, AZ 85016

jobs.title: Lean AI, Industrial Engineer
jobs.description: **COMPANY DESCRIPTION** At AirLife, we are dedicated to improving the quality of every breath. *Excellence with Every Breath* is not just a tag line, but the way we work and take care of our customers. With a mindset to evolve, innovate, and grow, we are a premier manufacturer of the highest\-quality and market\-leading breathing consumables. This growth philosophy has positioned us to increase our global footprint and business reach, impacting even more people around the world. Our expanding family of the most trusted brands offers a product portfolio that spans the continuum of care from first responder to home care, with safety, patient comfort, and clinical performance in mind. Collective expertise allows us to provide quality products and experiences to our patients, customers, and our people. Our values of Customer first, Differentiate with our People, Bias for Action, Continuous Improvement and Accountability define who we are and how we work. Join us! **POSITION SUMMARY** The Industrial Engineer will provide engineering and project support to Distribution Centers by combining traditional industrial engineering methods with applied AI and advanced analytics. Drive labor optimization by improving productivity through engineered labor standards, AI\-driven forecasting and predictive models, KPI’s, automation technology, and continuous improvement initiatives supports day\-to\-day distribution center performance through data analytics, machine learning models, labor management analysis, and visual management tools. This role focuses on using statistical analysis, AI/ML techniques, and operational data to improve labor efficiency, productivity, predictive maintenance, and workflow visibility within the distribution center while supporting continuous improvement initiatives. **POSITION QUALIFICATIONS** **Knowledge, Skills, \& Abilities:** * Distribution center/logistics concepts – understanding of warehousing best practices. * Ability to drive decision making through data and relevant business metrics. * Ability to resolve problems in a timely manner with little or no supervision. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills. * Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work cross functionally. * Must be able to utilize problem solving techniques to identify root causes of failures and solutions to meet targets. * Strong business planning and analytical skills including market intelligence, metrics, financial and analysis. * Ability to manage project portfolio of varying priorities and impact value. * Strong computer skills including Power B.I, MS Office and MSD/MOST experience preferred; proficiency with Python, SQL, or similar tools for data analysis and predictive modeling a plus. * Experience applying machine learning or statistical modeling to operational problems (e.g., demand forecasting, labor forecasting, predictive maintenance) preferred. * Familiarity with simulation or discrete\-event modeling tools (e.g., Arena, FlexSim, AnyLogic) a plus. * Experience in developing engineered labor standards. * Continuous improvement experience and knowledge of CI methodologies preferred. * Experience within the distribution/warehouse/logistics industry preferred. * Proficient in RF Scanning and Warehouse Management Systems preferred. * Experience in semi and fully automated material handling systems a plus. **Level of Experience:** * 3\+ years of work experience in Industrial Engineering. * 1\+years of work experience with AI application in supply chain or similar **Level of Education:** * Bachelor's degree or higher in Industrial Engineering or equivalent degree such as Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Logistics is required. **Travel:** * Up to 10%. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Develop, validate, and maintain time\-studied standards for overall operation and for each function, leveraging AI\-assisted time\-and\-motion analysis and predictive labor models where applicable * Create a culture of performance management through leader standard work, productivity meetings and KPI * Provide training to operations teams on labor management and associated systems * Create a playbook of productivity improvements using CI/Lean principles and technology * Develop and deploy AI/ML\-based models (e.g., demand and labor forecasting, predictive maintenance) to support proactive, data\-driven decision\-making * Build and maintain automated, AI\-enabled dashboards and reporting tools to increase real\-time visibility into labor, throughput, and equipment KPIs * Write all SOP’s for operations and ensure employee training program in place * Evaluate and make recommendations on layouts, MHE and other equipment to optimize productivity, using simulation and AI\-driven scenario modeling to validate changes before implementation. **OTHER RESPONSIBILITIES** * Uphold and embody AirLife’s values in all aspects of work. * Demonstrate accuracy and thoroughness in daily work; look for ways to improve and promote quality \& safety. * Inspire the trust of others; treat people with respect and dignity and embrace the value of diversity. * Use time efficiently; perform job accurately, thoroughly, and conserve Company resources to improve profits. * Contribute to building and maintaining a positive team environment. * Assure all policies and guidelines are implemented and followed. **QUALITY POLICY** At AirLife, Quality is our promise. It is our commitment to customer satisfaction and our dedication to product excellence in an evolving global healthcare market. This promise is kept through a continuously improving and effective Quality Management System and compliance to Regulatory Requirements. **DEIA STATEMENT** At AirLife, we are committed to building a diverse workforce and an inclusive workplace that reflects the communities and customers we serve. We believe our philosophy on Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Advancement (DEIA) encourages excellence and equips us to serve an evolving global marketplace. **BENEFITS** AirLife offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k), paid time off, paid holidays, bereavement leave, Employee Assistance Program resources, and medical leave benefits, subject to applicable eligibility requirements. Certain positions may also be eligible for bonus, commission, or other incentive compensation. **Please note:** The responsibilities outlined above are not exhaustive and may evolve over time. The role holder may be required to undertake additional duties as reasonably expected to meet the needs of the company.

jobs.title: Engineering Lab Operator
jobs.description: Overview: **ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.** At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. Whether you’re designing next\-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career. jobs.title: Data Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description: Applied Optoelectronics, Inc. (AOI) is seeking a Manufacturing Data Engineer to join the Process Integration team at its Sugar Land facility. This position will develop and maintain the data infrastructure and analytical tools used to connect fab process, equipment, metrology, device\-test, yield, and reliability data. The engineer will use Python, SQL, JMP, and statistical methods to automate data processing, improve manufacturing traceability, and provide reliable analytical tools for engineering and production teams. The engineer will also help maintain and monitor AOI’s existing fab process dashboard and work closely with Process Integration, Yield Engineering, Fab, Equipment Engineering, Quality, Reliability, and IT teams. Job Duties * Develop Python scripts for data collection, cleaning, reduction, analysis, visualization, and automated reporting. * Build and maintain databases that integrate fab process, equipment, metrology, device\-test, yield, and reliability data. * Establish data traceability across product, lot, wafer, process step, tool, recipe, operator, and timestamp. * Develop automated JMP workflows, scripts, reports, and visualization tools for manufacturing\-data analysis. * Create and maintain dashboards, wafer maps, trend charts, and automated reports for engineering and production teams. * Maintain and monitor the existing fab process dashboard. * Troubleshoot dashboard, data\-connection, and data\-integrity issues in collaboration with Equipment Engineering and IT. * Develop automated alerts that help process and yield engineers identify process shifts, equipment abnormalities, and manufacturing excursions. * Provide reliable datasets and analytical workflows to support SPC, process capability, DOE, correlation, reliability, and root\-cause analyses. * Work with yield engineers and process owners to translate analytical requirements into scalable databases, scripts, dashboards, and reports. * Establish data\-validation rules and monitor the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of manufacturing data. * Document databases, scripts, dashboards, interfaces, and standard analysis methods. Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Physics, Mathematics, or a related technical field. * 3 or more years of experience in data engineering, manufacturing analytics, database development, scientific software, or equipment\-data automation. * Strong Python programming skills, particularly for data processing, automation, analysis, and visualization. * Strong working knowledge of JMP for statistical analysis, visualization, and preferably JMP Scripting Language. * Experience with SQL, relational databases, database design, and combining data from multiple sources. * Working knowledge of manufacturing statistics, including SPC, process capability, regression, ANOVA, DOE, and measurement\-system analysis. * Ability to clean, reduce, analyze, and manage large manufacturing datasets. * Familiarity with LabVIEW and the ability to maintain and troubleshoot an existing LabVIEW\-based dashboard. * Ability to communicate effectively with engineering, manufacturing, quality, reliability, and IT teams. Preferred * Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related technical field. * Experience in semiconductor fabrication, optoelectronics, photonics, or another high\-volume manufacturing environment. * Experience with Python libraries such as pandas, NumPy, SciPy, matplotlib, seaborn, or Plotly. * Experience analyzing wafer maps, equipment histories, metrology results, product\-test data, reliability data, or manufacturing yield. * Experience developing automated reports, process\-monitoring alerts, and interactive dashboards. * Familiarity with manufacturing execution systems, equipment databases, SPC systems, or quality\-management systems. * Experience with REST APIs, Git, Linux, or software version\-control practices. Key Competencies * Strong Python, SQL, JMP, and data\-management capability. * Good understanding of database structure and manufacturing\-data traceability. * Working knowledge of manufacturing statistics and data visualization. * Strong data\-quality and troubleshooting skills. * Ability to understand manufacturing requirements and convert them into practical data solutions. * Effective cross\-functional collaboration. * Clear technical communication and documentation.

jobs.title: Staff Mobile Engineer - Android
jobs.description: Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life\-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries. At Lingo, we’re building a groundbreaking health platform that combines continuous biosensor data, real\-time analytics, and personalized insights to help people live fuller, longer, and healthier lives. Our systems ingest millions of sensor readings daily, powering experiences for consumers and partners worldwide, with the reliability and scalability of cloud\-native, enterprise\-grade platforms. At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to: * Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of. * Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year * An excellent retirement savings plan with high employer contribution * Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program and FreeU education benefit \- an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree. * A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune. * A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists. **THE OPPORTUNITY** This **Staff Mobile Engineer, Android** position works onsite in our **Alameda, CA location** for Lingo. As a Staff Mobile Engineer, Android at Lingo, you will lead the design and development of the Android applications and shared mobile platform components that power our biosensing experience. In this role you will set the architectural direction for the Android codebase, raise the engineering bar across the mobile team, and take ownership of large, ambiguous initiatives from concept through production. You bring deep, hands\-on Android expertise and modern Kotlin architecture practices, and you apply that expertise both to your own code and to how the broader team builds. You mentor other engineers, provide architectural guidance across Android teams, and lead design reviews that influence technical decisions across mobile, backend, and product. You are equally comfortable translating complex, ambiguous business problems into scalable technical solutions and communicating those solutions clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. A core part of this role is leading Lingo's transition from React Native to fully native Android, owning the migration strategy and setting the technical standard the rest of the team follows. **What You'll Work On** * Lead the design and development of complex Android applications and shared mobile platform components (SDKs, libraries, tooling). * Define and drive modern Android architecture standards, including Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines/Flow, MVVM/MVI, and modularization. * Ensure scalable, maintainable, and testable code through strong design patterns and best practices; optimize app performance, reliability, and scalability, including startup time, ANRs, and crash\-free sessions. * Own large, ambiguous initiatives from concept to production, establishing long\-term Android technical strategy including modularization, CI/CD, build optimization, and observability. * Partner with backend teams to design efficient mobile APIs and offline\-first solutions. * Lead the full development lifecycle: architecture, coding, testing, CI/CD, release management, monitoring, and maintenance. * Champion automated testing, code quality standards, and secure mobile development practices. * Implement strong observability practices such as crash analytics and performance monitoring. * Integrate AI/ML capabilities into Android applications, including on\-device and cloud\-powered solutions, to deliver intelligent, personalized, mobile experiences. * Lead Lingo's migration from React Native to fully native Android, owning migration strategy, sequencing, and architecture decisions, including how to bridge React Native and native code during the transition, and how to preserve feature parity and app stability throughout. * Evaluate existing React Native components and screens for migration complexity, define native module and screen replacement patterns, and set the technical standard the rest of the Android team follows during the transition. * Mentor senior engineers and provide architectural guidance across Android teams. * Lead design reviews and influence technical decisions across mobile, backend, and product teams. * Translate complex business problems into scalable technical solutions and communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline. * **8\+ years** of software engineering experience with strong Android development expertise. * Deep proficiency in Kotlin and modern Android frameworks, with Jetpack Compose preferred. * Working knowledge of React Native sufficient to assess existing React Native code, plan a native migration, and bridge between React Native and native modules during a phased transition. * Strong experience with mobile architecture patterns, modularization, and large\-scale app development. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Gradle optimization, and mobile observability tools. * Solid understanding of API design, performance tuning, and secure mobile development. * Proven track record of technical leadership and cross\-team influence. * Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across a globally distributed engineering team spanning the US, Spain, and India. **Preferred** * Direct experience leading or contributing to a React Native to native migration in a production consumer application. * Experience in consumer health, digital health, or regulated industries where software quality and reliability have direct implications for end users. * Experience with GraphQL. * Experience integrating on\-device or cloud\-powered AI/ML capabilities into Android applications. * Familiarity with Bluetooth Low Energy protocols and mobile SDK integration for wearable or connected health devices. * Experience building and maintaining shared Android platform components, SDKs, or libraries consumed by other engineering teams. **Apply Now** **Learn more about our health and wellness benefits, which provide the security to help you and your family live full lives:** www.abbottbenefits.com Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity. In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

jobs.title: Entry Level Facilities Technician
jobs.description: Routinely responsible for the maintenance and repairs to the building and grounds, related fixed portable equipment and installation under the supervision of Chief Engineer and/or Assistant Chief Engineer, while successfully performing the Apprenticeship Program. Supports the implementation and documentation of site safety plans and all Able Engineering Services’ operational standards and guidelines, as well as site specific standards, policies and procedures relating to the engineering department. ### **Job Duties** In general, the role and tasks of the Apprentice Engineer will transition to the role of a Journeyman Engineer. The Apprentice Engineer over the term of the Apprenticeship Program will: * Observe a specific task assigned to a Journeyman Engineer – one or many times depending on the complexity of the task. * Perform that task under the direction of the Journeyman Engineer – one or many times depending on the complexity of the task and when the Journeyman is satisfied that the Apprentice Engineer has mastered the task. * Perform that task under the direction of the Chief Engineer to approve and confirm that the Apprentice Engineer has mastered the task. * Once the task has been mastered to the satisfaction of the Chief Engineer, the Apprentice Engineer will perform the task with little or no supervision. This task specific training procedure will occur again and again with all of the tasks at the facility over the term of the Apprenticeship Program, and is the foundation of the Able Engineering Services’ Apprenticeship Program. * Maintains and cleans mechanical, electrical and shop areas. * Demonstrates commitment to learn all facets of the trade, specific building and industry in general. * Coordinates parts, supplies, and equipment from local vendors and inventory. * Performs simple procedures and tasks and other routine maintenance duties. * Performs miscellaneous tasks as assigned by the Chief Engineer and Assistant Chief Engineer. * Under the direction of a Journeyman Engineer maintains and performs repairs to buildings, utilities, grounds and equipment. * Under the direction of a Journeyman Engineer optimize the repair and maintenance of HVAC, electrical and pluming equipment and systems. Uses and helps provide best practices to troubleshoot and repair equipment and system problems so that problems are resolved in the most efficient and effective manner. * Fosters a work environment that promotes energy conservation and continuous improvement of engineering functions. * As appropriate, records all pertinent data in building logbooks and makes all appropriate daily entries. * Process administrative paperwork in accordance to departmental policies and procedures. * Stay abreast of the latest technology as related to building systems and equipment, and emergency response regarding fire and life safety. * Actively functions as a team member. * Demonstrates commitment to quality of service. * Complies with Able Engineering Services’ and facility’s policies and procedures. * Complies and participates with Able Engineering Services’ safety program. * Complies and participates in facility specific safety program. * Maintains regular attendance in the workplace. * Provides highest quality of service to the tenants, staff and visitors at the facility. * Participates in regular required communication with Chief Engineer, Assistant Chief Engineer, management, tenants and other staff. ### **Skills/Education/Experience** * Successfully qualifies for approved Apprenticeship Program. * Successfully completes all milestones of Apprenticeship Program. Candidates should have strong production engineering skills — Python and/or TypeScript, APIs and integrations, testing, and deployment — plus hands\-on modern AI/ML tooling. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Ability to communicate across the spectrum from developer to C\-suite * A portfolio of real\-world AI projects or deployed solutions **Why This Role** ----------------- * You'll do work few people can — shipping production Agentic AI and owning the client relationship at the same time, a scarce hybrid skill set in high demand across AI labs, enterprise SaaS, and consulting * High visibility, high impact — your work goes live at clients and drives measurable ROI, not into a backlog * Direct exposure to frontier models and platforms through partnerships with Anthropic, OpenAI, Agentforce, and the major clouds * Build reusable assets, accelerators, and playbooks that scale your impact across engagements — feeding a field\-to\-product learning loop that shapes what we build next Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. jobs.title: 2027 University Graduate - Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: The Opportunity Adobe is looking for a Machine Learning Engineer who will apply AI and machine learning techniques to big\-data problems to help Adobe better understand, lead and optimize the experience of its customers. Partnering with the business units, the candidate will be building various products that address challenging business problems through our customers’ full lifecycle, from customer analytics to marketing media optimization. By using statistical and econometric methods, predictive models, experimental design methods, and optimization techniques, the candidate will be working on the research and development of exciting projects like attribution, media mix modeling, budget optimization, personalization, causal analysis, time series analysis. Ideal candidates will have a strong academic background as well as technical skills including applied statistics, machine learning, data mining, and software development. Familiarity with working with large\-scale datasets and big data techniques would be a plus. jobs.title: Data Center Engineering Operations Technician
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. Key job responsibilities * Involved with projects of moderate complexity. * Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack\-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA). * Perform rack installs, rack decommissioning, operational readings and facility management. * Provide key performance indicators to senior engineers. * Responsible for the on\-site management of contractors, sub\-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures \& local legislation. * Monitor performance of maintenance and operations on all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center. * Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to while performing work. * Assist with basic support concepts such as ticketing systems, root cause analysis, change management creation, writing procedures and building management systems. * Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12\-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on\-call rotations. * Maintain data center critical infrastructure equipment ensuring 99\.999% up\-time of the world's largest cloud computing portfolio. * Role may support more than one location/site. * Walk job sites in uneven terrain. Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder * Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently and participate in group lifts for 40\+ pounds * Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull. A day in the life How would you like to be a part of Earth’s most customer\-centric company? You would work with teams of front\-line responders who support the operations of some of the world’s most powerful data centers. Our Data Center Engineering Operations team maintain and operate our critical infrastructure systems so that they are prepared to stand up against any situation. AWS has the world’s largest cloud computing portfolio. As an Amazonian you will work in some of the most sophisticated, safe, and secure data centers in the world. Our Engineering Operations Technicians I (EOT’s) help keep them that way by working with the brightest minds from around the globe to help test and implement the newest technology and work practices to meet the demands of a changing market. We have a passion for learning and evolving, it’s how we have helped define ourselves as leaders in the industry. Let’s work hard, have fun, and make history! About the team Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. Mentorship \& Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS\-Annapurna team develops the silicon used in our most advanced machine learning accelerator servers at cutting edge process nodes. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Java Runtime
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Are you fascinated by what happens beneath your code — how a compiler turns bytecode into blistering machine instructions, how a garbage collector reclaims memory without anyone noticing, how a runtime squeezes the last drop of performance out of the hardware? Maybe you've worked on garbage collection in a managed runtime like HotSpot, the .NET CLR, V8, or Chakra. Maybe you earned your expertise the hard way — tuning live services for performance and resilience under real production load. Whatever your path, the Java Runtimes Team at Amazon, owners of Amazon Corretto, would love to talk with you. Java powers the majority of services at Amazon and nearly all public\-facing AWS services. When we make the runtime faster or leaner, thousands of services — and millions of customers — feel it. You will work at the intersection of compilers, garbage collection, and systems software: finding bottlenecks in real running services, developing patches to the OpenJDK compiler, runtime, and libraries, and shipping them to every Amazon developer. You'll share what you learn with the broader engineering community and contribute your improvements back to OpenJDK — where the whole world runs them too. This is deep, high\-leverage systems work with an unusually direct line from your keyboard to global impact. We care about scalability, availability, and efficiency — and about going above and beyond to deliver the best possible Java experience for Amazon's internal teams, Corretto users, and the OpenJDK community. Key job responsibilities Identify areas for improvement using data from real running services, and turn those findings into concrete compiler, GC, and runtime optimizations. Design, implement, and benchmark improvements to JIT compilation, garbage collection, and core runtime subsystems in the OpenJDK compiler, runtime, and libraries. Contribute your changes upstream to OpenJDK and to Amazon Corretto, working through code review and the community process. Tune runtime behavior for performance and efficiency across x86 and Graviton (AArch64\) architectures. Build profiling, observability, and auto\-tuning tooling so runtime expertise scales across the fleet. Share your findings with the engineering community and help service teams adopt runtime improvements and newer JDK versions About the team In 2018 the team migrated Amazon's default JDK to OpenJDK, building rigorous security and quality mechanisms around it so that security and custom patches land internally the moment they are ready. We took that expertise and launched Amazon Corretto, Amazon's no\-cost, production\-ready distribution of OpenJDK — bringing our enhancements to customers and the OpenJDK community at large. Today we push the runtime forward across x86 and Graviton (AArch64\) fleets, and we increasingly encode deep runtime expertise into tooling so that fleet\-wide performance gains scale far beyond one\-to\-one consultation. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 5\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 5\+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience * 5\+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team * Direct contributions to OpenJDK, the HotSpot JVM, or another production managed runtime (e.g. .NET CLR, V8, or Chakra). * Compiler backend or optimization experience — instruction selection, register allocation, code generation, escape analysis, inlining, or intrinsics. * Familiarity with JVM internals such as bytecode, class loading, JIT deoptimization, tiered compilation, or the JVMCI / Graal interfaces. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * A track record of upstream open\-source contributions, published performance work, or conference talks. * A master's or PhD in Computer Science or a related field with a focus on compilers, runtimes, or systems. * Experience mentoring engineers or leading technical initiatives across teams Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.
