jobs.title: Sr. Embedded Software Engineer - Hardware/Software Integration
jobs.description: **Senior Embedded Software Engineer – Hardware/Software Integration** Astronics Advanced Electronic Systems (AES) is seeking a **Senior Embedded Software Engineer** with strong hardware/software integration experience to join our Cabin Electronics Product Group in Kirkland, WA. This is an **on\-site position** with part\-time WFH flexibility. You will work on embedded software that directly interfaces with aircraft power electronics, integrating and validating software on real hardware in the lab and in support of fielded systems. If you enjoy oscilloscopes more than web browsers and like digging into firmware, schematics, and hardware logs to solve real\-world problems, this role is for you. The Cabin Electronics Product Group is the world's leading manufacturer of in\-seat power systems for the commercial airline industry. Our EmPower® product line provides scalable power solutions used by over 280 airlines, IFE suppliers, and all major aircraft OEMs worldwide. **JOB SUMMARY** In this role, you will support **embedded software for aircraft products currently in production**, with a strong emphasis on: * **HW/SW integration and verification on target hardware** * **Root\-cause analysis of field and production issues** * **Design and implementation of embedded software improvements** You will collaborate closely with **Product Support, Electrical, Systems, and Test Engineering** to ensure our products meet performance, reliability, and regulatory requirements. This position requires a solid understanding of how embedded software interacts with hardware, and how design decisions affect product quality, manufacturability, and cost. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Develop, modify, and maintain **embedded software** for production aircraft power systems (resource\-constrained environments). * **Integrate and test software on actual hardware**: bring\-up boards, run diagnostics, and validate functionality using lab equipment. * Investigate and resolve **field and production issues**, including: + Reproducing issues on hardware + Performing root\-cause analysis across HW/SW boundaries + Implementing and verifying corrective actions * Perform and evaluate **software design changes** and conduct verification testing associated with design updates. * Develop software artifacts compliant with **RTCA DO\-178C** processes (Level D). * Review and update **software requirements, architecture, design documents, and verification test plans/procedures**. * Serve as a **subject matter expert** for specific embedded software components across multiple products. * Participate in **peer reviews** with cross\-functional teams and key stakeholders. * Provide accurate **task estimates** and status updates to support project planning and customer commitments. * Document **root cause analyses, corrective actions, and engineering change justifications** for internal and customer\-facing audiences. * Proactively identify and implement improvements to **software development and integration processes**, leveraging industry best practices. **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** **Education** * Bachelor's degree in **Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science**, or a related field. **Technical Experience** * Typically **5\+ years** of hands\-on experience developing and troubleshooting **embedded software** for **resource\-constrained systems** (e.g., bare metal or RTOS\-based, embedded Linux on SoCs, power electronics controllers, or similar). * Proven experience with **hardware/software integratio**n, including: + Working directly on target hardware (board bring\-up, driver debugging, HW interaction) + Using lab instruments (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers) to debug and characterize system behavior * Proficiency in **C and/or C\+\+** for embedded systems; experience with **Python** or similar scripting language for test automation or tooling is a plus. * Experience **debugging and optimizing existing codebases** in a production or field\-support context. * Working knowledge of **RTCA DO\-178C** required. * Familiarity with **software configuration management and problem reporting tools** (e.g., StarTeam, Polarion, or similar). * Knowledge of communication interfaces/protocols such as **UART, RS\-485, ARINC 429** is a plus. * **Embedded Linux** experience and familiarity with **device trees** are desired. **Soft Skills** * Ability to analyze and resolve **complex embedded software and system integration issues** with sound technical judgment. * Strong **verbal and written communication** skills. * Comfortable working in **collaborative, multidisciplinary teams** (Systems, Hardware, Test, Product Support). * Demonstrated experience **leading or mentoring** within software projects is preferred. **Industry Experience** * **Aerospace industry experience** (or other safety\-/mission\-critical, regulated industries such as automotive, rail, or medical devices) highly desired. **Employment Eligibility Requirements** * This position may involve access to items subject to U.S. export\-control laws. Employment is contingent upon the employee's authorization to access such items under applicable law. The company does not guarantee and is under no obligation to seek such authorization if it would be necessary. * Offers of employment are contingent upon successfully passing a pre\-employment background check and **drug test including cannabis screening**. **Compensation \& Benefits** * **Salary Range:** $102,687 – $154,031 annually (**Midpoint: $128,359**). Actual compensation depends on experience, skills, education, certifications, market conditions, and business needs. It is not typical to be hired at or near the top of the range. * **Quarterly Profit Sharing Bonuses** also apply. **Comprehensive Benefits Package** * **Health \& Well\-being:** Medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance; optional critical illness and accident coverage. * **Financial Security:** 401(k) plan and Employee Stock Purchase Plan. * **Work–Life Balance:** Flexible hybrid work arrangements for eligible positions, Employee Assistance Program, and a supportive culture encouraging balance. * **Generous PTO:** Starting at 120 hours annually, plus 12 paid holidays per year. Astronics Corporation (Nasdaq: ATRO) serves the world's aerospace, defense, and other mission critical industries with proven, innovative technology solutions. Astronics works side\-by\-side with customers, integrating its array of power, connectivity, lighting, structures, interiors, and test technologies to solve complex challenges. For over 50 years, Astronics has delivered creative, customer\-focused solutions with exceptional responsiveness. Today, global airframe manufacturers, airlines, militaries, completion centers and Fortune 500 companies rely on the collaborative spirit and innovation of Astronics. The Company's strategy is to increase its value by developing technologies and capabilities that provide innovative solutions to its targeted markets. For more information on Astronics and its solutions, visit www.Astronics.com. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: About Atrium : Founded in 1995, Atrium is a WBENC‑certified leader in Extended Workforce Management and Talent Solutions, blending technology and human expertise to help leading brands reimagine how work gets done. Atrium delivers its market\-leading solutions through four divisions: Talent Solutions, AtriumWORKS™, HR Advisory Services, and Atrium Innovation Research™ (AIR). All offerings integrate seamlessly to create flexible programs built for the evolving world of work. Overview: **About the AIR Incubator** Atrium Innovation Research (AIR) is where early\-stage ideas and applied research become products. The AIR Incubator is a hands\-on venture studio: small, cross\-functional teams take promising concepts \- many rooted in emerging AI and machine\-learning work \- and move them from a hypothesis to a validated, revenue\-ready product. We operate with the urgency of a startup and the resources of an established organization, running several bets in parallel and doubling down on the ones that show real traction. **The Role** We're hiring a **Senior Product Manager** to own the product direction of new ventures inside the incubator. You'll be the person who turns ambiguity into a plan: framing the problem, shaping the product, validating it with real customers, and driving it toward a market. This is a true cross discipline role \- you'll spend as much time in customer discovery and go\-to\-market experiments as you do writing specs, and you'll lead engineering, design, and research partners without relying on a large existing playbook. Responsibilities: * Own products from “0 to 1”: take new concepts from problem framing and prototype through launch and early scale, defining the vision, strategy, and roadmap along the way. * Turn AI/ML research into products: partner with researchers and engineers to translate emerging AI/ML capabilities into applications customers actually want and will pay for. * Run discovery and validation: lead customer interviews, design lightweight experiments, and use evidence to decide fast what to build, pivot, or kill. * Drive go\-to\-market: shape positioning, pricing hypotheses, and the earliest GTM motion; help land design partners and first customers. * Lead cross\-functionally: align engineering, design, research, and commercial partners around a shared plan, and keep multiple bets moving without formal authority over the team. * Define and measure success: set the metrics that matter for an early venture (activation, retention, willingness\-to\-pay) and make the case for continued investment with data. * Communicate up and out: give leadership a clear, honest read on each venture's traction, risks, and next milestones. \#LI\-AJ3 Qualifications: * 8\+ years in product management, including hands\-on experience taking a product from “0 to 1” (startup, new\-venture, or incubator setting strongly preferred). * A track record of shipping products in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments where you defined the problem before solving it. * Fluency with AI/ML product concepts \- you don't need to train models, but you can reason about what today's AI can and can't do and spot where it creates real value. * Strong customer\-discovery instincts and comfort with qualitative and quantitative validation methods. * Experience influencing and leading cross\-functional teams (engineering, design, research) toward outcomes. * Clear, persuasive communication \- you can align a room and write a crisp narrative or spec. * Early go\-to\-market instincts: shaping positioning, pricing hypotheses, and landing first design partners or customers. * Comfort setting and defending early\-venture metrics (activation, retention, willingness\-to\-pay) and making the investment case with data. * Strong project management skills. * Bias to action, high tolerance for ambiguity, and the judgment to know when to move fast and when to slow down. **Nice to Have:*** Prior founder, founding\-PM, or early\-employee experience at a startup. * Tech, Marketing, or Sales background * Experience in staffing, enterprise workforce management solutions, or talent technology. * Familiarity with the domains AIR builds in (workforce technology), and an existing network of potential design partners or early customers. Physical Requirements: * Ability to sit for an extended period of time. * Ability to commute into our New York City Office on a hybrid schedule. Education Requirements: * Technical background or degree in a quantitative/engineering field, or comparable hands\-on experience with data and AI systems. Benefits: Atrium offers a comprehensive **Atrium Care Package**, available upon eligibility, including:* 20 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) * 11 paid holidays * Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance * Health Savings Account (HSA) \& Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) * Pet Insurance * Legal Benefits * 401(k) Program with employer match * Employee Assistance Programs **Employee Perks:*** Summer Fridays * Flexible Work Schedule: Hybrid work schedule * Vibrant company culture with monthly events and in\-office amenities * Employee Wellness Programs * Employee Discounts through Working Advantage * Professional Development Opportunities * Commuter Benefit Program Compensation: The anticipated base salary range for this position is **$165,000–$180,000 annually**, depending on experience. This role is also eligible for an **annual year\-end bonus**. Pay Range: USD $165,000\.00 \- USD $180,000\.00 /Yr. EEO Statement : As a woman\-owned firm, we value diversity. We are an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer and will consider all applications without regard to race,sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, color, religion or creed, national origin or ancestry, veteran status, disability (physical or mental),genetic information, citizenship or any other characteristic protected by law. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions,and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. jobs.description: Audubon is currently seeking a Senior Civil/Structural Design Specialist to join our team in our Lake Charles office. The Senior Civil/Structural Design Specialist will be responsible for developing and coordinating detailed civil design drawings and plans for site development, grading/earthwork, drainage, utilities, and roadways. This role supports engineers and project managers by preparing design layouts, redlines, and construction documents using AutoCAD Civil 3D and related civil design software. The Senior Civil Designer ensures design accuracy, consistency with standards, and adherence to project requirements and schedules. Additionally, this position reviews work prepared by other designers, assists with cross\-discipline coordination, and contributes to quality control throughout the project lifecycle. **PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES****:** * Prepare complete design packages which may include, but not be limited to, preliminary, conceptual, and construction deliverables as well as engineering calculations. * Prepare detailed drawings of parts and assemblies from layouts, designs and working drawings including necessary projections, sectional views and standard specifications. * Interpret verbal or written direction to initiate a preliminary design. * Perform sizing and load calculations associated with foundations and simple\-span beams, using charts and tables, as required, to complete work assignments. * Check detailed sketches and drawings for project applicability and optimal construction. * Check and verify accuracy of drawings prepared by others. * Prepare bills of material (BOM) and specifications when drawings are complete. Revise drawings and * BOM consistent with engineering changes. * Implement revisions and change control per company standards at the direction of engineers. * Assemble information and reference drawings from a variety of sources. * Continually look for product improvements and cost reductions. * Confirm specification and code compliance, equipment compatibility, and optimal cost savings. * Assist with performing field surveys, documenting existing conditions, and/or recommending various design solutions. * Ensure accuracy of completed drawings before final release and verify drawings meet company and industry standards. * Check field red\-lined drawings and generate accurate as\-built drawings as needed. * Assist with proposal compilation utilizing computer aided design equipment and/or graphic tools to prepare high\-level layouts and sketches. * Utilize 2D or 3D computer aided design software to create layouts of civil/structural systems, devices and components, and create fabrication and assembly drawings. * Create technical specifications to facilitate the procurement, fabrication, and installation of components. * Create documentation required to process Engineering Change Orders (ECO). * Utilize engineering sketches, specifications and supporting documents in the designing, detailing, documenting, and verifying of civil/structural parts, subassemblies, assemblies or system configurations. * Identify dimensions, angles, curvatures, tolerances and materials necessary for optimal construction. * Analyze the effect of proposed changes for proper fit and/or interference problems and recommend possible solutions or alternate construction options. * Produce drawings and deliverables utilizing company standards within project\-approved schedule and budget. * Complete man\-hour estimates for discipline specific scope of work. * Maintain proper file management in accordance with company and industry standards. * Interact and communicate effectively with clients, subcontractors, vendors and other consultants. * Perform field data gathering when required to complete project deliverables within approved project scope and schedule. * Track and maintain a continued awareness of overall schedule and budget for assigned projects. * Develop detailed design schedules in coordination with the scheduler/planner, engineering, and project management personnel. * Confirm that discipline\-specific drawing quality is correct, consistent and legible. * Comply with all company and client health, safety, security and environmental (HSSE) standards as well as federal and local HSSE regulations. * Actively participate in company and client hazard identification and observation programs, and immediately report any unsafe acts, conditions or incidents to your supervisor. **Health, Safety, and Environmental Responsibilities:** * All employees are responsible for supporting Audubon Companies' Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) policies and procedures. This includes: * Performing duties in a manner that protects personal and team health and safety * Participating in required HSE training, meetings, and reporting activities * Identifying and reporting hazards, near misses, and unsafe conditions * Following safe work practices and complying with applicable regulatory requirements **EXPERIENCE AND SKILL REQUIREMENTS****:** * High School Diploma or GED required. * Associate's Degree from a Technical Institution preferred. * Minimum of 15 years of experience preferred. * AutoCAD software experience required. * CADWorx software experience required. * PDMS software experience preferred. * Microsoft Office software experience preferred. * Field experience required. * Experience in offshore oil \& gas, onshore gas processing, hydrocarbon storage and transportation, * chemical manufacturing or refining industry required. * Small/Medium project lead experience required. * Large project lead experience preferred. * Ability to find a solution for or to deal proactively with work related problems. * Ability to comprehend instructions and request clarification as necessary. * Ability to work in a team oriented environment. * Ability to think in such a way as to produce a new concept or idea. * Ability to make decisions or take actions to solve a problem or reach a goal. * Ability to accept responsibility and account for his/her actions. * Ability to read and understand drawing markups to determine drafting requirements. * Ability to utilize conventional drafting tools and CAD software to execute drafting requirements. * Ability to read and understand engineering drawings. **No Recruiters, please!** Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled

This is a highly cross\-functional leadership role. The Sr. Director operates as a trusted advisor to senior executives across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Accounting, and Revenue Operations, and is expected to independently identify opportunities, build consensus across stakeholders, and drive analytical initiatives from inception through to adoption. What Your Responsibilities Will Be: ### **Revenue \& Forecasting Analytics** * Own the design and maintenance of Avalara's revenue forecasting models, including providing feedback on policy and revenue recognition * Lead development and governance of the demand generation reporting platform, which will serve as the company's primary source of truth for funnel performance including opportunity stage tracking, TOFU metrics, and marketing pipeline KPIs * Partner with FP\&A on forecast methodology, variance analysis, and reconciliation * Drive identification and resolution of forecast discrepancies, including being the driver of discovery and remediation of any assumption misses ### **Predictive Modeling \& Scoring** * Lead the design and ongoing evolution of Avalara's prospect and customer scoring ecosystem, including product fit scores (A–D grade), propensity\-to\-buy models, ICP scoring\\, and customer health metrics * Own the alignment process across GTM stakeholders to define model success metrics, validate predictive performance, and ensure score adoption by Marketing, Sales Development, and Sales * Drive operationalization of scoring tools by ensuring models are not only built but actively embedded into sales workflows, SDR outreach, prospect targeting, and account prioritization ### **Data Infrastructure \& Governance** * Oversee the team's analytics engineering function, including Fivetran\-based ingestion, dbt model development, Snowflake schema design, and data pipeline quality for commercial datasets * Own the integration and governance of third\-party data sources including ZoomInfo, Cognism, D\&B, and Clay * Manage Snowflake data access, permissions, and ingestion pipelines for commercial data domains (Salesforce, Gong, Google Ads, AvaTax, Marketo, and more) * Partner with the Data Platform Engineering team on infrastructure decisions, the migration off legacy Hex / Power BI reporting onto Omni Analytics, and capacity planning * Own governance of core metric definitions and calculation logic (e.g., funnel stages, scoring inputs, forecast components) that feed into company\-wide KPIs, ensuring consistency between this team's models and the definitions maintained centrally by GAI ### **AI\-Enabled Analytics \& Platform Modernization** * Own and drive the AI roadmap for the team's analytical domains (forecasting, scoring, GTM/commercial analytics), defining where LLM\-powered insight generation, conversational analytics, and agentic workflows create real business leverage * Lead the team's transition from traditional dashboard\-based BI (Hex, Power BI) to Omni Analytics as the semantic layer and conversational analytics interface, including model/metric layer design so that natural\-language querying returns governed, trustworthy answers * Design and ship AI agents embedded directly into GTM, Finance, and Sales workflows (e.g., automated deal/account insights, forecast variance flags, scoring explainability) rather than standalone reporting, with clear ownership of accuracy, guardrails, and adoption * Evaluate build\-vs\-buy tradeoffs for AI/LLM tooling, balancing speed, cost, data security, and long\-term flexibility, and bring recommendations to the VP with a clear point of view ### **Stakeholder Partnership \& Executive Communication** * Serve as the analytics partner to senior leadership across Revenue Operations, Marketing, Sales, and Finance, translating complex analytical outputs into clear, actionable narratives * Drive cross\-functional alignment on key company metrics including OKR definitions, MBO criteria, and performance measurement frameworks * Present analytical findings, forecast updates, and strategic recommendations directly to VP and C\-suite stakeholders * Build and maintain a formal operating model with FP\&A that ensures a single source of analytical truth reaches executive leadership ### **Team Leadership \& D th transparency: work is documented, peer\-reviewed, and can be picked up by any team member * Executive leadership has a single, trusted analytical foundation that serves as the ground for insights and narrative What You'll Need to be Successful: **Qualifications** ------------------ * 10\+ years of experience in analytics, data science, or data engineering, with at least 4 years in a people management role * Deep expertise in Snowflake, SQL, dbt, and modern data stack tooling; experience with Omni, Power BI, Hex, or similar BI/semantic\-layer platforms * Hands\-on experience with LLM\-powered / conversational analytics tools and building AI agents or automated workflows on top of a governed data model (vs. one\-off prompting); able to distinguish genuine analytical leverage from AI novelty * Experience building and managing distributed teams that blend onshore and offshore talent across time zones, with a track record of sustaining quality, security, and stakeholder trust at that scale * Strong command of statistical modeling, predictive analytics, and machine learning concepts applied to commercial use cases * Proven ability to work with and influence senior stakeholders across multiple functions * Experience owning complex, multi\-stakeholder analytical initiatives from problem framing through to business adoption * Exceptional communication skills with strong ability to translate technical output into executive\-ready narratives * SaaS business model fluency, including ARR, GRR, NRR, bookings, revenue recognition, and GTM funnel mechanics * Experience with Salesforce data, marketing automation platforms, and CRM analytics a strong plus Avalara is an AI\-first Company: AI is embedded in our workflows, decision\-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI\-related technologies, ready to thrive here. * You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges \- improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers. * You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too. How We'll Take Care of You: Total Rewards In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses. Health \& Wellness Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance. Inclusive culture and diversity Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee\-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship. What You Need To Know About Avalara: We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech. We’ve already built an industry\-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6\.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real \- we're a billion dollar business \- and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission \- to be part of every transaction in the world. We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too. **We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer** Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. jobs.title: CXO AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Innovate with purpose** At BILL, we believe in empowering the businesses that drive our economy. By replacing outdated financial processes with innovative tools, we help businesses—from startups to established brands—make smarter decisions and gain control of their operations. And we don't stop there: we're creating the future of financial automation so businesses can spend more time on what matters. Working here means you become part of a vision\-driven team that's ready to tackle challenges and build cutting\-edge solutions. We value purpose, drive, and curiosity—and we thrive in a fast\-paced, ever\-changing environment. We're remote\-first, with office spaces in San Jose, CA and Draper, UT — and opportunities to connect in person when it counts. BILLders collaborate to deliver real impact for businesses that need more time in their busy weeks. BILL builds high performing teams and we seek to hire the best talent for every role. We're committed to building a workplace that fosters inclusion and diverse perspectives, valuing each person's unique skills and experiences. We'd love to hear from you—you might be just what we're looking for, whether in this role or another. ✨ Let's give businesses more time for what matters. Customer Experience Operations at BILL handles 60K\+ customer contacts per month across chat, phone, and email. We support SMB, mid\-market, and enterprise customers with a mix of internal and BPO teams across four countries. We're standing up a new team inside CXO focused on building agentic AI systems that automate manual work, catch things before they fall through cracks, and give leaders visibility into their operations. The work isn't new. We've been building AI tools and delivering value ad hoc, but now it's our mandate. This is a founding team. You'd be shaping the architecture, the workflows, and the culture from the ground up. There's existing work to build on, but no inherited playbook to follow. You'll work directly with CARE leaders, QA, Advocacy, and WFM to identify what to automate and validate that it's working. In this role, you will: * Automate repetitive operational workflows: CES reporting, QA transcript analysis, knowledge article maintenance, SOP\-driven case workflows. Deploy standardized automations across Slack and Salesforce at scale. * Flag stalled handoffs, aged cases, SLA breach risks, and duplicate cases before they become problems. Review DevRev/Cresta transcripts to ensure bots are behaving as expected. * Give leaders self\-serve access to data and insights. Deliver automated weekly/monthly business intelligence on cadence (site health, volume, SLA, CES). Detect escalation patterns and repeat contacts that nobody is connecting the dots on. * Build memory architecture: bots that look at staffing, feedback, transcripts, and agent work together at scale. Know what happened last week and what's coming next. You will also: * Connect and deploy orchestration layers (MCP, custom connectors) to automate CX business workflows and productize internal tools * Measure operational reliability and system accuracy to ensure business metrics are being achieved: contacts deflected, cost avoided, hours saved. Design escalation patterns so the system knows when to surface to a human. * Partner with the data team on structured data layers that keep AI outputs trustworthy. Productize what works so it scales across the org. We'd love to chat if you have: * 5\+ years building and deploying production systems. Python required. SQL strongly preferred. * 2\+ years working with LLMs in production: prompt configuration, tool use, function calling, RAG pipelines, agentic frameworks (MCP, custom orchestration, etc.) * Experience building LLM orchestration and integration layers that connect AI agents to business systems. Multi\-step workflows, tool coordination, memory management, error recovery. * You understand context engineering: accuracy depends on what information reaches the model. You've structured context, routing logic, and retrieval pipelines for these systems at scale. * You know how to measure operational reliability of AI systems: are they actually delivering the business outcomes they're supposed to? * Comfort with ambiguity. You'll define the approach, not just implement specs. * You can translate between technical implementation and business value: hours saved, contacts deflected, cost avoided. * Familiarity with customer support operations: contact routing, SLAs, agent workflows, quality assurance. * Bias toward shipping. jobs.title: Business Development Analyst
jobs.description: **WHY JOIN BALLARD MARINE CONSTRUCTION?** Ballard Marine Construction takes on the work others cannot or will not. As a specialty marine and underwater contractor, we solve complex problems across Power, Water/Wastewater, Industrial, Environmental, and Transportation markets throughout North America. What sets Ballard apart is the combination of technical depth, field experience, creativity, and the willingness to go after difficult work where our capabilities matter most. We are not interested in chasing everything we want to understand the market, recognize where we have an advantage, and make deliberate decisions about where we compete. Our culture reflects that same mindset. We are competitive, accountable, curious, and always looking for a better way. We expect people to dig deeper, challenge assumptions, and bring ideas forward, not simply maintain the status quo. For someone in an analytical role, Ballard gives you something worth digging into: complex markets, meaningful data, real project outcomes, and a business that wants to use those insights to make smarter decisions about where we grow next **Job Summary:** Under the direction of the Executive Vice President of Business Development, the Business Development Analyst supports Ballard’s national business development program by identifying early\-stage opportunities, evaluating fit with Ballard’s markets and capabilities, and turning market, pipeline, and project\-performance data into actionable business intelligence. Working across Business Development, Estimating, and Operations, this role combines public and private project research, CRM data, competitor intelligence, win/loss trends, estimating accuracy, project outcomes, and risk considerations to strengthen lead scoring, Go/No\-Go decisions, pursuit prioritization, and resource allocation. The Analyst also maintains reliable CRM information and supports reporting, process improvement, automation, and practical AI tools to improve how Ballard identifies and develops the right opportunities. **Ideal Candidate:** Core Attributes: * **Grit and Resiliency** \- We dig deep to figure out how to make things happen no matter how impossible it seems. We never give up. We take on challenges that nobody else can; or will. * **Comradery and Inspirational** \- We are a hard\-working team of likeminded individuals working toward a common goal. We regularly celebrate wins and like to have fun whether at work or at play. We come together each day looking for ways to instill life and energy into the world around us. * **Driven and Competitive** \- We love competition. We love to win and love to learn when we lose. Not getting the job done is not an option. We are obsessed to do our best and we do what it takes to win. * **Trustworthy and Respectful** \- We are passionate about honesty, authenticity and transparency. No lies. No drama. No politics. We value constructive conflict and ensure that even in conflict we treat others with respect. * **Ownership and Accountability** \- When something goes wrong, we first “look in the mirror” before we “look out the window”. We ask “what could I have done differently?” and then we share lessons learned. Regularly challenging ourselves and those around us to be better is a way of life. “Me first” belongs here. Education: * Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Business, Finance, Economics, Construction Management, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field * Equivalent education and relevant professional experience may be considered in place of a degree Experience: * 3\+ years of professional experience in market intelligence, business development operations, research, analytics, CRM administration, business intelligence, or a related field * Experience using CRM, reporting, and workflow tools; Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power BI, Excel, and Power Automate preferred * Experience in construction, engineering, utilities, industrial markets, environmental consulting, public infrastructure, or another project\-based industry preferred Skills: * Strong research, analytical, critical\-thinking, and business\-judgment skills * Ability to synthesize information from multiple sources and translate complex findings into clear recommendations, priorities, and next actions * Proficiency with Excel, CRM systems, dashboards, reporting tools, and practical workflow automation; familiarity with AI\-assisted research is preferred * Understanding of how opportunities move through a project\-based business development, estimating, pursuit, and delivery lifecycle * Commitment to simple, reliable systems and consistent CRM terminology, documentation, data standards, and quality controls * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain analysis to varied audiences * Ability to work independently and collaborate across Business Development, Estimating, Operations, Area leadership, technical teams, and external partners Responsibilities: * Identify early\-stage opportunities by researching long\-lead indicators, such as owner capital plans, budgets and master plans, regulatory and environmental filings, funding programs, public meeting records, consultant selections, and industrial investment activity * Evaluate identified leads for alignment with Ballard’s markets, capabilities, geography, timing, value, delivery method, relationships, risk profile, and self\-perform potential; advise when Ballard should engage, who should receive the lead, and the recommended next action * Maintain accurate, decision\-useful lead and opportunity data in Dynamics 365; route qualified intelligence to the appropriate Business Development, Area, or technical teams and track follow\-up * Analyze pipeline and market activity, including source effectiveness, lead quality, aging, conversion, client and competitor activity, and how early opportunities are identified, and communicate findings through concise dashboards and reports * Create a feedback loop between Business Development, Estimating, and Operations using win/loss reasons, pricing and estimate accuracy, delivery lessons, margin, risk, and capability fit to improve lead scoring, Go/No\-Go decisions, positioning, and resource allocation * Improve and document Ballard's lead\-development process, including research criteria, CRM terminology and data standards, reporting, workflows, and approved data sources * Help define, test, and monitor automation and AI\-assisted research tools; validate outputs for relevance, duplicates, false positives, and missed opportunities * Conduct targeted geographic and market research using Ballard’s CRM, pipeline, historical project data, and external industry sources to estimate opportunity volume, type, value, and timing * Prepare concise market assessments identifying key clients, engineers, contractors, competitors, procurement patterns, and barriers to entry, and provide recommendations to support decisions about entering, expanding within, or prioritizing a market * Support Anchor Project identification, pursuit prioritization, strategic research, and other Business Development initiatives as assigned **Physical Demands Working Environment:** * Work is primarily performed in an office environment * Ability to remain seated and work at a computer for extended periods * Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, and move between work areas as needed * Ability to frequently use a keyboard, mouse, and other standard office equipment * Ability to communicate and exchange information in person, by phone, and through virtual platforms * Ability to occasionally lift, carry, push, or pull items weighing up to 20 pounds **Benefits:** Ballard offers a comprehensive benefits package and provides a culture that values opportunity for growth, development, and internal promotion. Benefits include medical, dental, vision, life insurance, LTD, STD, PTO, 401K Plan with employer match, paid holidays, and so much more!! **Salary Range:** * $90K \- $120K * *Pay is commensurate with experience and qualifications.* **EEO Statement:** Ballard Marine Construction, LLC. is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, or veteran status. Reasonable accommodation will be considered for qualified individuals with a disability if it does not create an undue hardship for the Company, consistent with the ADA as amended.

jobs.title: Incident Responder 1
jobs.description: **Position Location Details:** * **Country:** USA * **Work mode:** hybrid preferred, remote considered **Position Summary:** Bentley’s Information Security team is building a security operation where automation does the first pass and people do the judgment. Automated investigation agents already triage most of our alerts, investigate cloud risks, and test our own defenses around the clock. What they cannot do is decide whether they were right, handle the cases they could not resolve, or make the next detection better. As an Incident Responder I, you join the Security Operations Center at the point where an alert becomes a decision. You will verify what automation concluded, own the cases it hands back, take containment actions within clearly defined limits, and feed what you learn back into detections and playbooks. You will work with modern tooling — CrowdStrike, Wiz, a cloud\-native SIEM and SOAR platform — across a global engineering and SaaS environment spanning three public clouds. This is an entry point, not a destination. The role is designed so that the share of your time spent on routine response falls as your share of engineering and improvement work grows, and it sits on a defined career path into detection engineering, security engineering, architecture, or governance. **Responsibilities:** **Keep us safe today*** Monitor and respond to alerts and cases from the SIEM, SOAR, endpoint, and cloud security platforms, including the output of automated investigation agents. * Review automated verdicts — malicious, not malicious, inconclusive — and act on them: confirm and close, escalate, or contain within the approved autonomy tier (isolate a host, revoke a session, block an indicator). * Own the inconclusive queue: investigate what automation could not resolve and document the outcome so the same class of case can be automated next time. * Hand off and receive incidents cleanly across shifts with complete, structured notes; escalate to senior responders and management per the incident response procedure. **Sharpen what we have*** Sample automated verdicts for accuracy (false positives and false negatives) and report findings; your sampling doubles as audit evidence for our compliance program. * Tune existing detections and playbooks based on what your shift observed; keep runbooks current. * Watch the health of the tooling the SOC depends on — sensor coverage, connector status, log sources — and raise gaps before they become blind spots. **Help build what’s next*** Contribute to detection\-as\-code: propose new detections and playbook steps, version them, and test them with a senior engineer. * Learn the behavioral baselines of AI agents operating in our environment and flag abnormal agent activity — a new class of alert this SOC owns. * Take part in post\-incident reviews and turn lessons into automation requests for the engineering team. **Qualifications:** * 1–2 years of education or training in a security\-related field, or equivalent work experience in IT roles such as desktop support, network operations, or systems administration. * Working knowledge of operating systems, authentication protocols, network protocols and topologies, email systems, and cloud service models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS). * A basic understanding of cyberattacks and threats, using the MITRE ATT\&CK framework as a reference. * Comfort working alongside automation: you can read an automated investigation summary, judge whether it is right, and explain why. * Curiosity and a habit of writing things down. The value of this role is in what you feed back into the system. * Availability for a shift rotation as part of a 24×7 operation. * This is a full\-time role expected to work 40 hours per week, based in the USA and does not require travel. * Requires sitting or standing at will while performing work on a computer. * Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future employer sponsorship. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Exposure to SOAR playbooks, scripting (Python or PowerShell), or query languages such as KQL or SPL. * Hands\-on time with CrowdStrike Falcon, Wiz, Microsoft Sentinel or a comparable SIEM. * Security\+, CySA\+, or a similar foundational certification — or the intent to earn one; we fund training and certifications. **About Bentley Systems** Around the world, infrastructure professionals rely on software from Bentley Systems to help them design, build, and operate better and more resilient infrastructure for transportation, water, energy, cities, and more. Founded in 1984 by engineers for engineers, Bentley is the partner of choice for engineering firms and owner\-operators worldwide, with software that spans engineering disciplines, industry sectors, and all phases of the infrastructure lifecycle. Through our digital twin solutions, we help infrastructure professionals unlock the value of their data to transform project delivery and asset performance. www.bentley.com **Equal Opportunity Employer:** Bentley is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, pregnancy, protected veteran status, religion, national origin, age, genetic information or any other protected characteristic. jobs.title: Data Engineer (BI)
jobs.description: Bridgeway is seeking a Data Engineer (BI) to design, develop, and maintain our data warehouse infrastructure and the semantic models, dashboards, and reporting that sit on top of it. This role involves working closely with analysts, engineers, and business stakeholders to shape our data architecture, build secure and efficient data pipelines and curated data models, and turn data into self\-service analytics and insight across the organization. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in data engineering, dimensional and semantic data modeling, business intelligence tooling, and ELT processes, along with a passion for making data accessible and actionable. This is a remote position with occasional travel. Preference given to East Coast candidates. **Key Responsibilities**: * Design and maintain semantic data models, metrics layers, and certified datasets that provide a consistent, business\-friendly source of truth for reporting and self\-service analytics. * Define, standardize, and govern KPIs, calculation logic, and a shared metric glossary so that metrics are consistent and trusted across dashboards and self\-service analytics. * Develop, maintain, and optimize dashboards and reports in Sigma (primary), with some Power BI and native Databricks dashboards/AI\-BI Genie , and enable business users to explore data through governed self\-service analytics. * Define and maintain Sigma workspace standards (workbook templates, certified datasets, RLS configuration, naming/governance conventions) in the development instance for promotion across tenant environments, in partnership with Platform Engineering, for tenant\-level administration. * Collaborate with the Architecture team on data quality, testing, and observability; own triage and resolution of BI\-layer/dashboard issues. * Drive BI adoption by training and supporting business users, monitoring dashboard usage, and identifying underused or redundant assets for redesign, training, or deprecation. * Ensure data security and compliance, including role\-based access controls for security, encryption, masking, and governance best practices to ensure compliant handling of sensitive information. * Gather reporting and analytics requirements from business stakeholders, define success measures, and translate them into technical specifications and well\-structured data products. * Enable analytics, reporting, and AI/ML use cases through well\-structured, business\-friendly data models, feature availability, and platform integrations using tools such as Databricks Vector Search and Model Serving. * Collaborate within an Agile\-Scrum framework and develop comprehensive technical design documentation to ensure efficient and successful delivery. * Build and maintain production dashboards and workbooks in Sigma, ensuring reliability and performance for business users. * Implement row\-level security and Entra ID\-based access controls to govern and secure data access within the BI/data platform. * Collaborate and communicate proactively with engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders, influencing priorities and driving alignment across teams. **Requirements**: * 3\+ years of hands\-on data engineering and/or business intelligence experience required. * Experience in Databricks, including DAB and Materialized Views. * 3\+ years designing semantic/dimensional data models and building dashboards and reports in a modern BI platform including hands\-on experience with a metrics or semantic layer required. * 3\+ years of experience with analytical SQL (ANSI SQL/T\-SQL/Spark SQL) and Python for data engineering, including pipeline construction, transformation logic, and automation required. * Azure DevOps; GitHub CoPilot knowledge is a plus. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Master's degree preferred. * Experience dealing with HIPAA compliant data sets is a plus.

jobs.title: Technical Service Field Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description:** Brooks Instrument (www.brooksinstrument.com), an industry leader in flow and pressure instrumentation for critical applications, is seeking candidates for **Technical Field Service Engineer** position that will be based at the company headquarters in Hatfield, Pennsylvania (suburban Philadelphia). The company has manufacturing locations in Pennsylvania, Hungary, Malaysia and Korea, and also maintains sales and service offices throughout the world. Our high\-tech products are used in laboratory and process applications in end markets such as: oil \& gas, petrochemical, medical devices, waste water, life sciences, and analytical instruments. Brooks is a division of ITW (Illinois Tool Works), a fortune 200 company. ITW is one of the world’s leading diversified manufacturers of specialized industrial equipment, consumables, and related service businesses. The company has operations in 56 countries and employs over 50,000 employees. These talented employees, many of whom have specialized engineering or scientific expertise, contribute to ITW’s global leadership in innovation. The company is proud of its broad portfolio of nearly 10,000 active patents, and is focused on fully leveraging its highly differentiated business model to deliver solid growth with consistent best\-in\-class margins and return on capital. **Basic Function** Provide technical assistance to customers, sales representatives, and application engineers both in the factory and at customer locations. Assist the Failure Analysis and Technical Services groups with customer returns, diagnostics, and troubleshooting. Perform field service activities including calibration, training, troubleshooting, installation/startup assistance, and technical support on Brooks Mass Flow Controllers and other Brooks products. Successful candidates must have a minimum of 2\-year degree in engineering technology or an equivalent with 5\+ years of experience servicing highly technical or related equipment, excellent customer service skills, strong mechanical aptitude, willingness to travel (up to 40%) and great communication and follow through skills. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Serve as a primary technical point of contact for customers, providing after\-sales support at customer sites and via phone, email, and remote tools. * Perform on\-site calibration, troubleshooting, installation/startup assistance, and technical service on Brooks products, including billable, warranty, and escalation support. * Communicate clearly and professionally with customers regarding troubleshooting, findings, corrective actions, and recommendations. * Provide customer training on Brooks products, software, operation, maintenance, calibration, and troubleshooting, both on\-site and in\-house. * Collaborate with Failure Analysis on diagnostics, testing, data review, root cause investigations, and failure reporting. * Work with Engineering and New Product Development to support product validation and provide feedback on serviceability, supportability, tools, and documentation. * Support the development and improvement of service software, diagnostic tools, test equipment, technical documentation, and training materials. * When not assigned to customer field service activities, perform in\-house Technical Services responsibilities, including customer support, troubleshooting, testing, training, and Failure Analysis support. * Maintain strong product knowledge, follow Brooks and customer safety requirements, support continuous improvement initiatives, and work effectively in a team environment. **Education and Experience** **Required Qualifications** * Associate or bachelor’s degree in engineering technology or a related field, or equivalent experience. * Approximately 5 years of experience supporting or servicing complex technical products involving electronics and/or mechanics. * Experience providing customer\-facing technical support, including troubleshooting, issue ownership, and communication via phone, email, and directly at customer sites. * Ability to diagnose, test, troubleshoot, and service products using electrical schematics, mechanical drawings, and test equipment. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate professionally and effectively with customers, including during difficult or challenging situations. * Proficiency with Windows\-based systems and the ability to learn new software applications and service tools. * Ability to work independently at customer sites while coordinating with internal technical resources as needed. * Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally up to approximately 40% based on customer and business needs. * undefined **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with automation, controls, or system integration, including PLC\-based systems. * Familiarity with industrial communication protocols such as Serial (RS\-232/RS\-485\), Ethernet/IP, PROFINET, and EtherCAT. * Experience supporting digitally enabled or networked instrumentation. * Hands\-on field service experience supporting industrial or semiconductor equipment. * Background in industrial or semiconductor process equipment or prior experience with Brooks Instrument or similar products. **Benefits** Our employees enjoy competitive, merit\-based salary plus excellent benefits including: * Health and dental insurance * Company Paid Life Insurance * Short and Long Term Disability * 401K plan with generous company match * Vacation, personal days and holidays * Continuing education reimbursement program * Flexible spending accounts The opportunity to join a well established (80 years in business) yet dynamically changing organization that works together as a team to meet the challenges of satisfying customers’ needs and managing rapid growth to better compete in a global marketplace. *ITW is an equal opportunity employer. We value our colleagues’ unique perspectives, experiences and ideas and create workplaces where everyone can develop their careers and perform to their full potential.* *As an equal employment opportunity employer, ITW is committed to equal employment opportunity and fair treatment for employees, beginning with the hiring process and continuing through all aspects of the employment relationship.* *All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability, protected Veteran status or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.*

jobs.description: **IT Systems Engineer (Level II)** **Job Summary** CISO Global is seeking a skilled **IT Systems Engineer (Level II)** to join our Secure Managed Services team. This role supports a diverse portfolio of customer environments and requires strong technical troubleshooting skills, excellent customer communication, and the ability to take ownership of issues through resolution. As an IT Systems Engineer, you will support and maintain both cloud\-based and traditional on\-premises customer environments, including desktops, laptops, servers, network infrastructure, Microsoft 365 services, mobile devices, and business applications. This position serves as an escalation point for our Level I Service Desk team and is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving more complex technical issues, supporting multiple customer environments, collaborating with other technical teams, and continuing to grow their technical skills. Success in this role requires more than technical ability. Our engineers regularly interact directly with customers and are expected to communicate professionally, build trust, take ownership of issues, and consistently provide a strong customer experience. Successful candidates are proactive problem solvers who can manage multiple priorities, adapt quickly between different customer environments, communicate clearly, and remain accountable for seeing issues through to resolution. **Key Responsibilities** **Technical Escalation Support** * Serve as an escalation point for technical issues that require support beyond the Level I Service Desk. * Troubleshoot and resolve more complex desktop, server, Microsoft 365, networking, identity, and application\-related issues. * Provide technical guidance to Service Desk team members when appropriate. * Recognize when an issue requires escalation to Level III engineering resources and ensure proper documentation and handoff. **Remote Monitoring and Management** * Utilize Remote Monitoring and Management (RMM) tools to proactively monitor, maintain, and support customer systems. * Identify and remediate technical issues before they impact end users when possible. * Assist with patching, system maintenance, software deployment, and endpoint health. **Ticket Management** * Manage and resolve technical incidents and service requests through the ticketing system. * Maintain accurate documentation, detailed troubleshooting notes, and strong ticket hygiene. * Communicate clearly and consistently with customers regarding issue status, expectations, and resolution. * Take ownership of assigned issues and ensure appropriate follow\-through. **End\-User Technical Support** * Provide advanced troubleshooting for desktops, laptops, mobile devices, peripherals, and end\-user applications. * Support Windows, macOS, and Android environments. * Diagnose operating system, application, hardware, connectivity, and user profile issues. **Microsoft 365 and Cloud Administration** * Administer and support Microsoft 365 environments, including Exchange Online, Entra ID, Microsoft Intune, and related services. * Support user lifecycle management, licensing, mailbox administration, permissions, identity, and access control. * Assist with endpoint management, security configuration, and device administration. * Troubleshoot Microsoft 365 applications and cloud service issues. **Server and On\-Premises Infrastructure** * Administer and troubleshoot Windows Server environments and traditional Active Directory domains. * Support Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, File and Print Services, and domain controllers. * Assist with server maintenance, patching, system health monitoring, and troubleshooting. * Support customers operating hybrid environments that combine on\-premises infrastructure with Microsoft cloud services. **Networking** * Troubleshoot network connectivity issues across customer environments. * Support and diagnose issues involving DNS, DHCP, VPN connectivity, switches, firewalls, VLANs, wireless networks, and general network communication. * Work with internal engineering resources and third\-party vendors when additional network support is required. **Identity and Access Management** * Administer user accounts, permissions, security groups, authentication, and access controls across Microsoft 365 and Active Directory environments. * Assist with identity\-related troubleshooting and security configuration. **Email and Security Support** * Support enhanced email security solutions designed to protect customer environments from phishing, malicious email, and other threats. * Assist with security\-related investigations, endpoint remediation, vulnerability remediation, and account security issues. * Follow established security standards and escalation procedures. **Deployment and Systems Administration** * Deploy and configure desktops, laptops, applications, and related technology for new and existing users. * Assist with workstation imaging, provisioning, software deployme  requirements. * Transition effectively between customers and technical issues throughout the workday. * Maintain professionalism and attention to detail while balancing multiple priorities. **Qualifications** **Experience** * **3 years of professional IT support experience preferred.** * Managed Service Provider (MSP) experience is strongly preferred. * Experience supporting small to mid\-size business environments. * Previous experience functioning as a technical escalation resource is preferred. **Technical Proficiency** Candidates should have hands\-on experience with several of the following areas: * Windows desktop operating systems * Windows Server * Active Directory and Group Policy * Microsoft 365 * Exchange Online * Microsoft Entra ID * Microsoft Intune * DNS and DHCP * VPN troubleshooting * Firewalls, switches, VLANs, and network connectivity * Endpoint troubleshooting and administration * Ticketing systems * Remote Monitoring and Management platforms * Business application troubleshooting Experience with both Microsoft cloud environments and traditional on\-premises Active Directory environments is highly valued. **Customer Service and Communication** * Strong verbal and written communication skills. * Ability to explain technical issues clearly to non\-technical users. * Strong customer service mindset with the ability to build trust and maintain professional relationships. * Ability to remain professional and composed while troubleshooting customer\-impacting issues. **Ownership and Problem Solving** * Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. * Ability to independently investigate and resolve technical problems. * Demonstrated ability to take ownership of issues and follow them through to resolution. * Ability to prioritize work effectively in a fast\-paced, multi\-customer environment. * Willingness to collaborate, ask questions, and escalate appropriately when needed. **Security Mindset** * Commitment to security best practices and protecting customer environments. * Ability to follow established security procedures, access controls, and documentation standards. **Certifications** Relevant industry certifications such as Microsoft, CompTIA, or similar credentials are advantageous but are not required. **Work Environment** * Candidates **must reside in Arizona**. * Candidates must be able and willing to travel to customer locations throughout the Phoenix and Scottsdale area. You'll partner with teams across the organization to identify opportunities, build models, and turn data from Snowflake and other sources into recommendations that drive business outcomes. You will also play a key role in building our conversational analytics capabilities and expanding how we use AI to better serve our members and employees. We're looking for someone who is curious, detail\-oriented, and motivated by making a difference. **Responsibilities:** * Develops data science solutions that utilize machine learning, artificial intelligence, statistical and quantitative modeling to develop predictive and prescriptive analytics. * Applies and integrates statistical, mathematical, predictive modeling and business analysis skills to manage and manipulate complex data from a variety of sources. * Creates visualizations, including dashboards, to display data\-backed insights and predictive results. * Works across a wide range of related areas including data extraction and cleansing, feature engineering, machine learning, exploratory analysis, data quality analysis, experimental analysis. * Partners with other teams to create and deploy Data Products that create member and/or business value. * Executes data science and analytics projects, including, but not limited to enterprise projects, run\-the\-business, and other special projects. * Participates in and communicates the status of projects with respect to milestones and schedule commitments. * Leads data discovery sessions and documents needs in a way that can translate into work requirements for other team members. * Elicits requirements using interviews, document analysis, requirements sessions, data descriptions and definition, use cases, scenarios, and data analysis. * Validate hypotheses, identify growth opportunities, and influence direction for process improvement with analyses, experimentation or other scientific methods. * Develops quality assurance test plans and direct quality assurance testing. * Adheres to data science best practices, documentation requirements, and BT standards and guidelines. * Prepares and delivers reports, recommendations, or alternatives that address existing and potential trouble areas across the organization. * Adheres to data science policies and procedures. * Works closely with data engineers, analysts, and team members to support data\-driven projects. * Mentors data analysts. * Fosters business and IT relationships to understand key needs and form collaborative strategic partnerships. * Seeks opportunities to improve department efficiency and reduce expenses by streamlining operations. * Comply with all Federal Regulations as they pertain to your job duties including Bank Secrecy Act. **Position Requirements:** * This position is Remote. * Bachelor’s degree in data science, applied mathematics, statistics, or machine learning is Required. * 5\+ years of prior experience in data scientist role is Required. * 1 \+ year of data science roles or equivalent experience including working with stakeholders is Required * Experience applying statistical modeling, machine learning (ML/AI) algorithms for supervised \& unsupervised learning, and natural\-language processing (NLP) to business problems and goals is Required. * Proficient in SnowFlake, Python, R, SQL, and basic machine learning is Required. * Proficient in using data visualization tools. Excellent communications skills, including the ability to simplify recommended action plans from complex data science project is Required. * Must be able to understand and analyze data and rapidly generate actionable results. Ability to influence and communicate complex analysis \& insights to a non\-technical audience. * **Connexus Credit Union's Employer Recognitions:** * 2026 Best Place to Work in IT, Computer World *Equal Opportunity* *Employer/Disabled/Veterans/41* *CFR 60–1\.4, 41 CFR 60\-1\.35*

jobs.title: Project Engineer - Data Center Construction
jobs.description: **Posting Title:** Project Engineer – Data Center Construction **Reports To:** Project Executive **Location:** Santa Teresa, NM **Salary Range:** $66,000 to $86,000 This position primarily involves working on\-site at the project location or in office. Travel frequency and duration will vary depending on the role and project timeline. Final determination of a successful candidate’s starting pay will vary based on a number of factors, including market location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, education and experience. The pay scale listed for this position is generally for candidates that meet the specified qualifications and requirements listed on this specific job description. We provide a competitive compensation package that recognizes your experience, credentials, and education alongside a robust benefits program to meet your needs. Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. **WHO WE ARE** Since 1954, Cupertino Electric, Inc. (CEI)has been powered by people who’ve built a reputation for delivering high\-profile, complex projects. Real, tangible things that alter the landscape and improve lives. And we've done it with integrity for more than 70 years. We’re problem solvers and innovation seekers. We’re team players and safety fanatics. And we're proud to be part of Quanta Services (PWR:NYSE), North America's largest employer of skilled craft labor. Because what we do is important, but how we do it is everything. **THE DATA CENTER TEAM** We build mission\-critical data centers throughout the U.S. to ensure crucial information accessed by millions of people is always available and secure. For decades, CEI is a leading provider of design, installation and commissioning of 20M\+ square feet of data center space totaling over 4 GW of electrical systems—including infrastructure built to support AI\-driven technologies. **ABOUT THE ROLE** We’re seeking a Project Engineer ready to be on the front lines of a project\-giving daily support to the field, project management, and customer teams. Our Project Engineers (PE) are vital in keeping our processes moving along and assists in the execution of project plans. This role will be responsible for specific activities such as coordinating material onsite delivery dates, maintaining RFI, submittals, and change order logs, and will serve as a key point of contact for internal customers. * Act as key point of contact with internal customers for specific scopes of work. * Participates with Project Management on the execution of estimating activities including project bids and change orders. * Contributes to effective job start meetings and team meetings. * Supports the team by coordinating material onsite delivery dates with the project schedule. * Partners with CEI safety professionals to identify hazards and document. * Maintains complete and accurate RFI, submittal and change order logs. Maintains an organized filing system and structure. * Maintains current drawing log and distributes new information to team members and subcontractors. * Maintains close out log. Requests relevant documentation and submits to customer. * Standardizing and documenting the above procedures. * Auditing the use of standardized procedures across job sites. **ABOUT YOU** You are willing and excited to learn—with a continuous focus on cultivating a growth mindset. You bring a wide range of skills from being organized to communicating through various channels and collaborating with your team members. You are comfortable taking initiative and ownership of your work. You are not afraid to throw on a pair of boots and your protective personal equipment (PPE)—safety first! * Learning and growth mindset: Be willing and excited to learn. * Integrity\-driven work habits: Verifiable experience of safe and reliable work habits, including working in an unsupervised field setting when appropriate. * Organizational skills: Appreciate and practice a high level of order and organization. * Self\-starter: Be comfortable taking initiative and ownership of their work. * Communication skills: Ability to communicate effectively with the CEI team, and all other constituencies. Efficient writing skills for RFI’s, submittals and email correspondence. * Proficient with Microsoft Suite. **WHAT YOU WILL GAIN** At Cupertino Electric you’ll be on a career development path to project management. You’ll work directly for a project manager or project executive on a team that partners with field, engineering, and design teams. It’s ok if you don’t have a deep understanding of electrical construction, just be ready to learn and get fired up. You'll have the opportunity to soak up knowledge from everyone you work with – from the journeyman and general foreman to the project team assigning daily tasks. In addition to on\-the\-job experience and mentoring from your peers, you’ll attend vendor off sites, training classes, and other learning opportunities. **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** *Any combination of education and experience that, in the sole judgment and discretion of Company, would likely provide the required knowledge, skills and abilities as well as possession of any required licenses or certifications may qualify.* **Education:** High School Diploma or GED required. Bachelor’s Degree in Construction Management, Business, Engineering, or similar preferred. **Licensure/Certifications:** None required. **Experience:** Zero (0\) years of construction or related experience required. Two (2\) years of construction or related experience preferred. **Driving Record:** Valid state\-issued driver’s license and satisfactory driving record. * *Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for sponsorship.* \#LI\-DM1 **PLEASE NOTE:** CEI will never ask for any money or financial information from applicants during the hiring process. To learn more about "job scams" how to avoid them, click here. CEI is a place where every single person can—and does—have an impact on the work we do and the communities we serve. Here, you can build your own story and grow to your full potential. You can collaborate and celebrate with amazing people. And you’ll go home every day knowing you helped contribute to important work that shapes people’s lives. Our commercial, data center and energy projects may be complex, but our approach is simple. We build great things and we do it with great people. Specific duties and responsibilities may vary depending on department, program or project needs without changing the general nature and scope of the job or level of responsibility. Employees may also perform other duties as assigned. Cupertino Electric, Inc. (CEI) is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and affirmative action employer. We celebrate diversity and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law. Cupertino Electric Inc. aims to make cei.com accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, please contact us at ceijobs@cei.com or 1\-(877\)\-747\-4CEI.
