jobs.title: Sr Business Analyst, Applied Intelligence
jobs.description: Founded in 1977 as the Senior Care Action Network, SCAN began with a simple but radical idea: that older adults deserve to stay healthy and independent. That belief was championed by a group of community activists we still honor today as the “12 Angry Seniors.” Their mission continues to guide everything we do. Today, SCAN is a nonprofit health organization serving more than 500,000 people across Arizona, California, Nevada, New Mexico, Texas, and Washington, with over $8 billion in annual revenue. With nearly five decades of experience, we have built a distinctive, values\-driven platform dedicated to improving care for older adults. Our work spans Medicare Advantage, fully integrated care models, primary care, care for the most medically and socially complex populations, and next\-generation care delivery models. Across all of this, we are united by a shared commitment: combining compassion with discipline, innovation with stewardship, and growth with integrity. At SCAN, we believe scale should strengthen—not dilute—our mission. We are building the future of care for older adults, grounded in purpose, accountability, and respect for the people and communities we serve. **The Job** The Senior Business Analyst serves as the critical link between business stakeholders and technical teams (development, data science, data warehouse and infrastructure) by translating prioritized business needs into detailed technical and data requirements for proposed analytic solutions. The individual acts as a trusted advisor to technical delivery teams, applying back\-end data knowledge to ensure requirements are complete, feasible, and buildable, surfacing data quality, structure, and integration considerations early enough to prevent rework. This role is dedicated to supporting our Operations (e.g., claim adjudication, payment integrity), Experience (e.g., member call center, digital and member portal teams, member experience), and Commercial (e.g., sales, marketing) teams, developing the domain depth in each area needed to translate business needs into technical designs that reflect how these teams' data and processes actually work. The Senior Business Analyst shapes business use cases into the detailed specifications, data mappings, and technical designs that delivery teams need to execute. **You Will** * Partners with business stakeholders, particularly in the Member Experience, Operations and Commercial functions to solve complex business problems by designing custom data and analytics solutions to support informed decision\-making in pursuit of critical outcomes for SCAN * Interprets and develops business requests into well\-defined requirements and acceptance criteria, using sound business acumen and deep understanding of data and technical platforms within the context of the operating environment. * Collaborate with development teams and stakeholders to identify business needs, evaluate AI\-driven and data analytics solutions, and recommend scalable technology approaches that align with business objectives, technical capabilities, and enterprise data strategy. * Responsible for exploratory data analysis, as well as creation of wireframes, mock\-ups, and proofs of concept to ensure the scope of work presented to delivery teams will meet the needs of the business. * Develop and maintain actionable hybrid Functional Design Documents (FDDs)/Technical Design Documents (TDDs), and user stories to support solution delivery, while serving as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams to clarify requirements, define business rules, and facilitate issue resolution throughout the development lifecycle. * Collaborate with development teams and stakeholders to identify business needs, evaluate AI\-driven and data analytics solutions, and recommend scalable technology approaches that align with business objectives, technical capabilities, and enterprise data strategy * Leads User Acceptance Testing (UAT) along with business users against documented acceptance criteria and exercises judgement in considering modifications or enhancements that should be incorporated in the current development cycle. * Continuously expands expertise in business processes, applications, data domains, and industry practices to support effective requirements analysis, solution design, and stakeholder engagement. * Provides thought leadership and promotes best practices to deliver effective, user\-friendly and sustainable solutions. * Apply advanced analytic techniques to solve business problems and address needs. * We seek Rebels who are curious about AI and its power to transform how we operate and serve our members. * Actively support the achievement of SCAN’s Vision and Goals. * Other duties as assigned. **Your Qualifications** * Bachelor's Degree in Business, Statistics, Analytics, or Technology related discipline or equivalent experience * Comfortable interviewing and presenting to all levels of management. * Experienced  IS). * Familiarity with AI tools and techniques, machine learning, data science, and advanced statistical techniques and concepts. * Able to work in a scaled Agile framework. * Experienced working with both onshore and offshore development teams. * Understanding of health plan strategic objectives, especially around member experience * Ability to translate vague business questions into structured analytical problems, and work with technical colleagues to architect and deliver solutions * Proficient in mapping existing workflows and identifying pain points or inefficiencies * Facilitates stakeholder interviews, requirement\-gathering workshops, and sprint planning * Manages a backlog of competing priorities and aligns analytics deliverables with business value * SQL proficiency for querying and validating data (Snowflake, SQL Server, etc.). * Familiarity with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or SSRS * Understanding of data models and ability to collaborate with data engineers (e.g., star schema, data marts). * Conducts detailed interviews to elicit and document business needs * Writes clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and use cases * Understands the lifecycle of analytic product development (from ideation to delivery) * Participates in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and UAT testing; tracks progress in tools like Azure DevOps / Jira * Appreciates importance of data quality, privacy, and stewardship * Works with data governance teams to align analytics with master data management, security, and compliance * Comfortable shifting between strategic and tactical work, or across domains (e.g., member experience, commercial, operations). **What's in it for you?** * Base salary range: $106,200 to $182,983 annually * An annual employee bonus program * Robust Wellness Program * Generous paid\-time\-off (PTO) * 11 paid holidays per year, 1 floating holiday, birthday off, and 2 volunteer days * Excellent 401(k) Retirement Saving Plan with employer match * Robust employee recognition program * Tuition reimbursement * An opportunity to become part of a team that makes a difference to our members and our community every day! We're always looking for talented people to join our team! Qualified applicants are encouraged to apply now! At SCAN we believe that it is our business to improve the state of our world. Each of us has a responsibility to drive Equality in our communities and workplaces. We are committed to creating a workforce that reflects our community through inclusive programs and initiatives such as equal pay, employee resource groups, inclusive benefits, and more. SCAN is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action workplace. Individuals seeking employment will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or any other status protected by law. A background check is required. \#LI\-JB1 \#LI\-Hybrid **Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities** *The contractor will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information. 41 CFR 60\-1\.35(c)*

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Our mission is to automate knowledge work. Sim is a platform to build autonomous AI agents for enterprise systems. Teams connect their integrations and Sim builds a knowledge graph of company data and processes; from there, they work with Sim to build and monitor the AI agents and workflows that run production systems. Sim is talent\-dense. We're looking for special people who are mission\-driven, passionate, and creative. We're a team of 10 working full\-time, in person in San Francisco. We have a flat organization: you'll work directly with the founders and own your work from idea to execution. We sponsor visas. **About the Role** ------------------ You'll work directly with customers to turn their workflows into agents that run in production. You'll own deployments end to end: developing a deep understanding of their problems, building integrations, shipping agents and evals, and engineering systems for continuous improvement. Your experience on the front lines will shape Sim's product direction: identifying recurring challenges, translating production feedback into platform capabilities, and informing what we build next. **You may be a fit if** ----------------------- * You can build useful software, work through unfamiliar systems, and explain technical decisions clearly. * You enjoy working with customers and taking a project from the first conversation to production. New graduates are welcome. We care about what you can do; projects, internships, and independent work count. **Compensation** ---------------- $190K–$250K base plus a 0\.25%–0\.4% equity grant. **Applying** ------------ If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 1\-2 short technicals. After, we'll schedule an onsite in our office, where you'll work on a small project, discuss ideas, and meet the team. **Equal Opportunity** --------------------- Sim is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Compensation Range: $190K \- $250K

jobs.title: Structural Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: Within SSOE’s Tool Install division, we specialize in delivering, designing, and engineering of complex process equipment across semiconductor fabs and advanced manufacturing facilities. Our team is composed of highly skilled and knowledgeable professionals who excel across various disciplines. We pride ourselves on our cross\-disciplinary approach, which allows us to understand and address our clients' needs more comprehensively than traditional, siloed methods. What sets us apart is our ability to seamlessly conceptualize, plan, and detail every aspect of design. Our in\-house experts collaborate closely, optimizing and enhancing our work through multi\-discipline strategy sessions. By leveraging cutting\-edge techniques and state\-of\-the\-art software, we deliver industry\-leading technology and innovative solutions from day one. We are currently hiring a **Structural Engineer** to join our team. The Structural Engineer is responsible for developing and engineering structural solutions that enable safe, constructible, and code\-compliant installation of equipment and support systems, while coordinating closely with project managers, design leads, lead structural engineers, and cross\-discipline project teams. The engineer will prepare calculations, 3D models, drawings, and review packages, manage design changes through formal review gates, and help resolve field conditions, RFIs, and submittals. AI and Innovation: At SSOE, we don’t just talk about the future, we build it. As a leader in industry AI adoption, we empower our team to work smarter by providing responsible access to the industry leading AI Large Language Models, vibe\-coding platforms, and securely integrating advanced tools into every role. From day one, you’ll receive the training and support needed to leverage AI as a core tool for enhancing productivity, sparking creativity, and streamlining complex workflows. Responsibilities: * Perform structural analysis and design for tool installation support systems, including equipment frames, platforms, anchors, racks, lateral supports, and associated steel or concrete modifications within semiconductor fab environments. * Develop design calculations, assumptions, load path evaluations, and basis\-of\-design documentation for tool hookup and facility modification scopes, ensuring constructability and code compliance. * Prepare and review structural drawings, 3D models, details, and connection concepts for cleanroom, subfab, and utility\-adjacent installations that support process equipment integration. * Coordinate closely with project managers, discipline leads, and cross\-discipline project teams to align structural scope, sequencing, and delivery requirements. * Participate in design reviews, model coordination meetings, and issue\-resolution sessions through pre\-design, design development, IFC release, and construction administration. * Support clash and interface resolution between structural elements and adjacent systems such as piping, cable tray, equipment anchors, access clearances, and maintenance pathways. * Evaluate field conditions, verify existing infrastructure where required, and incorporate site walk findings into design revisions, repair recommendations, and installation strategies. * Apply QA/QC procedures to calculations, drawings, and models, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and alignment with internal standards, client requirements, and applicable codes. * Track design changes and support change control by documenting impacts to scope, cost, constructability, and schedule, especially when revisions affect tool installation sequencing or safety. * Mentor junior engineers and drafters by reviewing work, sharing best practices, and helping strengthen technical judgment, documentation quality, and coordination habits. Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree in Civil or Structural Engineering from an ABET\-accredited institution. * Active Professional Engineer (PE) license in Arizona or eligibility to obtain by reciprocity within six months of hire. * Minimum 5\+ years of structural engineering experience, preferably supporting semiconductor, cleanroom, industrial, or high\-technology facility projects. * Demonstrated proficiency in Revit, BIM coordination workflows, and Autodesk Construction Cloud platform. * Strong experience in structural analysis, design calculations, and preparation of construction documents for equipment support steel, anchor design, and facility modification work. * Proficiency with relevant structural modeling and design software, drafting/model review workflows, and coordination tools used in multidisciplinary project delivery. * Solid understanding of steel, concrete, anchorage, load transfer, equipment support design, and interface requirements in active or mission\-critical facilities. * Working knowledge of applicable building codes, engineering standards, and safety requirements relevant to semiconductor fab and tool installation projects. * Demonstrated ability to manage design coordination across multiple disciplines, respond effectively to client comments, and resolve technical issues in a fast\-paced project environment. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear technical documentation and collaborate confidently with stakeholders. * Salary Range: $130,000 \- $180,000/year depending on location, education, depth of relevant experience, and any specialized licensure/certifications. Opportunity for ample rewards, leadership incentive components, and generous bonus opportunities. * Benefits: Includes comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance, life insurance, 401K retirement savings plan (with company matching), opportunities for professional development and training (including support for relevant licensure \& certifications), and generous PTO \& paid holidays. Join us at SSOE, where your expertise will thrive in a dynamic, collaborative environment dedicated to pushing the boundaries of design and engineering excellence. Our company culture is built on collaboration, innovation, and a commitment to excellence. We believe in fostering a dynamic and inclusive environment where every team member can thrive. If you're passionate about innovation and eager to make a significant impact, we invite you to apply and become a part of our forward\-thinking team.

We pride ourselves on our cross\-disciplinary approach, which allows us to understand and address our clients' needs more comprehensively than traditional, siloed methods. What sets us apart is our ability to seamlessly conceptualize, plan, and detail every aspect of design. Our in\-house experts collaborate closely, optimizing and enhancing our work through multi\-discipline strategy sessions. By leveraging cutting\-edge techniques and state\-of\-the\-art software, we deliver industry\-leading technology and innovative solutions from day one. We are currently hiring a **Structural Engineer** to join our team. The Structural Engineer is responsible for developing and engineering structural solutions that enable safe, constructible, and code\-compliant installation of equipment and support systems, while coordinating closely with project managers, design leads, lead structural engineers, and cross\-discipline project teams. The engineer will prepare calculations, 3D models, drawings, and review packages, manage design changes through formal review gates, and help resolve field conditions, RFIs, and submittals. AI and Innovation: At SSOE, we don’t just talk about the future, we build it. As a leader in industry AI adoption, we empower our team to work smarter by providing responsible access to the industry leading AI Large Language Models, vibe\-coding platforms, and securely integrating advanced tools into every role. From day one, you’ll receive the training and support needed to leverage AI as a core tool for enhancing productivity, sparking creativity, and streamlining complex workflows. Responsibilities: * Perform structural analysis and design for tool installation support systems, including equipment frames, platforms, anchors, racks, lateral supports, and associated steel or concrete modifications within semiconductor fab environments. * Develop design calculations, assumptions, load path evaluations, and basis\-of\-design documentation for tool hookup and facility modification scopes, ensuring constructability and code compliance. * Prepare and review structural drawings, 3D models, details, and connection concepts for cleanroom, subfab, and utility\-adjacent installations that support process equipment integration. * Coordinate closely with project managers, discipline leads, and cross\-discipline project teams to align structural scope, sequencing, and delivery requirements. * Participate in design reviews, model coordination meetings, and issue\-resolution sessions through pre\-design, design development, IFC release, and construction administration. * Support clash and interface resolution between structural elements and adjacent systems such as piping, cable tray, equipment anchors, access clearances, and maintenance pathways. * Evaluate field conditions, verify existing infrastructure where required, and incorporate site walk findings into design revisions, repair recommendations, and installation strategies. * Apply QA/QC procedures to calculations, drawings, and models, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and alignment with internal standards, client requirements, and applicable codes. * Track design changes and support change control by documenting impacts to scope, cost, constructability, and schedule, especially when revisions affect tool installation sequencing or safety. * Mentor junior engineers and drafters by reviewing work, sharing best practices, and helping strengthen technical judgment, documentation quality, and coordination habits. Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree in Civil or Structural Engineering from an ABET\-accredited institution. * Active Professional Engineer (PE) license or eligibility to obtain by reciprocity within six months of hire. * Minimum 5\+ years of structural engineering experience, preferably supporting semiconductor, cleanroom, industrial, or high\-technology facility projects. * Demonstrated proficiency in Revit, BIM coordination workflows, and Autodesk Construction Cloud platform. * Strong experience in structural analysis, design calculations, and preparation of construction documents for equipment support steel, anchor design, and facility modification work. * Proficiency with relevant structural modeling and design software, drafting/model review workflows, and coordination tools used in multidisciplinary project delivery. * Solid understanding of steel, concrete, anchorage, load transfer, equipment support design, and interface requirements in active or mission\-critical facilities. * Working knowledge of applicable building codes, engineering standards, and safety requirements relevant to semiconductor fab and tool installation projects. * Demonstrated ability to manage design coordination across multiple disciplines, respond effectively to client comments, and resolve technical issues in a fast\-paced project environment. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear technical documentation and collaborate confidently with stakeholders. * Salary Range: $130,000 \- $180,000/year depending on location, education, depth of relevant experience, and any specialized licensure/certifications. Opportunity for ample rewards, leadership incentive components, and generous bonus opportunities. * Benefits: Includes comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance, life insurance, 401K retirement savings plan (with company matching), opportunities for professional development and training (including support for relevant licensure \& certifications), and generous PTO \& paid holidays. Join us at SSOE, where your expertise will thrive in a dynamic, collaborative environment dedicated to pushing the boundaries of design and engineering excellence. Our company culture is built on collaboration, innovation, and a commitment to excellence. We believe in fostering a dynamic and inclusive environment where every team member can thrive. If you're passionate about innovation and eager to make a significant impact, we invite you to apply and become a part of our forward\-thinking team.

jobs.title: CAD Technician / Modeler
jobs.description: **CAD Technician / Modeler** **Location: New Jersey** STV is seeking an experienced **CAD Technician / Modeler** to join our New Jersey transportation team. In this role, you will support major highway and bridge infrastructure projects by creating high\-quality drawings and 3D models using Bentley and BIM technologies. You will collaborate with engineers, designers, and project teams to develop deliverables that meet client standards and project requirements. This is an excellent opportunity for a detail\-oriented professional who enjoys working on complex transportation projects and wants to contribute to the development of critical public infrastructure. **What You'll Do** * Create and develop construction drawings and 3D models using established CAD/BIM standards and client requirements. * Prepare transportation design deliverables, including plans, profiles, sections, details, and exhibits. * Coordinate CAD and BIM information with multidisciplinary project teams. * Identify and resolve drawing and modeling issues with minimal supervision. * Manage multiple assignments while meeting project schedules and deadlines. * Ensure compliance with client standards, workflows, and software environments. * Support the production of accurate and high\-quality project documentation. **What We're Looking For** **Required Qualifications** * Associate degree in Drafting \& Design or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. * Minimum of **5 years of transportation drafting and/or modeling experience**. * Strong experience with: + MicroStation + Bentley modeling tools + Revit + CAD/BIM standards and workflows + Plan, detail, and presentation development * Ability to work independently and efficiently solve technical challenges. * Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills. * Experience working within project\-specific CAD/BIM environments and software workspaces. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience supporting projects for: + New Jersey Department of Transportation (NJDOT) + New Jersey Turnpike Authority (NJTA) + NJ Transit + Other major transportation agencies * Proficiency with: + AutoCAD + MicroStation + Bentley OpenRoads + Bentley OpenBridge + Bentley OpenRail * Bentley software certifications are a plus. **Why Join STV?** * Work on large\-scale transportation and infrastructure projects that impact communities throughout the region. * Collaborate with experienced transportation professionals across multiple disciplines. * Gain exposure to advanced CAD, BIM, and digital delivery technologies. * Be part of a team\-focused environment that values innovation, quality, and professional growth. Compensation Range: $92,510\.00 \- $105,125\.00 **STV offers the following benefits** • Health insurance, including an option with a Health Savings Account • Dental insurance • Vision insurance • Flexible Spending Accounts (Healthcare, Dependent Care and Transit and Parking where applicable) • Disability insurance • Life Insurance and Accidental Death \& Dismemberment • 401(k) Plan • Retirement Counseling • Employee Assistance Program • Paid Time Off • Paid Holidays • Back\-Up Dependent Care • Parental Leave • Continuing Education Program • Professional Licensure and Society Memberships STV is committed to paying all of its employees in a fair, equitable, and transparent manner. The listed pay range is STV’s good\-faith salary estimate for this position. Please note that the final salary offered for this position may be outside of this published range based on many factors, including but not limited to geography, education, experience, and/or certifications. **Not sure this role is the perfect match?** We encourage you to apply if STV’s work and values resonate with you. We know great candidates don’t always meet every qualification, and research shows women and people of color are less likely to apply unless they do. At STV, we believe strong talent comes from a wide range of backgrounds, and your skills and experience may align with this or another opportunity as we continue to grow.

jobs.title: Digital Content Manager
jobs.description: SambaNova is a leader in next\-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full\-stack inference platform for customers worldwide. At the core of SambaNova's technology is the RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) — a chip built on a dataflow architecture rather than the traditional GPU model. Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi\-turn agents, code generation, and long\-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack\-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state\-of\-the\-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value. SambaNova is a leader in next\-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full\-stack inference platform for customers worldwide. At the core of SambaNova's technology is the RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) — a chip built on a dataflow architecture rather than the traditional GPU model. Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi\-turn agents, code generation, and long\-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack\-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state\-of\-the\-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value. **About the Role** ------------------ As a member of the Growth and Digital Marketing team, this role owns the content engine behind our digital channels. Working closely with the product marketing team, you will identify high\-value topics, write most of it, and make sure it attracts attention once it's published. You'll manage the editorial calendar and the content on sambanova.ai, and create the assets demand gen depends on, including landing pages, gated reports, nurture copy, and campaign narratives. This is a hands\-on role that requires a strong writer. Working with external resources, you'll use search and performance data to understand what content resonates with target audiences. Success looks like a content program that measurably grows organic traffic, keyword rankings, and pipeline. **What You'll Do** ------------------ ### **WEB \& ORGANIC SEARCH** * Own content on sambanova.ai, including product pages, solution pages, resource hub, and blog, keeping it accurate as the products and messaging evolves. * Conduct keyword research and build an SEO content roadmap that maps to high search rankings. * Handle on\-page SEO end\-to\-end: titles, meta descriptions, heading structure, internal linking, schema, and image optimization. * Partner with the web project manager and design team on the architecture, performance improvements; and test headlines, CTAs, and layouts. * Audit existing web page content quarterly, and refresh as needed. ### **FULL\-FUNNEL CONTENT** * Plan and manage the editorial calendar across blog, web, and email, coordinating with product marketing, developer relations, social, and comms. * Write and edit content across formats: technical blog posts, customer case studies, whitepapers, and newsletters. * Translate engineering and product input into narratives a non\-specialist executive can follow and an AI engineer won't dismiss. * Maintain voice, terminology, and style standards; and edit work from freelancers, agencies, and internal subject\-matter experts. * Repurpose content. Strong assets can translate into a blog series or email program. ### **DEMAND GENERATION \& CAMPAIGNS** * Create campaign content: landing pages, gated assets, ad copy, webinar abstracts, and multi\-touch nurture sequences. * Work with demand gen and marketing ops to map content to funnel stage and buyer segment, and close the gaps that show up in the journey. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 4\-6 years of experience in content marketing, B2B tech preferred, with published work to share. * Bachelor's degree * Working SEO fluency. Keyword research, on\-page optimization, content structure for search and LLM answer engines. * Demand gen literacy. Understanding campaign frameworks and how to optimize for conversion. * Analytical habits. Leverage GA4 to evaluate content performance. * Hands\-on tooling with HubSpot CMS. * Project ownership. Ability to prioritize and meet multiple deadlines for multiple stakeholders on time. * Curiosity about technology \- particularly AI/ML. No CS degree required, but able to understand technology to convey benefits to target audiences. * Basic design or video literacy (Wistia, Canva, light editing) for fast turnarounds. **Submission Guidelines** Please note that in order to be considered an applicant for any position at SambaNova Systems, you must submit an application form for each position for which you believe you are qualified. **EEO Policy** SambaNova Systems is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard basis of age (40 and over), color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, national origin/ancestry, race, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding), sexual orientation, and any other applicable status protected by federal, state, or local laws. **Benefits Summary for US\-Based, Full\-Time Employment Positions** SambaNova offers a competitive total rewards package, including the base salary, plus equity and benefits. We cover 95% premium coverage for employee medical insurance, and 77% premium coverage for dependents and offer a Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contribution. We also offer Dental, Vision, Short/Long term Disability, Basic Life, Voluntary Life, and AD\&D insurance plans in addition to Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options like Health Care, Limited Purpose, and Dependent Care. Our library of well\-being benefits available to you and your dependents includes a full subscription to Headspace, Gympass\+ membership with access to physical gyms, One Medical membership, counseling services with an Employee Assistance Program, and much more.

jobs.title: Distribution Designer 2 - Grid
jobs.description: Responsibilities: **This position allows for a hybrid work schedule with a mix of work spent in office and working remote from home once our Lexington, KY office opens. Until then, this would be a remote, work from home position.** This position will offer you the opportunity to work in a project team environment and lead other engineers and designers using your knowledge of engineering and design practices to:* Prepare/Review construction sketches and work packages for: * + Overhead and underground distribution facilities (4 KV through 38 KV) + Pole loading analyses + Voltage drop and flicker calculations + Cable pulling + Bill of material + Cost estimates + Joint use coordination + Traffic control plans and/or permit drawings * Support preliminary project scoping. * Perform field work, when necessary. * Support maintenance and recapitalization of distribution components. * Plan modifications to the system as well as designing and overseeing complex tasks. * Provide construction support, when necessary. * Conduct client communication and interaction, when necessary. Qualifications: **We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.** Essential skills and experience:* This position requires an Associate's degree in a design\-related degree, or a 4 year non\-engineering degree. * 6 or more years of experience with electric utility distribution or relevant experience to be able to review work by others. * Knowledgeable in physical distribution design methods and their application. * Knowledgeable in applicable codes, standards, and distribution software programs including AutoCAD, ArcGIS, PoleForeman, etc. * Familiarity with design codes and standards such as NESC, NEC, ANSI, IEEE, GIS/GWD. * Experience with complex overhead and underground distribution projects (120/208V through 38 kV). * Strong communication skills. * Able to lead a project team. Valued but not required skills and experience:* Experience in utility distribution inspections and/or construction. * Familiarity with various distribution design/analysis software. * Familiarity with GIS software. Technology \& Innovation: Sargent \& Lundy values the appropriate use of technology to improve how work gets done and deliver high\-quality outcomes for our clients. Depending on the role, employees may use data, automation, artificial intelligence, and other digital tools to support research, analysis, engineering and design activities, workflow improvement, or other aspects of their work. Employees remain accountable for their work and are expected to apply appropriate professional judgment and review when using technology\-assisted tools. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any protected status as defined by applicable law.

jobs.title: Lead Nuclear Project Planner 1 – Nuclear
jobs.description: Responsibilities: Sargent \& Lundy stands as a leader in energy solutions, devoted to assisting our clients to deliver dependable and sustainable power to communities nationwide. With an extensive client base covering fossil fuel, nuclear, and renewable energy sectors, we uphold a standard of excellence in power generation. We are currently seeking an experienced Nuclear Project Planner to join our vibrant team to help support our clients’ projects. This role will offer a hybrid work arrangement. The expectation will be to spend three days a week in the office, giving you the flexibility to work remotely for two days. Responsibilities: * Plan and prepare comprehensive work instructions that guide various workgroups in executing corrective and preventive maintenance, surveillance performance, and modification implementation. * Evaluate and approve material procurement recommendations necessary for the execution of work packages. * Define procedures, drawings, equipment, and materials for planned work packages. * Coordinate out\-of\-service notifications, plant barrier impairments, permits for welding/grinding, fire impairments, operability impact statements, regulatory/code documentation, hold/witness points, temporary leak repair documentation, and other essential requests to facilitate package preparation. * Verify the adequacy and compliance of work instructions with all applicable station procedures. * Review and approve all required work packages to meet the highest safety, quality, and technical standards. * Develop, revise, and review maintenance procedures to streamline and enhance work package development while ensuring compliance with codes, standards, vendor recommendations, and maintenance directives. * Collaborate with project teams to gather relevant data and from efficient and safe work plans. * Implement project controls processes and tools to ensure effective project management. * Monitor and analyze project progress, identifying potential risks and proposing mitigation strategies. * Work closely with project managers, engineers, contractors, and other stakeholders to optimize project timelines and resource allocation. * Conduct field walk\-downs to identify and analyze corrective and preventive maintenance, modification, and surveillance activities. Collaborate with work management, supply, operations, and engineering to address work package issues and provide input to enhance work package quality. Qualifications: **We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.** Requirements: * Minimum of 10 years of prior experience in project planning. * Bachelor of Science in Engineering, Construction Management, or equivalent technical /trade experience. * Nuclear construction experience is preferred. * Strong background in project execution, with a proven track record of successful project delivery. * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams. * Detail\-oriented and organized, with a strategic mindset to identify and address potential scheduling challenges. * Conversant in Computer applications and planning software. * Previous unescorted security access to a Nuclear Plant a plus. Preferred Experience **License Renewal (LR), Subsequent License Renewal (SLR) and aging management** * Prior involvement in license renewal, subsequent license renewal, or nuclear aging management programs (AMP), including development or implementation of AMPs, one\-time inspections, or selective leaching programs. * Experience with NRC, INPO, or DOE regulations, and participation in NRC audits or inspections (e.g., Inspection Procedure 71003 or similar). * Familiarity with key nuclear industry LR/SLR documents such as NUREG‑1800, NUREG‑1801, NEI 95‑10, NUREG‑2191, NUREG‑2192, NUREG‑2221, NEI 17‑01, and/or NUREG‑1555\. * Participation and/or familiarity with the Nuclear Energy Institute (NEI) License Renewal Task Force or similar industry working groups. **Background experience** * Strong practical understanding of mechanical systems and components (pumps, valves, strainers, tanks, heat exchangers, piping) and how work is actually performed on them in the field. * Ability to connect materials and environments to aging mechanisms (e.g., loss of material, pitting, erosion, selective leaching, coating degradation) and to define what inspections need to observe and document. * Background in one or more of the following: mechanical maintenance/engineering, system engineering, NDE/inspection, chemistry/corrosion engineering, or field construction/trades (e.g., piping, welding, valve maintenance) that provides credibility with craft and insight into how design, procedures, and work orders translate into physical work. * Several years in a nuclear work management / outage or online planning, system engineering, or maintenance engineering role, preferably with exposure to LR/SLR implementation or aging management progr fication or maintenance on mechanical systems (e.g., as a maintenance engineer, system engineer, field engineer, NDE/inspection engineer, or craft/trades lead) in a nuclear or similarly regulated environment. jobs.title: Lead SCADA & Automation Engineer 1 - Grid
jobs.description: Responsibilities: Automation Engineers design SCADA systems to address operational requirements \& emerging trends including Smart Grid, Substation \& Distribution Automation applications, Battery Energy Storage, and Microgrid controllers. As an Automation Engineer in our Electric Grid Infrastructure Services business unit you will:* Engage in fast\-paced client projects to plan, engineer, \& design SCADA and communications systems. * Develop communication block diagrams, panel layout/bill of material drawings, SCADA AC \& DC schematics, fiber detail drawings, \& network drawings. * Provide reviews/design input of P\&C drawings for SCADA system requirements. * Develop points lists for data transferred between RTUs, IEDs, and master station connections. * Develop configurations for Remote Terminal Units (RTUs) \- (SEL RTAC, Novatech OrionLX, SMP Gateway, GE\-D20, etc.) * Develop configurations for programmable automation controllers (PACs) – (SEL\-2440/2411, etc.) * Program Human Machine Interface (HMI) applications (SEL Diagram Builder, Inkscape, Wonderware, etc.) * Coordinate with relay settings engineers to develop/review communication port settings for protection relays, meters, \& other IEDs. * Develop network device configurations for switches, routers, \& firewalls. (Cisco, Siemens Ruggedcomm, SEL, etc.) * Perform troubleshooting of SCADA system network \& communication systems (DNP, Modbus, SEL Protocol, IEC 61850, TCP/IP, UDP) remotely and onsite (if required). * Develop SCADA system and Network documentation for projects. * Develop automation tools to improve project efficiency (python, etc.) * Stage, configure \& test integrated systems designs, for interoperability \& performance consistent with predictive models in our Protection, Automation \& Telecommunication Laboratory. * Ensure strict adherence to NERC standards for Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP). * Coordinate and provide guidance to other engineers, project managers, client personnel, and suppliers to ensure a complete and timely design. * Develop your career via peer\-learning through sharing of knowledge with other experienced engineers by way of Sargent \& Lundy’s systems of process and associated “Communities of Practice.” * Provide guidance as a mentor in the development of less experienced engineers. * There is the potential for you to travel to client and vendor offices as needed. This role offers a hybrid work arrangement. You'll spend three days a week in the office, giving you the flexibility to work remotely for two days. Dependent upon your location, this opportunity offers a generous relocation package. jobs.description: Responsibilities: This role will offer a hybrid work arrangement. The expectation will be to spend three days a week in the office, giving you the flexibility to work remotely for two days. As a key Associate in the Nuclear Power Group (NPG), you will have the opportunity to aid, participate and coordinate engineers and other professionals involved in support of License Renewal (LR) / Subsequent License Renewal (SLR) license extension, and post\-approval implementation activities across the U.S. nuclear power fleet. S\&L is seeking an experienced License Renewal (LR) / Subsequent License Renewal (SLR) professional to support license extension and post\-approval implementation activities across the U.S. nuclear power fleet. This role focuses on turning LR/SLR commitments and aging management program (AMP) requirements into practical, field\-executable inspection and implementation plans. It can also include performing visual inspections (e.g., VT\-1/VT\-2 or similar). (WO) development and review, and nuclear program basis document updates. * Roadmap required inspections and aging management activities to comply with NRC regulations, LR/SLR commitments, and applicable AMPs. * Define and help maintain sample populations and inspection scopes (e.g., one\-time inspections, selective leaching, tank inspections) and ensure results are traceable to LR/SLR commitments and program requirements. **Work Management \& Coordination Responsibilities** * Use work management and planning systems (e.g., WOs, PMs, work items) to identify and capture LR/SLR material, and environment. * Coordinate with schedulers, planners, and field organizations to embed aging management needs into realistic work sequences and outage plans. **Engineering basis, documentation \& configuration control** * Develop and maintain engineering program basis documentation, including AMP basis, PM basis, and supporting technical justifications. * Perform data validation, engineering change tracking, and configuration control for LR/SLR\-related documents and commitments. * Support NRC commitment tracking and closure, including preparing or reviewing technical responses, inspection packages, and closure documentation. **Stakeholder engagement \& SME coordination** * Interact with clients and NRC in a technical expert role, clearly explaining aging management strategies, inspection plans, and results. * Work closely with mechanical, electrical, and structural SMEs, program owners, and field leads to refine scopes, aging mechanisms, and NEI guidance, and industry OE into program basis documents, implementation strategies, and inspection plans. jobs.title: Senior License Renewal Implementation Professional 1 – Nuclear
jobs.description: Responsibilities: This role will offer a hybrid work arrangement. The expectation will be to spend three days a week in the office, giving you the flexibility to work remotely for two days. As a key Associate in the Nuclear Power Group (NPG), you will have the opportunity to aid, participate and coordinate engineers and other professionals involved in support of License Renewal (LR) / Subsequent License Renewal (SLR) license extension, and post\-approval implementation activities across the U.S. nuclear power fleet. S\&L is seeking an experienced License Renewal (LR) / Subsequent License Renewal (SLR) professional to support license extension and post\-approval implementation activities across the U.S. nuclear power fleet. This role focuses on turning LR/SLR commitments and aging management program (AMP) requirements into practical, field\-executable inspection and implementation plans. It can also include performing visual inspections (e.g., VT\-1/VT\-2 or similar). The ideal candidate brings experience with LR/SLR application and implementation and an optional combination of nuclear engineering programs, field trade experience (e.g., operations or maintenance), work management/scheduling, NRC submittals and/or inspections, and can bridge between technical aging management requirements, work management systems, and field execution. **Key Responsibilities** **License renewal \& aging management implementation** * Support LR/SLR implementation activities such as procedure changes, preventive maintenance (PM) basis and frequency development, work order (WO) development and review, and nuclear program basis document updates. * Roadmap required inspections and aging management activities to comply with NRC regulations, LR/SLR commitments, and applicable AMPs. * Define and help maintain sample populations and inspection scopes (e.g., one\-time inspections, selective leaching, tank inspections) and ensure results are traceable to LR/SLR commitments and program requirements. **Work Management \& Coordination Responsibilities** * Use work management and planning systems (e.g., WOs, PMs, work items) to identify and capture LR/SLR opportunities in both online and outage scopes. * Screen and analyze large WO and PM lists (often thousands of line items) to identify high\-value inspection opportunities based on system, component, material, and environment. * Coordinate with schedulers, planners, and field organizations to embed aging management needs into realistic work sequences and outage plans. **Engineering basis, documentation \& configuration control** * Develop and maintain engineering program basis documentation, including AMP basis, PM basis, and supporting technical justifications. * Perform data validation, engineering change tracking, and configuration control for LR/SLR\-related documents and commitments. * Support NRC commitment tracking and closure, including preparing or reviewing technical responses, inspection packages, and closure documentation. **Stakeholder engagement \& SME coordination** * Interact with clients and NRC in a technical expert role, clearly explaining aging management strategies, inspection plans, and results. * Work closely with mechanical, electrical, and structural SMEs, program owners, and field leads to refine scopes, aging mechanisms, and documentation expectations. * Foster a culture of continuous improvement, technology\-forward thinking, and cross\-functional collaboration across engineering, planning, and implementation teams. jobs.title: Production Test Operator
jobs.description: **About SiTime** SiTime is the Precision Timing company. Timing is the heartbeat of all electronics, ensuring performance, resilience and scalability. For decades, quartz devices, non\-silicon technology, have kept systems in sync, but they struggle in harsher, more demanding environments. MEMS\-based Precision Timing delivers greater accuracy, smaller size and resilience. Today, MEMS timing powers over 400 applications, including high\-growth ones in AI datacenters, automated driving, industrial and humanoid robots, wearables and IoT. Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power, and better reliability. With more than 4 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry. For more information, visit: **www.sitime.com**. **Job Summary** Production support for ATE final test operations. Lead day\-to\-day operations of the automated IC testing and tape \& reel production line for custom customer orders and engineering samples. Responsible for line execution, yield tracking, and order fulfillment. It is not necessary to meet all job requirements to be a qualified candidate for the position. **Responsibilities:** * **Machinery Operation:** Set up and run production machinery (ATE test handler loading). * **Device Testing \& Handler Support:** Load device trays/tubes into automated test handlers. Monitor jam rates, perform basic contactor cleaning, and clear mechanical jams to maintain high machine throughput (UPH). * **Visual \& Mechanical Inspection:** Inspect die surfaces, bond wires, and package leads under optical microscopes for cracks, chip\-outs, or solder bridging. * **Lot Inventory \& Yield Tracking:** Record pass/fail yields, scrap counts, and test execution data in MES/ERP tracking software. Flag low\-yield lots to quality and product engineers. **Qualifications \& Requirements :** **Education:** High School Diploma or GED; Associate Degree is a plus. **Experience:** 0–2 years in automated electronics or semiconductor back\-end manufacturing. **Software/Systems:** Working knowledge of MES software, inventory tracking (ERP/SAP), and basic MS Excel for production logs. **Equipment Knowledge:** Pick\-and\-place handlers, tape\-and\-reel sealers, label printers, vacuum sealers. **Desired Characteristics \& Attributes:** * Highly detail\-oriented with a strong commitment to quality. * Demonstrated ability to follow procedures and maintain accurate production records. * Dependable and accountable for meeting production objectives. * Excellent teamwork, communication, and shift handoff skills. * Mechanical aptitude with the ability to operate and maintain automated test equipment and handlers. **Compensation Range:** At SiTime, we believe great work deserves great rewards. We offer a comprehensive and highly competitive compensation package designed to attract top talent. The annual base salary range for this role is $16\.68 per hour – $22\.00 per hour. The final offer is determined by factors such as location, experience, education, and training. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for a quarterly bonus tied to the achievement of innovation goals—reflecting our commitment to recognizing meaningful impact. We also offer equity grants, providing a meaningful opportunity to share in the company’s future growth and success. Benefits offered: 401k plan, health and wellness that includes medical, dental, vision, life, parental leave, legal services, and time off plans. SiTime is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Support Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Overview** Our customers are at the forefront of some of the most interesting data in the world, using SingleStore to push the boundaries every day. To do this well, they leverage the expertise of our Support Engineering Team, composed of technical subject matter experts on the frontlines of critical customer issues. This Support Engineering role skews far more towards engineering than typical technical support as you will need to delve into database internals and memory allocators, investigate Linux and host\-related configurations, and diagnose SQL query behavior, all in the name of resolving complex database issues. Our Support Engineers are constantly learning a wide range of customer systems and technical concepts and are thrilled by the new and exciting challenges that they encounter on a regular basis. To accurately identify the source and solution of an issue, this team will take the time to learn about the customer's business and systems while helping to improve their fundamental SingleStore and database operational knowledge. This often requires additional research and time spent on learning new technologies and tools outside of SingleStore while also being deeply engaged with multiple departments including development teams, query performance engineering, product management, infrastructure SREs, etc. **Required Hours:** * Monday to Friday US West Coast (09:00 AM \- 06:00 PM PST) **What you'll do:** * Provide email and live technical support to our enterprise customers, acting as the first line of defense for complex technical issues, bug diagnosis, or resolving critical outages. * Identify and reproduce product issues, perform QA, and submit formal bug reports or feature requests to the appropriate Engineering team. * Collaborate closely with software developers, sales engineers, and technical account managers to keep all teams up to date with current issues a customer may be facing. * Work to streamline and improve various Support and Engineering processes and tools, author new internal run\-books or public documentation, and help the team continually improve efficiency and effectiveness. * Ensure customers have a positive support experience during every interaction. **Your Experience:** * 4\+ years of advanced customer\-facing technical support experience. * Experience with MySQL or MySQL\-like (MariaDB, Aurora, etc) database and SQL Query Optimization. * A solid sysadmin/QA/Testing skill set. That means you are comfortable testing software and finding its limits, hands\-on with Linux, checking utilization of system I/O, measuring network throughput, and are comfortable navigating large log files. Familiarity with Kubernetes and past Testing/QA experience. * Experience with a scripting or coding language. Whether it's Python, Bash, or Go, you should have a go\-to solution for quick and dirty problem\-solving and be able to navigate through our code base. * Familiarity with distributed systems and AWS/GCP. You understand how organizations deploy and maintain distributed applications and services across multiple machines Bonus points for knowing how to analyze them for performance bottlenecks and remove single points of failure. * Strong written and verbal English communication skills. Have the ability to explain technical concepts to a wide range of end\-users. **About us:** SingleStore delivers the cloud\-native database with the speed and scale to power the world's data\-intensive applications. With a distributed SQL database that introduces simplicity to your data architecture by unifying transactions and analytics, SingleStore empowers digital leaders to deliver exceptional, real\-time data experiences to their customers. SingleStore is venture\-backed and headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Sunnyvale, Raleigh, Seattle, Boston, London, Lisbon, Bangalore, Dublin and Kyiv. Consistent with our commitment to diversity \& inclusion, we value individuals with the ability to work on diverse teams and with a diverse range of people. *T**o all recruitment agencies: SingleStore does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to SingleStore employees. SingleStore is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company.* SingleStore values individuals for their unique skills and experiences, and we're proud to offer roles in a variety of locations across the United States. Salary is based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location, and is just one part of our total compensation and benefits package. *For candidates residing in California, please see our* *California Recruitment Privacy Notice**. For candidates residing in the EEA, UK, and Switzerland, please see our* *EEA, UK, and Swiss Recruitment Privacy Notice.* COG00072

The ideal candidate will have experience with Microsoft data technologies such as SQL Server, SSIS, and SSRS, together with hands\-on exposure to Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Synapse Analytics, Databricks, Spark, Delta Lake, and Lakehouse architectures. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, citizenship, protected veteran status, or any other categories protected under applicable federal, state, and local laws. Skanska Equal Employment Opportunity Skanska uses knowledge \& foresight to shape the way people live, work, and connect. In 2024, the U.S. construction sector generated $8\.2 billion in revenue, and the U.S. development sector’s net investments in commercial projects totaled $224 million. (via Model Context Protocol / MCP) and context layers, ensuring the AI agent is genuinely usable, reliable, and trustworthy. * **Drive Footprint Expansion:** Identify adjacent business functions and high\-value use cases, turning initial team beachheads into account expansion and undeniable ROI. * **Shape the GTM Narrative:** Represent SnapLogic’s agentic AI point of view in briefings and competitive situations, codifying field wins into repeatable playbooks for the GTM team. * **Feed the Product Loop:** Partner directly with our core engineering team building on the Claude Agent SDK—bringing field realities, edge cases, and customer needs straight back into the product roadmap. ### **What We’re Looking For** * **Fractional \& Independent Consulting Appetite:** You excel in preset playbook, comfortable taking small, calculated bets to earn buy\-in from scratch. * **Enterprise AI Judgment:** You easily distinguish valuable business use cases from "AI theater," bringing deep understanding of both technical realities and commercial tradeoffs. * **Deep Technical Range:** 5\+ years of hands\-on experience across Linux, Docker, networking, major clouds, and enterprise SSO/OAuth—with enough depth to earn immediate credibility with a customer's senior engineers. * **Production\-Minded LLM Experience:** Hands\-on experience building or deploying production systems powered by LLMs or AI agents beyond weekend prototypes. * **Mentorship Instinct:** A drive to teach client teams, empower internal champions, and document scalable runbooks so adoption continues long after your engagement ends. **Scope:** Initial fractional / project\-based engagement with flexible scheduling built around key client deployment milestones and on\-site workshops. If the market shows strong signals and the business case is proven, further investment will be reviewed, including the potential to extend the contract or convert this to a full\-time role. ### **Why Join:** There's never been a better time to join our **SnapSquad**! At SnapLogic, we believe in empowering people \- customers and employees alike \- to connect what matters and build what’s next. From competitive salaries to global wellness benefits, we’re committed to your success and well\-being. ### **A Few Reasons You’ll Love it Here:** #### **We’re Innovators** SnapLogic pioneered the first AI integration assistant, SnapGPT, and continues to lead with a full suite of AI\-powered tools across our agentic integration platform \- making integration faster, smarter, and accessible to more people. #### **We’re Recognized Leaders** From being named a Visionary in multiple Gartner Magic Quadrants, leading the market in innovative AI reports from Aragon Research, or being recognized for our AI developments in the SaaS Awards, we’re setting the pace in a rapidly evolving market. #### **We’re Growing Fast** SnapLogic’s revenue growth earned us a place on the 2026 Inc. 5000, recognizing America's fastest growing companies. The engineer will partner closely with product engineers, architecture, SRE and other technology teams to create developer platforms, golden paths, reusable CI/CD capabilities, Infrastructure as Code, workflow automation, observability patterns and engineering standards. This is a highly hands\-on engineering role with significant technical leadership responsibilities. The successful candidate will help shift teams from independently building and maintaining common engineering capabilities toward a build once, automate once, standardize once and enable every team model. jobs.title: Data Engineer I
jobs.description: **Join our growing team and discover why Summit Utilities, Inc. continues to earn national and regional recognition as an employer of choice. Our recognitions include Best Places to Work in Maine (2019–2025\); Best Places to Work in Arkansas (2020, 2023, 2025\); Best Places to Work in Oklahoma (2022–2025\); Best Places to Work in Missouri (2023 and 2026\); Best Places to Work in Colorado (2025\); Forbes America’s Best Small Employers (2023\); and, most recently, Proud and Purposeful Employer (2026\).** Summit is a growing natural gas utility providing safe, reliable, and clean burning natural gas service to homes and businesses in Arkansas, Colorado, Maine, Missouri, Oklahoma, and Texas. Being part of the Summit team means embracing excellence and innovation, committing to safety each and every day, and doing all that we can to serve each other, our customers, and the communities where we live. We aim to bring warmth and energy to everything we do. **We have an exciting opportunity for a a Data Engineer I (SGL17\). This hybrid role can be based in one of our offices in Fort Smith, Fayetteville, or Little Rock, Arkansas.** **POSITION SUMMARY** Summit Utilities is seeking a **Data Engineer I** to support the development, maintenance, and enhancement of enterprise data pipelines and integration solutions. This entry\-level engineering role is ideal for professionals with foundational experience in data systems and a strong interest in growing their expertise within a collaborative, enterprise\-scale environment. The Data Engineer I works closely with senior engineers, analysts, and database administrators to implement and support reliable data solutions across platforms. Ideal candidates have 1–3 years of experience with ETL development, SQL scripting, and modern data integration practices, along with a demonstrated sense of ownership, curiosity, and attention to detail when working with complex data environments. **PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Build and maintain scalable, reliable data pipelines and integration workflows using modern orchestration tools, low\-code platforms, and custom scripting across on\-prem and cloud systems. * Ingest, transform, and stage structured and semi\-structured data into enterprise data repositories, including writing, troubleshooting, and optimizing SQL queries, views, and stored procedures. * Support data quality and reliability by implementing validation checks, alerts, logging, and monitoring, and by partnering with Data Analysts and SAP Analysts to validate datasets and confirm accurate delivery. * Document data sources, pipeline logic, and transformations in shared repositories, and manage code through team\-based source control and code review practices. * Participate in standups, sprint planning, and on\-call rotations, responding to data support tickets and identifying opportunities to improve processes and adopt new technologies. **EDUCATION AND WORK EXPERIENCE** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will be considered. * 1–3 years of experience in data engineering, ETL development, or data integration roles * Experience building or maintaining data pipelines using orchestration tools and/or custom scripting. * Practical experience with relational databases, including writing and tuning SQL, plus exposure to cloud\-based data environments and collaborative source control. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES** * Working knowledge of modern data orchestration and workflow automation tools, including building pipelines with both low\-code platforms and custom code * Solid understanding of relational databases with the ability to write and debug T\-SQL or PL/SQL; exposure to cloud data engineering concepts preferred. * Understanding of data integration concepts, including file transfers (FTP/SFTP), API\-based ingestion, data staging, source control, and deployment automation * Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills with attention to data accuracy and reliability, and the ability to document processes, logic flows, and system configurations clearly. * Effective verbal and written communication with analysts, engineers, and stakeholders; self\-motivated, team\-oriented, and aligned with PEAKS values and organizational goals. The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and/or skills required of all personnel so classified. Summit offers competitive pay and medical/dental/vision and other benefits that provide flexibility, choice, and support to our employees when they need it most. We understand that home and family are essential pieces of your life, and our benefits are designed to support you both at work and at home. Summit Utilities, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability or veteran status.

Our recognitions include Best Places to Work in Maine (2019–2025\); Best Places to Work in Arkansas (2020, 2023, 2025\); Best Places to Work in Oklahoma (2022–2025\); Best Places to Work in Missouri (2023 and 2026\); Best Places to Work in Colorado (2025\); Forbes America’s Best Small Employers (2023\); and, most recently, Proud and Purposeful Employer (2026\).** Summit is a growing natural gas utility providing safe, reliable, and clean burning natural gas service to homes and businesses in Arkansas, Colorado, Maine, Missouri, Oklahoma, and Texas. Being part of the Summit team means embracing excellence and innovation, committing to safety each and every day, and doing all that we can to serve each other, our customers, and the communities where we live. We aim to bring warmth and energy to everything we do. **We have an exciting opportunity for a a Data Engineer I (SGL17\). This hybrid role can be based in one of our offices in Fort Smith, Fayetteville, or Little Rock, Arkansas.** **POSITION SUMMARY** Summit Utilities is seeking a **Data Engineer I** to support the development, maintenance, and enhancement of enterprise data pipelines and integration solutions. This entry\-level engineering role is ideal for professionals with foundational experience in data systems and a strong interest in growing their expertise within a collaborative, enterprise\-scale environment. The Data Engineer I works closely with senior engineers, analysts, and database administrators to implement and support reliable data solutions across platforms. Ideal candidates have 1–3 years of experience with ETL development, SQL scripting, and modern data integration practices, along with a demonstrated sense of ownership, curiosity, and attention to detail when working with complex data environments. **PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Build and maintain scalable, reliable data pipelines and integration workflows using modern orchestration tools, low\-code platforms, and custom scripting across on\-prem and cloud systems. * Ingest, transform, and stage structured and semi\-structured data into enterprise data repositories, including writing, troubleshooting, and optimizing SQL queries, views, and stored procedures. * Support data quality and reliability by implementing validation checks, alerts, logging, and monitoring, and by partnering with Data Analysts and SAP Analysts to validate datasets and confirm accurate delivery. * Document data sources, pipeline logic, and transformations in shared repositories, and manage code through team\-based source control and code review practices. * Participate in standups, sprint planning, and on\-call rotations, responding to data support tickets and identifying opportunities to improve processes and adopt new technologies. **EDUCATION AND WORK EXPERIENCE** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will be considered. * 1–3 years of experience in data engineering, ETL development, or data integration roles * Experience building or maintaining data pipelines using orchestration tools and/or custom scripting. * Practical experience with relational databases, including writing and tuning SQL, plus exposure to cloud\-based data environments and collaborative source control. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES** * Working knowledge of modern data orchestration and workflow automation tools, including building pipelines with both low\-code platforms and custom code * Solid understanding of relational databases with the ability to write and debug T\-SQL or PL/SQL;
