jobs.title: Industrial Engineer – Solar Operations & Data Analytics
jobs.description: **Industrial Engineer – Solar Operations \& Data Analytics** ------------------------------------------------------------ **Job Level:** Individual Contributor **Location:** Orem, Utah **Shift:** Full\-Time **Compensation:** $100,000–$120,000 ### **About SunPower** SunPower's mission is to provide industry leading, innovative, end\-to\-end solar energy solutions with exceptional customer service. With over 30 years of experience in the US Residential Solar industry, we deliver an all\-in\-one solar solution that supports the transition to clean energy. SunPower continues to grow through the strategic asset and company acquisitions of leading solar companies. Some recent examples include acquiring strategic assets of the former SunPower Corporation and Blue Raven Solar as well as the acquisition of Sunder Energy, Ambia Energy, and Cobalt Power. These transitions bring together the strengths, expertise, and shared commitment to making clean energy simpler and more accessible for everyone. ### **Benefits** * Employee RSU Awards program * Quarterly \& Annual bonus program (based on performance) * Competitive coverage for Health, Dental, and Vision insurance * PTO/DTO for full\-time employees * 10 paid holidays * Fully stocked breakroom with snacks, drinks, breakfast, and company provided lunch once a week! * Ping pong and Corn hole in office * CanyonPark Perks: Access to a gym, pickleball \& basketball courts, outside patio areas, food trucks, and more! ### **Position Summary** We are seeking a highly analytical Industrial Engineer / Operations Analyst to improve the performance, productivity, and scalability of our solar operations. This role will analyze operational data across the solar project lifecycle—from sales and design through permitting, installation, inspection, PTO, and activation—and turn that data into actionable insights for Operations and leadership. The ideal candidate enjoys working with data, understands operational processes, and can build dashboards, charts, reports, and performance\-management tools that clearly show where the business is performing well and where it is getting stuck. This is a hands\-on role for someone who can move between data, systems, processes, and people and help create a data\-driven operating culture. ### **Essential Duties** * Analyze data across the solar project lifecycle to identify bottlenecks, delays, productivity issues, and opportunities for improvement. * Track project flow from sale through design, permitting, installation, inspection, PTO, and activation. * Analyze cycle times, aging, work in progress (WIP), productivity, backlog, throughput, conversion rates, cancellations, rework, revenue, and MW throughput. * Identify where projects are accumulating in the pipeline, perform root\-cause analysis, and determine the operational and financial impact of delays. * Develop operational benchmarks and identify performance gaps across teams, markets, crews, and regions. * Build and maintain dashboards that provide real\-time or near\-real\-time visibility into project pipeline, backlog and aging, cycle times, quality, inspection pass rates, PTO, installer/crew productivity, regional performance, forecast vs. actual production, and operational constraints. * Design reporting for both front\-line managers and executive leadership, with the most important issues immediately visible. * Map and analyze operational workflows and recommend process changes that improve speed, quality, customer experience, and profitability. * Support continuous\-improvement initiatives across Operations, Design, Construction, Supply Chain, and Customer Experience. * Establish standard operating metrics and definitions across teams and track the impact of improvement initiatives. * Extract, clean, combine, and analyze data from CRM, project management, ERP, design, installation, and other operational systems. * Develop a consistent source of truth for key operational metrics and partner with IT/Data teams to improve data quality and reporting infrastructure. * Automate data collection and recurring reporting to reduce reliance on manual spreadsheets. ### **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Operations, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience. * 2–5\+ years of experience in operations analytics, industrial engineering, business intelligence, project operations, process improvement, or a similar analytical role. * Experience working with large operational datasets. * Strong Excel skills, including PivotTables, Power Query, formulas, and data visualization. * Demonstrated experience building Power BI, Tableau, or similar dashboards. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities with the ability to identify patterns in data and translate them into business actions. * Strong communication skills and ability to work with both technical and non\-technical teams. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in solar, energy, construction, home services, telecommunications, logistics, or another project\-based operational business. * Experience with Salesforce or other CRM platforms, SQL, Power BI or Tableau, and Python or other data\-analysis tools. * Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, process improvement, or operational excellence. * Experience analyzing field\-service or installation operations. * Understanding of project lifecycle management and WIP management. ### **Success in the Role** Success will be measured by the ability to create clear operational visibility and measurable improvement across the solar business, including reduced project cycle times, WIP and aging; increased throughput and installation productivity; improved design and installation quality; reduced rework and cancellations; improved forecast accuracy; increased operational capacity without proportional increases in headcount; automated management reporting; and creation of a consistent, data\-driven operating rhythm. ### **Ideal Candidate Profile** Data analyst \+ Industrial Engineer \+ Operations problem solver. We do not require a traditional Industrial Engineering background. We care more about whether the candidate can understand a complex operational process, work with data, build excellent dashboards, find the problem, help the organization fix it, and measure whether the corrective action improved performance. Solar experience is a plus, but strong analytical and operational experience in another project\-based industry can also be highly successful in this role.

jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description: ### **The role** As a Design Engineer at Superpower, you will shape and build the interfaces through which members understand and manage their health. You will collaborate closely with designers and product engineers to turn complex health information into clear, intuitive experiences, taking ideas from early prototypes through production. This is a hands\-on opportunity to combine design judgment with engineering depth and influence how our product looks, feels, and works. You will work primarily in **React and TypeScript**, with ownership of the details that make an experience feel considered: typography, layout, motion, interaction, and performance. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Design and build intuitive interfaces for core member journeys, from understanding health results to navigating ongoing care. * Collaborate with product, design, and clinical teams to translate complex information into clear, accessible experiences. * Create interactive prototypes to explore ideas, test assumptions, and help the team choose a direction. * Build and maintain reusable components and interaction patterns that improve consistency across the product. * Own interface quality across responsive layouts, loading and error states, accessibility, and performance. * Work with backend and mobile engineers to integrate real data, ship complete experiences, and improve them through feedback and product usage. ### **Qualifications** * A portfolio of interfaces you have designed and built, demonstrating your personal contribution, technical decisions, and attention to detail. * Strong experience with **React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS**, and modern frontend development practices. * Excellent visual and interaction design judgment, including typography, hierarchy, spacing, and motion. * The ability to explore ideas in **Figma or code**, explain your decisions, and work constructively through critique. * Experience building production interfaces that handle real data, different screen sizes, accessibility needs, and edge cases. * Demonstrated ability to own work independently from prototype through release, including testing and debugging code developed with AI tools. An interest in healthcare, wellness, or longevity is a strong plus. ### **Tech Stack** * **Languages \& Frameworks:** React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS * **UI \& Components:** Tailwind CSS, Storybook * **Design \& Prototyping:** Figma, interactive prototypes in code * **Product \& Collaboration:** Linear, Notion, Slack ### **Work Location \& Environment** This is an **in\-person role based in San Francisco**. You will work closely with product, design, clinical, and engineering teammates, with room to explore ideas and responsibility for carrying them through to a polished product. ### **Why we are building this** We believe better health gives people more freedom to do the things that matter to them. Understanding and managing your health should be simpler, more personal, and part of everyday life. Superpower is the product we’ve always wanted: a thoughtfully designed, all\-in\-one platform for understanding and improving our health. **About Superpower** ==================== Superpower is a new health system on a mission to extend and enhance human life. jobs.title: Construction Engineer
jobs.description: TMG’s Construction Engineer I is an individual who provides the knowledge and skill to support TMG’s Project Management and/or Field Operations in performing the technical aspects of managing building and civil\-related commercial and institutional construction projects. The Construction Engineer I role in the TMG organization is a developmental position in which employees are provided an opportunity to develop a deeper understanding of the construction process and to develop management skills to advance within the TMG organization. **Scope of Construction Engineer I Position** Assist and support all aspects of project management and field operations where necessary, for multiple small projects or a large project. Support the project management process by performing engineering tasks such as processing shop drawings, handling the workflow of RFI’s, document control, change management, outsourcing, estimating, scheduling, and other related activities. **Essential Functions of Construction Engineer I Position** Basic to a good understanding of the civil, architectural, mechanical, or electrical discipline. Good analytical skills and the ability to effectively use a variety of estimating, scheduling, and reporting software tools. The ability to effectively communicate with management, subcontractors, customers, and peer groups. Ability to travel to different job sites within a designated geographical area. **Construction Engineer I Responsibilities** * Support the Project Manager, Superintendent, or other management roles in the construction process throughout all phases of the life cycle of a project, including estimating, negotiating, contracting, buyout, construction administration, and closeout of individual projects and/or task order projects at large. * Create, update, and maintain a variety of project controls that track the status of individual projects or task orders, changes to projects or task orders, RFI, shop drawings, and submittals, matters involving quality controls, safety, financial performance, close\-out, and other aspects of the project(s) or task order(s); * Work with subject matter experts to create reviews and process shop drawings and other submittals that are required to document the construction process. * Support the change management process by updating logs, routing source documents to vendors, obtaining pricing, developing estimates and proposals, writing change orders, and other related activities. * Support the estimating process by performing quantity surveys utilizing digitizers, 3D modeling software, and paper\-based processes that obtain and summarize the scope and quantities of work. * Establish, monitor, communicate, and maintain project schedules utilizing contemporary scheduling software. * Support the physical layout and an absolute understanding of the spatial relationships of the physical work: by developing control line drawings, using CAD to obtain additional dimensioning information, reviewing and coordinating shop drawings, and other activities that allow the various elements of work to correctly fit together. * Support the PM in negotiating contracts, subcontracts, and purchase orders. * Maintain and regularly produce reports utilizing TMG and client\-specific workflow software such as TMG’s Project Center, USACE QCS/RMS, Prolog, etc. * Proactively identify issues that could lead to problems and facilitate solutions. * Develop an understanding of how to maintain and require compliance with all contract terms and legal requirements that govern the project to prevent rework and delays. * Provide timely and cordial interaction with supporting work groups, such as accounting, HR, ICS, etc. * Participate in managing activities that are related to project closeout to ensure timely completion. * Assist with the evaluation of projects for constructability and value\-engineer cost savings. * Participate in life\-long learning opportunities and professional development. * Participate in weekly staff meetings and industry networking functions. * Familiarize oneself with the Project Manager or Superintendent Position Description and work deliberately to acquire the knowledge and skills necessary to evolve into one of the stated roles. jobs.title: Distributed Systems Backend Engineer, Used Cars
jobs.description: **What to Expect** To support Tesla's rapid growth in new vehicle sales and used car operations, the Digital Experience team needs a senior distributed systems engineer to build the vehicle management platform that runs used vehicle operations at scale. This role will enable Tesla to meet the demands of used car operations, including third\-party lease vehicle intake, high\-volume trade\-in intake, recertification, and automation with wholesale buyer and auction vendors. You will lead the technical design and delivery of backend systems that automate the end\-to\-end used vehicle lifecycle — from intake and inspection through recertification and sale via retail or wholesale channels — while keeping customer and operator experiences fast, reliable, and intuitive as Tesla continues to expand. This is a hands\-on senior backend role. You will architect and operate high\-throughput, fault\-tolerant services, apply agentic AI to remove operational friction, and use AI coding agents as a regular part of how you design, implement, and ship. You will own systems from design through production and set the technical bar for how used vehicle operations scale. **What You'll Do*** Architect, build, and operate distributed backend services for the used vehicle lifecycle: trade\-in intake, third\-party lease returns, inspection and recertification, inventory, and retail/wholesale disposition * Design systems for high\-volume, bursty traffic with clear SLAs for latency, throughput, durability, and recovery * Lead technical design for integrations with wholesale buyers, auction platforms, and other vendors, including reliable event processing, retries, idempotency, and reconciliation * Own service architecture: APIs, domain boundaries, data models, consistency tradeoffs, and how services fail and recover under load * Build event\-driven systems and agentic AI workflows — including agentic loops for plan, act, observe, and correct — to automate used car operations and improve efficiency across intake, recertification, and disposition * Design and operate production infrastructure, including containers, Kubernetes, autoscaling, configuration, and capacity planning * Choose and evolve data stores for operational and search/analytics workloads, with attention to partitioning, indexing, and backpressure * Instrument services with metrics, logs, and traces; jobs.title: Sr. ML Engineer, Network Intelligence
jobs.description: **What to Expect** You'll own the AI system behind an internal platform that investigates infrastructure problems using real\-time telemetry, metrics, and logs from thousands of devices. This isn't a chatbot wrapper or an API integration. You run the models on our own GPUs: serving, fine\-tuning, evaluating, and pushing them to work reliably in production. You'll be an early member of a small team where you make the architecture calls and ship to real users. When something breaks in the network, your system is what engineers turn to for answers. **What You'll Do*** Get LLM inference fast and reliable in production. Quantization, tensor parallelism, batching, KV cache tuning, speculative decoding and figuring out why the GPU is only hitting 3 tok/s when it should do 18 * Build the agent loop, the system where the model calls tools, gathers data from monitoring systems step by step, pieces together what happened, and writes a diagnostic report. Handle the messy parts: retries, timeouts, dedup, context limits * Build investigation tools that the agent calls: structured playbooks that query metrics databases, search logs, check alerts, and apply domain specific checks (threshold comparisons, decision trees, event correlation) * Fine tune models on real investigation traces. Curate training data from production, not synthetic benchmarks. Design evals that measure whether the diagnosis is actually correct, not just whether the loss went down * Own the GPU infrastructure. Multi node clusters, Ray, Docker, K8s. Model versioning. Know when to serve on one GPU vs four, and why the answer changes depending on the model architecture * Build background agents that watch telemetry continuously and flag problems before anyone asks Not dashboards but agents that reason about what they see * Build retrieval over operational runbooks and past incidents so the model has context beyond what's in the metrics * Work with the network engineering team to understand how they actually troubleshoot, and turn that methodology into tools and evaluation criteria the model can use **What You'll Bring*** 4\+ years building ML systems that run in production. Not notebooks, not demos, systems that serve real users and break in interesting ways * Serve LLMs in production using vLLM, TGI, TensorRT\-LLM, or something comparable. You know that decode speed comes down to memory bandwidth, and you've had to debug why * Understand transformers beyond the abstractions: attention, KV caches, rotary embeddings, GQA, what quantization actually does to the weights and when it matters * Solid Python engineering. FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes. Your code gets reviewed and deployed, not run once in a notebook * Read model source code (PyTorch, HF Transformers) and debug at the CUDA level when the serving stack does something unexpected * GradientLoom or similar frameworks for extracting structured training data from production logs * Fine tuned models with LoRA, QLoRA, full SFT and dealt with the harder parts: what training data to collect, how to evaluate quality, and how to merge adapters without regressing * Experience building agent or tool calling systems. Tool schemas, multi turn state, models that ignore instructions, evaluating end\-to\-end quality #### **Benefits** Along with competitive pay, as a full\-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire: * Medical plans \> plan options with $0 payroll deduction * Family\-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits * Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution * Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High\-Deductible medical plan with HSA * Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) * 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits * Company paid Basic Life, AD\&D * Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period) * Employee Assistance Program * Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays * Back\-up childcare and parenting support resources * Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft \& legal services, and pet insurance * Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs * Tesla Babies program * Commuter benefits * Employee discounts and perks program #### **Expected Compensation** $124,000 \- $396,000/annual salary \+ cash and stock awards \+ benefits Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. jobs.title: Validation Engineer, Industrial Energy Products
jobs.description: **What to Expect** We are seeking a validation engineer for the site\-level energy controller on our utility\-scale battery sites. That controller runs on embedded Linux. It manages settings, telemetry, and failover, and it talks to utility and SCADA equipment. You will run software\-centric SIL and HIL for it, build that regression with System Integration, and keep the work on the bench. You do not need to have already defined a validation program. You do need the instinct to look at a controller change and suspect which failure would escape, then go prove it. Our stack includes Go, Rust, and Python. We are language agnostic, and none of these is mandatory. **What You'll Do*** Run software\-centric SIL and HIL for the site\-level energy controller on embedded Linux — settings, telemetry, redundancy/failover, and utility/SCADA communications — so System Integration is testing the site, not the application * Propose the cases worth automating. For a controller change, look for the failures that would escape — restarts, partial writes, timed\-out peers, split state — and do not stop at a suite that only proves the happy path. System Integration and the software team decide which of those become permanent tests * Build that regression with System Integration: automated SIL and HIL that runs against controller builds and catches those cases before they become a system\-test problem. The team writes these tests in pytest * Validate Modbus, DNP3, and SCADA behavior on the bench, including timeouts, bad frames, and peer dropouts, on real equipment where the lab has it and in simulation where it does not * Debug the bench you share. You will not own rack bring\-up, but you will trace a failure from the application through TCP/IP to the port, and you will touch the hardware when that is the fastest way to separate a software bug from a wiring one * When the defect is below the application, follow it far enough to hand off a reproducible case. Kernel and OS depth is learned here. The work stays on the bench: no field deployments, no full\-site signoff **What You'll Bring*** Degree in Engineering (Software, Electrical, Computer, or a related field), or equivalent experience * Internship, co\-op, or up to a few years in test, embedded software, or controls. A new graduate with a strong lab or project record qualifies. Five years is not required * Evidence you think about how something fails, not only how to show it works. A project or internship where you found a case the obvious test missed * Some time on a bench, in SIL, or in HIL. You have written or changed a test, not only run one someone else wrote * Networking fundamentals enough to follow a conversation from the application toward the wire, and a willingness to debug on real hardware * One industrial protocol, or proof you can pick an unfamiliar one up quickly. Modbus, DNP3, or SCADA. All three is not required * Able to read code and change a test harness. Our stack includes Go, Rust, and Python. We are language agnostic, and none of these is mandatory * Able to write automated tests. We use pytest. Experience in another framework is fine * Kernel or OS debugging is not required #### **Benefits** Along with competitive pay, as a full\-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire: * Medical plans \> plan options with $0 payroll deduction * Family\-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits * Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution * Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High\-Deductible medical plan with HSA * Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) * 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits * Company paid Basic Life, AD\&D * Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period) * Employee Assistance Program * Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays * Back\-up childcare and parenting support resources * Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft \& legal services, and pet insurance * Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs * Tesla Babies program * Commuter benefits * Employee discounts and perks program #### **Expected Compensation** $120,000 \- $252,000/annual salary \+ cash and stock awards \+ benefits Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. jobs.title: Fire Protection Engineer

We take pride in fostering a culture that values family, professional growth, and long\-term career development—setting us apart from other services companies. Requirements Tesla Laboratories is seeking a Fire Protection Engineer to support Design Technical Support (DTS) services for the Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command Northwest (NAVFAC NW), Planning Design and Construction Directorate, Design Division (PDC4\). This position supports the existing NAVFAC workforce and provides increased capability for Design\-Bid\-Build and Design\-Build projects and associated efforts undertaken by NAVFAC Northwest customers within the NAVFAC Northwest Area of Responsibility (Puget Sound area). Perform fire protection engineering tasks for new and existing facilities, including analysis/basis, plans, specifications, calculations, and estimates for acquisition of active and passive fire protection systems, such as: Water\-based fire suppression, standpipe, chemical\-based, and gaseous clean agent fire suppression systems. Fire pump and control systems, water supply and storage systems, firefighting access and fire hydrant systems. Advanced early warning and conventional fire alarm/detection and mass notification systems, fire alarm reporting systems. Smoke control/management systems, structural fireproofing systems, and firestop systems. Nationally recognized testing laboratory requirements, life safety and means of egress systems, fire\-resistance\-rated construction and opening protective systems. Facility mutual fire exposure protection, building code allowable facility size regulations, electrical hazard classifications, hazardous material/waste protection, life safety power supply, and marking/illumination of egress systems. In addition, the Fire Protection Engineer will: Coordinate with team members to execute project scope, create/manage schedules, and track/brief budget execution in conformance with project and customer requirements. Create project technical dashboard reports via Microsoft software (Power BI, Project, Excel, etc.). Facilitate the minimization of project delays by providing technical reviews and recommendations within predetermined timeframes. Research codes, guidance, policies, procedures, processes, criteria, and federal laws/regulations, and provide sound technical recommendations both verbally and in writing. Apply innovative technical principles, practices, and theories to the resolution of technical issues. Coordinate with the Government client, NAVFAC team members, leadership, project stakeholders, and various regulatory agencies. Coordinate and facilitate meetings, make recommendations based on project requirements, coordinate workflow processes, schedule/coordinate Plans of Action and Milestones (POAMs), and effectively communicate findings to project personnel; provide written minutes for all meetings. Review technical reports, RFIs, designs, design changes (design\-build and design\-bid\-build), project deliverables, submittals, and cost proposals from contractors to ensure compliance with customer and RFP requirements. Provide technical support for review of the commissioning plan, design and construction submittals, and field inspections. Provide technical support for construction field activities. Provide a summary of accomplishments during weekly meetings and in a prepared monthly status report. Provide weekly reports documenting technical engineering support and quality assurance on each assigned project, including status, issues, costs, schedule, and findings/observations/recommendations/data collected. Prepare reports, Requests for Proposals, and/or scopes of work in the required format, including applicable attachments, and participate in briefings/conferences. Prepare and deliver briefs supported by necessary project documentation to project team members, base personnel, and senior management. Ensure timely submission of submittals, reviews, and recommendations. Education: Graduate of an accredited Engineering college curriculum (4\-year degree minimum). Experience: Minimum of 6 years of Design Management and/or Design experience performing the tasks described above. It is highly desirable, but not required, to hold a current U.S. Professional Engineering (P.E.) license in the fire protection discipline. Demonstrated knowledge of broad\-based engineering principles and versed in the discipline being hired. Sound understanding of technical concepts, principles, and practices applicable to multi\-disciplined engineering project design. Benefits Tesla Laboratories offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well\-being and long\-term success of our employees, including: Competitive compensation Health, dental, and vision insurance Retirement plan with company contribution Paid time off and federal holidays Professional development and training opportunities Supportive, family\-focused company culture Opportunities for long\-term career growth within a growing SDVOSB

jobs.title: Senior Customer-Facing PHP Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** Transport Pro is a leading provider of web\-based logistics software. We are looking for a **Senior PHP Developer** who thrives at the intersection of deep technical problem\-solving and customer empathy. This is not a traditional behind\-the\-scenes engineering role, nor is it a simple helpdesk position. You will serve as the primary technical interface for our clients—translating real customer friction into robust software solutions. We need an experienced developer who genuinely cares about solving human problems through code, understands the business impact of production issues, and takes pride in making our clients feel heard, supported, and valued. **A Note on Technical Depth:** We require a genuine software engineer with foundational knowledge. We are looking for candidates who can read stack traces, write SQL queries by hand, debug environment issues, and write clean, scalable PHP from memory. While AI tools (like Claude or Cursor) are fine for secondary assistance, if you rely on generative AI or "vibe coding" to figure out basic logic or troubleshoot standard errors, this position will not be a fit. **Work Environment \& Travel:** This position is fully remote. Your core mandate will be handling high\-touch customer support requests, configuring custom client installations, and writing production\-ready system enhancements. Because logistics operates around the clock, while 24/7 work is not required, this is not a strict 9\-to\-5 desk job. You will be part of an on\-call rotation to respond to critical customer emergencies on nights and weekends when urgent production issues arise. Additionally, while the day\-to\-day role is remote, **occasional travel will be required** (e.g., key client visits, high\-touch onboarding, or company offsites). Candidates must be willing and able to travel periodically as needed. **Responsibilities** * **Customer\-Centric Problem Solving:** Directly interact with clients to diagnose complex technical issues, provide empathetic communication, and deliver timely, high\-quality resolution to production support tickets. * **Full\-Stack Application Development:** Develop, refactor, and enhance server\-side applications using PHP, ensuring high performance, security, and maintainability. * **API \& System Integration:** Design and implement robust APIs (RESTful and SOAP) to facilitate seamless integrations between client environments and our core logistics platform. * **Software Architecture \& Design:** Participate in system design discussions, contributing to scalable software architecture and long\-term platform improvements. * **Clean Code \& Process Discipline:** Write readable, well\-tested, maintainable code following established engineering standards, SDLC processes, and version control (SVN). * **Testing \& Quality Assurance:** Perform hands\-on debugging and unit testing to ensure application stability across production and staging environments. * **Cloud \& OS Operations:** Manage and deploy services within Linux environments hosted on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). **Requirements** **Soft Skills \& Mindset** * **Empathy First:** Outstanding verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey complex technical concepts calmly and clearly to non\-technical stakeholders. * **Owner's Mentality:** Deep accountability for customer success—you treat client emergencies with the urgency and care they deserve. * **Strong Diagnostic Instincts:** A methodical approach to troubleshooting that relies on fundamental knowledge, system logs, and code inspection rather than trial\-and\-error AI generation. * **Willingness to Travel:** Open to occasional travel (typically \< 10\-15%) for key client on\-site visits, training sessions, or internal team meetings. **Technical Capabilities** * **3\+ Years Senior PHP Experience:** Demonstrated expertise in modern PHP backend development within a production enterprise environment. * **Core Engineering Principles:** Deep proficiency in Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP), design patterns, data structures, and secure coding practices. * **Database Mastery:** Strong hands\-on experience with relational databases, specifically schema design, optimization, and complex query writing in **PostgreSQL**. * **Full Web Stack Proficiency:** Solid understanding of front\-end web technologies, including JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, jQuery, and JSON formats. * **API \& Integration Protocols:** Proven experience designing and consuming RESTful and SOAP web services. * **Infrastructure \& Linux:** Familiarity with Linux server administration, shell scripting, containerized workflows, or cloud infrastructure (GCP/AWS). **Why Join Us?** At Transport Pro, we believe that great software engineering starts with a passion for helping real people. If you take pride in building rock\-solid code while delivering an exceptional client experience, we would love to have you on our team. Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: At Trunk Tools, we’re the leading AI company revolutionizing construction, the second\-largest industry on earth. We recently raised a $40M Series B led by Insight Partners, bringing our total funding to $70M from top\-tier investors including Redpoint and Innovation Endeavors. This new round is fueling our next phase of growth as we scale AI agents across the jobsite. Our mission is to build the future of construction through intelligent automation. Despite being a $13\+ trillion industry, construction still runs largely on analog processes, we’re changing that by embedding AI directly into field operations. Founded by builders and technologists (Stanford, MIT), our team has delivered software used by over 140,000 field professionals, impacting millions of users and contributing to $10B\+ in built projects. Many of us come from the field ourselves, giving us a deep understanding of the industry’s unique challenges. After years of building the “brain” of construction, we’re now launching production\-ready AI agents, starting with intelligent document processing and Q\&A, and rapidly expanding into core operational workflows. Our team has doubled in the past year, and with 100\+ employees (50\+ engineers), we’re scaling fast and entering a period of hypergrowth. This is a rare opportunity to join at an inflection point. **About the role** ------------------ Forward Deployed Engineers are how Trunk Tools gets into the field. You'll embed directly with our general contractor customers, stand up Cortex and our agents inside their real projects, and own the work of turning a pilot into a result the customer can measure: submittal reviews cut from 54\.8 days to 14, a 20\-sheet bulletin reviewed in under 10 minutes instead of roughly 6 hours, RFIs answered before they're ever sent. This is an early\-career role built for engineers who want to write real code, sit with real builders on real jobsites, and watch their work land in weeks, not quarters. You'll learn both the construction domain and the craft of deployment under experienced Forward Deployed Engineers, and everything you pick up in the field will flow straight back into the product. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Deploy Cortex and the agents into live projects.** Connect a customer's document set, integrate with the systems they already run (Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud), and configure the agents around how their teams actually work. * **Create new custom agents for use on live projects.** Leverage the Trunk Tools platform to create new agents for specific customer use cases that can be built, deployed, and used within a project, and used by the customer organization on multiple projects. * **Own the data\-to\-outcome loop for your accounts.** Get a working, measurable result on the customer's own drawings, specs, and submittals, fast, so the value is undeniable. * **Sit with the builders.** Spend time on jobsites and in trailers with project engineers, assistant project managers, and superintendents to learn their workflow and drive real adoption, not just a login. * **Write production\-quality code.** Build the tooling that makes each deployment work, and make it hold up as something the platform can reuse rather than a one\-off. * **Feed the field back into the product.** Bring what you learn to Product and Engineering so Cortex and the knowledge graph get sharper with every deployment. * **Partner with the account team.** Work alongside the deal owner from first proof through expanding across the customer's portfolio. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 0 to 3 years of software engineering experience with strong computer\-science fundamentals. Recent graduates with substantial project or internship experience are encouraged to apply. * Working proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript, and comfort with APIs, data, and building integrations between systems. * Clear, direct communication and genuine comfort in front of customers. We hire engineer\-diplomats: people who can write code in the morning and earn a superintendent's trust in the afternoon. * Willingness to travel to jobsites and customer offices, and real comfort working in the field, hard hat included. * A bias to action. You ship, you watch what breaks, you fix it, and you pick up a new domain quickly. * Low ego and a builder's respect for the people doing the work. **Bonus points** ---------------- * Exposure to construction, architecture, or engineering, or genuine curiosity about how buildings get built. * Familiarity with data, machine learning, or retrieval systems. * Prior customer\-facing, deployment, or forward\-deployed work. * Hands\-on experience with Procore or Autodesk Construction Cloud. **How we work** --------------- We live by three values, and this role touches all of them: * **Low Ego** \- we learn what construction teams need directly from them, on the jobsite. This job is that value made literal. * **No BS** \- we don't over\-promise AI. Every result you deliver should tie to time saved, cost reduced, or work won, and it should be real. * **High Output** \- we ship what we said we'd ship, when we said we'd ship it. **What we offer** A close\-knit and collaborative early\-stage startup environment where every voice is heard and every opinion matters Competitive salary and stock option equity packages 4 Medical Plans to choose from including 100% covered option. Plus Dental and Vision Insurance! Learning \& Growth stipend Flexible long\-term work options (remote and hybrid) Free lunch provided in the office in NYC \& Austin \- you’ll never go hungry with us! Unlimited PTO; We truly believe in work\-life balance and that hard work should be balanced with time for rest and rejuvenation IRL / In\-Person retreats throughout the year ***Please note:*** *All official communication from Trunk Tools will come from an email address ending in* ***@******trunk.tools****. If you receive outreach from any other domain, please disregard it or report it to us.* *At Trunk Tools, we’re working hard to build a more productive and safer environment within the construction industry, and we strive to live by these same values here at Trunk Tools HQ. As an equal\-opportunity employer, we are committed to building an inclusive environment where you can be you. We work hard to evaluate all employees and job applicants consistently, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected class.* Compensation Range: $128,700 \- $209,000

jobs.title: Laboratory Technician
jobs.description: Who We Are: *At UES, we’re a team of more than 4,000 engineers, scientists, geologists, inspectors, technicians, and drillers united by a shared purpose—to make a meaningful impact in the communities we serve. As a national leader in geotechnical engineering, environmental consulting, and materials testing and inspection, we collaborate on transformative projects across transportation, energy, water, healthcare, and more. Learn more about the benefits of joining Team UES and our core values at* *careers.teamues.com**.* Position Overview: We are seeking a detail\-oriented and motivated Laboratory Technician I to join our team and support geotechnical, construction materials testing, and environmental projects. This role is responsible for performing laboratory testing and analysis on soil, concrete, asphalt, aggregates, and other construction materials to ensure compliance with industry standards and project specifications. Working in a controlled laboratory environment, the Lab Technician I plays a vital role in ensuring accurate, high\-quality test results that support infrastructure and construction projects. The ideal candidate will have a strong attention to detail, the ability to follow standardized testing procedures, and a commitment to safety and quality assurance. You will be responsible for preparing samples, operating and maintaining testing equipment, recording data, and assisting in maintaining laboratory organization and compliance. \#LI\-KD1 \#LI\-Onsite Responsibilities: * Perform routine laboratory testing on construction materials, including soil, concrete, and other construction materials following ASTM, AASHTO, and other applicable industry standards to ensure compliance with project specifications. * Ensure that project testing requirements are met and compliant with project specifications, requirements, and company policies and procedures. * Accurately document and report test results, maintaining detailed, organized, and error\-free records. * Assist with sample preparation, handling, and proper storage, ensuring sample integrity, traceability, and adherence to laboratory protocols. * Operate laboratory testing equipment. * Follow strict safety protocols and laboratory procedures, including proper handling of materials and use of personal protective equipment (PPE). * Communicate effectively with lab supervisors, engineers, and field personnel, providing timely updates on test results, sample status, and any technical issues. * Perform additional duties as assigned, supporting the laboratory team, field technicians, and project managers as needed. Job Responsibilities Note: *The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. UES retains the right to add to or change the duties of the position at any time.*Qualifications: * High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree or technical coursework in engineering, geology, construction science, or a related field preferred. * 0\-3 years of experience in construction materials testing, geotechnical laboratory work, or a related field (prior laboratory experience preferred but not required). * Commitment to workplace safety, following OSHA, company, and laboratory safety protocols, including the proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE). * Basic computer proficiency, with experience in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) and Field Data Collection (FDC) software preferred. * Ability to read, write, and interpret procedures, manuals, technical documents, and reports related to construction materials testing and laboratory protocols. * Mathematical skills sufficient to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. * Effective verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with colleagues, supervisors, field personnel, and clients to carry out instructions and report findings. * Strong organizational, time management, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently. * Detail\-oriented and quality\-focused, ensuring accuracy in sample preparation, testing procedures, and data documentation. * Ability to work independently within the limitations of experience, using initiative to solve routine lab challenges. * Ability to stand for extended periods of time and perform physically demanding tasks, including lifting and moving materials or equipment. * Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record; ability to travel to job sites as needed. Physical Demands \& Work Environment: Work is sometimes conducted in a laboratory setting, but may also involve fieldwork and exposure to outdoor conditions, including:* Sites that may not be accessible by vehicle, requiring travel on foot through wetlands, swamps, grasslands, construction zones, and other uneven or rugged terrain with natural and man\-made obstacles such as sand, brush, and debris. * Moderate to loud noise levels due to lab equipment, field operations, and construction environments. * Exposure to dirt, dust, chemicals, sun, heat, humidity, and varying weather conditions as part of field sample collection and testing. Physical requirements include: * Ability to lift and carry between 35 and 75 lbs. over distances up to 75 feet, involving regular repetitive motion. * Ability to stand, walk, drive, and operate laboratory and field equipment for extended periods. * Frequent use of hands and arms for typing, handling samples, operating lab instruments, and performing testing procedures. * Ability to bend, twist, reach, stoop, pull, kneel, climb, balance, lift, carry, and push as required for laboratory and fieldwork. * Ability to communicate effectively through verbal and written means in a lab and field environment, often requiring the use of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment). * Ability to use your senses to see (including close, distant, and peripheral vison, depth vision, and ability to focus) and smell. Travel Requirements: * This position does not require regular travel as part of its primary responsibilities. However, occasional travel may be required, up to 10%, primarily for occasional off\-site meetings, training sessions, or company events. Travel, when necessary, will be communicated in advance and aligned with business needs. EEO Statement: **UES is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to recruit the most qualified candidates. Please see our full EEO Statement at the bottom of the page** **here**

jobs.title: Senior Major Gift Officer, Penn Engineering
jobs.description: **University Overview** The University of Pennsylvania, the largest private employer in Philadelphia, is a world\-renowned leader in education, research, and innovation. This historic, Ivy League school consistently ranks among the top 10 universities in the annual U.S. News \& World Report survey. Penn has 12 highly\-regarded schools that provide opportunities for undergraduate, graduate and continuing education, all influenced by Penn’s distinctive interdisciplinary approach to scholarship and learning. As an employer Penn has been ranked nationally on many occasions with the most recent award from Forbes who named Penn one of America’s Best Large Employers in 2023\. Penn offers a unique working environment within the city of Philadelphia. The University is situated on a beautiful urban campus, with easy access to a range of educational, cultural, and recreational activities. With its historical significance and landmarks, lively cultural offerings, and wide variety of atmospheres, Philadelphia is the perfect place to call home for work and play. The University offers a competitive benefits package that includes excellent healthcare and tuition benefits for employees and their families, generous retirement benefits, a wide variety of professional development opportunities, supportive work and family benefits, a wealth of health and wellness programs and resources, and much more. **Posted Job Title** Senior Major Gift Officer, Penn Engineering**Job Profile Title** Major Gifts Officer Senior**Job Description Summary** Penn Engineering’s world\-acclaimed faculty, state\-of\-the\-art research laboratories and highly interdisciplinary curricula offer an experience that is unparalleled. Innovation and technology drive every program and transform the fundamentals of what future engineers are learning. http://www.seas.upenn.edu/ Penn Engineering is seeking an accomplished, strategic, and collaborative development professional to serve as a Senior Major Gift Officer covering international territories. This is an exciting opportunity to partner with and contribute to a highly successful development and alumni relations team, an engaged Dean and Board, and a committed and involved community consisting of alumni, parents, faculty and friends. As part of a team of experienced fundraisers, the Senior Major Gifts Officer reports to the Director of Development. This position manages the identification, qualification, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship of assigned prospects with the giving ability of $100,000 and above. The position will focus primarily on Asia (Hong Kong, Singapore, and China) and India, with other potential regions assigned, and is responsible for designing, planning, and implementing a major gifts plan that proactively extends the reach of Penn Engineering internationally to expand Engineering's prospect base and build the donor pipeline. The role is also responsible for developing and maintaining regional knowledge, including an understanding of fundraising practices, philanthropic trends, and cultural norms that influence donor engagement in assigned markets. At the Senior Major Gifts Officer level, the role carries a higher degree of independence in developing and executing fundraising strategies, managing complex prospect relationships, and advancing high level cultivation and solicitation efforts. The position represents Penn Engineering in key international markets and works closely with School leadership, faculty, volunteers, alumni, and colleagues across the School and the University to advance institutional priorities. The position requires the willingness and ability to travel extensively throughout the year, sometimes for up to two weeks at a time, and to varied countries in a single trip. Availability to work some weekends and evenings is also required.**Job Description** **Job Responsibilities** * Manage a top\-tier portfolio of approximately 150 donors and prospects, executing comprehensive moves management—including identification, qualification, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship—to develop and advance a robust pipeline of high\-level gift prospects. * Develop strategies for and conduct identification, qualification, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship visits with donors and prospects with giving capacity ratings of $100,000 or more. * Meet mutually agreed\-upon annual goals for core role responsibilities, including donor and prospect visits, solicitations, and philanthropic commitments secured. * Ensure pertinent prospect information and contacts are accurately recorded in the institutional database in a timely manner. * Collaborate with fundraisers across the department and University on overall relationship\-building with alumni and other constituents of the School. * Coordinate cultivation events and programs hosted by the School or assigned prospects, and staff programs in the designated geographic region. * Other duties and responsibilities as assigned **\*\ ife, and Flexible Spending Accounts**: Penn offers comprehensive medical, prescription, behavioral health, dental, vision, and life insurance benefits to protect you and your family’s health and welfare. You can also use flexible spending accounts to pay for eligible health care and dependent care expenses with pre\-tax dollars. * **Tuition**: Take advantage of Penn's exceptional tuition benefits. You, your spouse, and your dependent children can get tuition assistance here at Penn. Your dependent children are also eligible for tuition assistance at other institutions. * **Retirement:** Penn offers generous retirement plans to help you save for your future. Penn’s Basic, Matching, and Supplemental retirement plans allow you to save for retirement on a pre\-tax or Roth basis. Choose from a wide variety of investment options through TIAA and Vanguard. * **Time Away from Work:** Penn provides you with a substantial amount of time away from work during the course of the year. This allows you to relax, take vacations, attend to personal affairs, recover from illness or injury, spend time with family—whatever your personal needs may be. * **Long\-Term Care Insurance:** In partnership with Genworth Financial, Penn offers faculty and staff (and your eligible family members) long\-term care insurance to help you cover some of the costs of long\-term care services received at home, in the community or in a nursing facility. If you apply when you’re newly hired, you won’t have to provide proof of good health or be subject to underwriting requirements. Eligible family members must always provide proof of good health and are subject to underwriting. * **Wellness and Work\-life Resources**: Penn is committed to supporting our faculty and staff as they balance the competing demands of work and personal life. That’s why we offer a wide variety of programs and resources to help you care for your health, your family, and your work\-life balance. * **Professional and Personal Development:** Penn provides an array of resources to help you advance yourself personally and professionally. * **University Resources:** As a member of the Penn community, you have access to a wide range of University resources as well as cultural and recreational activities. Take advantage of the University’s libraries and athletic facilities, or visit our arboretum and art galleries. There’s always something going on at Penn, whether it’s a new exhibit at the Penn Museum, the latest music or theater presentation at the Annenberg Center, or the Penn Relays at Franklin Field to name just a few examples. As a member of the Penn community, you’re right in the middle of the excitement—and you and your family can enjoy many of these activities for free. * **Discounts and Special Services**: From arts and entertainment to transportation and mortgages, you'll find great deals for University faculty and staff. Not only do Penn arts and cultural centers and museums offer free and discounted admission and memberships to faculty and staff. You can also enjoy substantial savings on other goods and services such as new cars from Ford and General Motors, cellular phone service plans, movie tickets, and admission to theme parks. * **Flexible Work Hours:** Flexible work options offer creative approaches for completing work while promoting balance between work and personal commitments. These approaches involve use of non\-traditional work hours, locations, and/or job structures. * **Penn Home Ownership Services:** Penn offers a forgivable loan for eligible employees interested in buying a home or currently residing in West Philadelphia, which can be used for closing costs or home improvements. * **Adoption Assistance:** Penn will reimburse eligible employees on qualified expenses in connection with the legal adoption of an eligible child, such as travel or court fees, for up to two adoptions in your household. *To learn more, please visit:* *https://www.hr.upenn.edu/PennHR/benefits\-pay*

AI integration patterns. * Proficiency in front\-end web development technologies such as React, Angular, and Node.js. * Experience configuring build and deployment systems such as Docker, Jenkins, enterprise\-scale components. * Knowledge of version control, CI/CD pipelines, and best practices for application and ML model deployment. * Working knowledge of distributed in\-memory computing technologies such as Redis. * Understanding of enterprise security, certificate management, and related practices. * Hands\-on experience with Jenkins and container deployment architecture. * jobs.title: Process Engineer
jobs.description: “Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for sponsorship now or in the future.” Voyant Beauty believes our people are more than just employees; they’re the driving force behind everything we achieve. Our culture fosters teamwork, respect, and camaraderie, ensuring that every individual’s contribution is valued and celebrated. We invest in their growth, providing opportunities for development and advancement within our dynamic team. Voyant Beauty is a company that specializes in the development and manufacturing, of beauty, personal and home care products. We work with various brands, retailers, and businesses to create customer formulations and products tailored to their needs. This can include skincare, haircare, bath and body products, fragrances, and more. Essentially, Voyant Beauty serves as a one\-stop\-shop for companies looking to bring their beauty and personal care product ideas to life. Safety is a core value at Voyant Beauty. We prioritize the well\-being of our team members, ensuring a safe and secure environment where everyone can thrive and excel. If you’re seeking to be part of a team where your talents are valued, your safety is paramount, and your efforts contribute to meaningful change, then Voyant Beauty is the place for you. Come join us and be a part of our journey. A Brief Overview In this role, you will be responsible for identifying and implementing process efficiencies within our plant by utilizing Lean methodologies such as 5S, Kaizen, and Six Sigma. You will provide plant\-wide support and become a subject matter expert in optimizing production processes to ensure efficient and cost\-effective project execution. As the internal Process Engineer, you will oversee new projects, including bottle and label changes, new product lines, and production line improvements, while bridging the gap between account managers, production teams, and external customers. You will also be responsible for mapping material flows, conducting production data analysis, and recommending efficiency improvements. What you will do * Provide comprehensive plant support by becoming a subject matter expert in key processes to ensure projects are completed efficiently and cost\-effectively from start to finish. Participate in continuous improvement initiatives, while developing best practices, streamlined routines, and innovative solutions to enhance production rates, improve output quality, and reduce costs. * Identify the 7 wastes, reviewing total productive maintenance, creating loss analysis and compiling downtime charts using Six sigma tools (Problem Solving, Failure Mode and Effective Analysis (FMEA) Process Mapping, Value Added Flow Analysis, Seven Wastes, Takt time, 5S, Value System Mapping). * Manage new projects coming to the site, such as bottle changes, label updates, and new product lines. Coordinate between on site Account Managers and key departments—batching, inventory, production, quality, and warehouse—to ensure smooth project execution. Map material flows, identify touch points, and recommend process improvements for greater efficiency. Collaborate with Account Managers to communicate with external customers on project needs, including line trials, while collecting and analyzing production data to document and design more efficient production processes. * Performance of Installation Qualification (IQ), Operation Qualification (OQ), and Product Qualification (PQ). * Observe Good Manufacturing Processes (GMP). * Participating in Safety \& Quality Audits. * Some duties may vary slightly by location. Education Qualifications * Bachelor's Degree in science, engineering or chemical engineering (Preferred) * Will consider recent graduates with 5S/Lean/Six Sigma/Kaizen training and/or experience (Preferred) Experience Qualifications * 1\-3 years Working in a fast\-paced regulated company strongly desired; experience in the cosmetics/personal care manufacturing industry preferred (Preferred) * 1\-3 years Proven track record of successful implementation of manufacturing process improvements (Preferred) * 1\-3 years Experience with AutoCad, MiniTab \& SolidWorks (Preferred) Skills and Abilities * 5S, Kaizen, and Lean Methodologies: In\-depth understanding of process improvement tools like 5S, Kaizen, Six Sigma, and Lean principles, enabling continuous improvement and efficiency in manufacturing processes. (Medium proficiency) * Knowledge of project management techniques, especially as it relates to managing projects from conception to completion, including the ability to oversee internal and external stakeholders. (High proficiency) * Familiarity with GMP and regulatory requirements, particularly in a fast\-paced and regulated industry such as cosmetics or personal care. (High proficiency) * Understanding of how to analyze, map, and optimize production processes for increased efficiency and cost savings. (Medium proficiency) * Knowledge of standard data analysis methods to assess production accuracy, line design, and vendor performance, and the ability to apply this data for process improvements. (Medium proficiency) * Skill in identifying areas for process efficiency using Lean principles and implementing those improvements through 5S and Kaizen events. (Medium proficiency) * Data analysis and problem\-solving skills, enabling the ability to evaluate production data, create diagrams, and recommend process improvements. (Medium proficiency) * Proficient in communicating across different departments (e.g., account management, production, quality, and warehouse) and liaising with external clients to ensure successful project completion. (High proficiency) * Effective in managing multiple projects simultaneously, particularly new product introductions or changes, and coordinating various functions within the plant. (High proficiency) * Ability to develop innovative solutions that improve production rates, quality, and cost\-efficiency. (Medium proficiency) * Comfortable using computer systems and software tools for managing data, analyzing processes, and communicating across teams. (Medium proficiency) * Demonstrated ability to set clear goals and follow through to achieve shared outcomes across teams. (Medium proficiency) * Ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders, both internally and externally, to drive successful project outcomes. (High proficiency) * Keen attention to detail, particularly in managing production data, vendor performance, and new project implementation. (High proficiency) * Ability to take ownership of continuous improvement initiatives and process changes within the plant. (Medium proficiency) Licenses and Certifications * Lean Six Sigma Certification\-IASSC or LEAN equivalent is desirable (Preferred) **To Staffing and Recruiting Agencies:** Our company does not accept unsolicited curriculum vitae’s or applications from agencies. We are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited curriculum vitae’s or applications and explicitly reserve its right to contact candidates presented in such unsolicited curriculum vitae’s or application. Our company provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, religion, sex, color, national origin, sexual orientation, age, disability or veteran status. Vee Pak will consider requests for accommodations due to a disability impacting a qualified employee's ability to perform the essential functions of their position consistent with applicable laws. In addition to federal law requirements, Vee Pak complies with applicable provincial and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

jobs.title: Sr Telephony Engineer, Avaya Aura
jobs.description: **Senior Telephony Engineer, Avaya Aura** Company Overview Waterfield Tech enables companies to select, design, and deploy tailored customer engagement solutions from the world’s leading providers enhanced by cutting edge Applied AI. The results are **happier customers, enhanced insights,** and **lower costs**. Once live, we empower companies to support, optimize, and modernize those solutions and AI applications, leading to **lower risk** and **increased efficiency**. Our client\-centric process and track record of success have earned the trust of clients around the world when it comes to customer interaction. We value our people—their diversity, their dedication, and their commitment to customer satisfaction. We encourage each other. We understand the value of hard work and the importance of a healthy balance. We’re all on the same page… even though we may get there from different perspectives. All in all, it’s a pretty cool place to be and we’re growing our global team of engineers, sales professionals, and creative souls. Position Summary Waterfield Tech is seeking a Senior Telephony Engineer, Avaya Aura to lead the hands\-on deployment of complex Avaya Aura and unified communications solutions (on\-premises, hybrid, and cloud) across commercial, enterprise, and government customers, increasingly including migration from legacy Avaya estates to cloud and CCaaS platforms. The Senior Telephony Engineer owns the technical delivery of each engagement day to day, including configuration, integration, testing, and cutover, working closely with Waterfield Tech Project Managers to deliver on time, on quality, and to standard. As a senior technical resource, the engineer mentors less experienced voice engineers and contributes to delivery standards and reusable IP. Deep, hands\-on Avaya Aura expertise is required; breadth across UC/CCaaS and cloud is valued. Key Responsibilities * Lead the hands\-on deployment of Avaya Aura solutions end to end (System Manager, Session Manager, Communication Manager, messaging, media servers and gateways, and IM \& Presence (Breeze)) across on\-premises, hybrid, and cloud, including virtualized and physical server builds (OVA deployment, VM sizing) in new and upgrade environments and applying service packs and patches per Avaya documentation. * Own day to day technical delivery (configuration, integration, testing, and cutover), managing schedules and adhering to stage gate quality and control standards across the full lifecycle, including issues, risks, and change requests, to ensure successful, on time delivery. * Perform discovery of customer telephony environments; gather requirements and complete data gathering for the Avaya Aura application servers; communicate network and system requirements (DHCP scope options, QoS, and split\-horizon DNS). * Configure and deploy Aura call routing and edge, including dial plans (E.164 and shortcut dialing), Communication Manager vectoring/VDN where contact center functionality is required, SIP\-based Remote Worker, Session Border Controller (SBCE), SIP trunking, and Avaya Workplace (formerly Equinox) soft clients across iOS, Android, Windows, and WebRTC, and troubleshoot as needed. * Lead certificate implementation end to end (CSR generation and installation of customer/Avaya certificates across the Aura stack); complete licensing via Avaya PLDS and technical onboarding via Avaya GRT. * Complete integration programming between Avaya Aura servers and to non\-Avaya systems, and support adjuncts such as IVR, CMS reporting, call recording, and SIP PSTN services. * Validate and troubleshoot end to end connectivity using system tools and the Avaya knowledge base, and develop and execute acceptance test plans that evaluate the customer's Avaya Aura environment. * Support migration and modernization: legacy to cloud and hybrid Avaya migrations, and integration with CCaaS and AI\-enabled capabilities such as virtual agents and agent assist. * Apply AI to delivery by using AI\-powered tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude) for documentation, testing, and delivery efficiency, and maintain accurate booking and time entry in Microsoft Dynamics 365/Project Operations. * Contribute to delivery standards, practices, templates, tools, and reusable IP that mature the Avaya practice, and provide coaching and mentoring for less experienced voice engineers. * Ensure delivery meets Waterfield Tech standards and remains compliant with RFP/proposal SOW and executed contract terms, and support pre\-sales scoping, feasibility, and level of effort. * Continue professional development and Avaya certification, and perform other duties as assigned. How This Role Is Measured This role is measured on the delivery of assigned work and the quality of what is handed off. Primary measures are task estimate adherence (actual versus estimated hours on assigned WBS tasks) and on time task completion against the project plan, together with delivery quality: the rework rate on /Session Manager, messaging, SBCE, AES, media servers and gateways, and Device Services; Avaya Workplace (formerly Equinox) soft clients; and virtualization (VMware ESXi, AVP) with OVA deployment and legacy to cloud/System Platform migration. * Preferred: Avaya Experience Platform (AXP) and CCaaS; AI enablement (virtual agents, agent assist, AI\-powered self\-service); and voice protocol and telephony security depth (SIP/SIP trunking, H.323, MGCP; certificates, reverse proxy, firewalls). Qualifications **Experience** * 8\+ years implementing and supporting complex Avaya Aura engagements (planning, configuration, integration, and cutover) in a medium to large organization, including gathering and documenting requirements with business stakeholders. * Hands\-on preventive maintenance, installation, and administration of Avaya gateways (G450/G430/G350, G650 PN, EGW) and Communication Manager Server 7\.x, 8\.x, and 10\.x. * Experience with complex dial plans, call handlers, auto\-attendants, and attendant console; bulk configuration tools; contact center functionality (agents, skills, vectors) desirable. * Experience with messaging (Aura Messaging, Avaya IX Messaging/OfficeLinx), Breeze and Breeze plug\-ins, AADS/Utility Server, and 46xx settings files; several preferred. **Technical Proficiency** * Server and OS depth: Linux/ESXi administration and System Platform migrations; Linux commands for log analysis; DHCP, DNS, and split\-horizon DNS. * Integration depth: Application Enablement Services (TSAPI, CVLAN, DMCC) and related integration; remote access and diagnostic tools (VPN, Nectar, web\-based). * Delivery tooling: Microsoft Dynamics 365/Project Operations for booking, time entry, and delivery operations; AI\-powered delivery tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude). **Soft Skills** * Senior technical presence: leads deployments hands\-on and mentors less experienced engineers. * Excellent attention to detail; adapts to shifting priorities, competing demands, and timelines. * Strong analytical and problem solving skills; manages multiple complex efforts simultaneously. * Excellent oral and written communication and customer service skills across all levels of the organization. * Collaborative across internal and external teams; comfortable with ambiguity and change. **Education** * Bachelor’s Degree required; Master’s a plus. Emphasis in a technology field preferred. Equivalent work experience will be considered. Additional Requirements * Avaya certifications strongly valued: ACIS/ACSS or current Avaya certification equivalents; Avaya Aura credentials desirable. * VMware certifications preferred; other technical certifications a plus (Cisco networking/telephony, security, or cloud). * Availability to work flexible hours as needed, including after hours cutovers. Physical Requirements * Sitting: Ability to sit for extended periods (up to 80% of the time). * Lifting: Ability to lift or carry objects up to 10 lbs. * Equipment: Frequent use of computer, telephone, and standard office equipment. * Travel: Ability to travel up to 10% for customer installations, cutovers, and training.
