All employees must be citizens of the United States or be able to provide proof of employment eligibility.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Customer Tech
jobs.description: **Location**: Mountain View, CA, Seattle, WA, or Boston, MA (Hybrid \- this role requires being in\-office 3 days per week in one of these locations) Wayfair’s Customer Tech organization is the product and engineering engine behind how tens of millions of customers discover, evaluate, personalize, and purchase for the home across web and app. Customer Tech teams own the end\-to\-end consumer experience from the first moment of inspiration through purchase and beyond. Customer Tech is accountable for the strategies, systems, and design craft that determine whether Wayfair is the destination customers return to. We’re hiring a Principal Software Engineer to drive cross\-domain and end to end technical leadership across the org \- operating at the intersection of large\-scale distributed systems, native app, web and platform infrastructure, and rapid AI adoption. You will set multi\-year architecture strategies, simplify ambiguous problem spaces, and guide engineering teams around a cohesive technical vision to ensure Wayfair builds scalable, performant, and reliable experiences for millions of users. **The Opportunity** Customer Tech is organized into four superpods: Growth, Discovery, Purchase, and Platforms. Together, they power the full customer journey from acquisition and discovery to purchase and post\-purchase. Platforms provide the technology foundation for scalable, seamless experiences. This is a strategy\-first, high\-influence technical leadership role. As a Principal Software Engineer, you will establish high\-impact architectural standards across our front\-end, back\-end, and distributed platform stacks. Your primary partners will include Customer Tech Engineering Directors, Product \& Design Leadership, Applied Science, and Data Science. You will also partner with the broader engineering leadership and engineering community within Wayfair; your job is to connect technical decisions directly to customer needs and business outcomes. Crucially, we want someone who is actively thinking about building scalable architectures that are AI and Agent ready to drive Agentic adoption for both developers and Wayfair consumers. How should Wayfair’s technical ecosystem, data federation layers, APIs, and developer workflows evolve to support AI\-driven experiences and autonomous capabilities? You will be expected to have an opinionated point of view, prototype solutions, and drive the execution to make that platform vision a reality. **What You’ll Own****Technical Strategy \& Architectural Vision*** Define and communicate a compelling multi\-year architecture strategy and practical technical roadmaps across multiple engineering domains and superpods. * Simplify complex, highly ambiguous problem spaces where no clear ownership or path forward exists, establishing reference architectures and clear technical plans. * Architect and evolve high\-scale, distributed systems across our stack, including GraphQL/REST APIs, data federation, Next.js/React front\-end infrastructure, and cloud\-native services. **Architectural Judgment \& Technical Excellence*** Make explicit, high\-judgment trade\-offs between delivery speed, performance, maintainability, scalability, site reliability, cost, and developer experience. * Drive hands\-on execution by authoring Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), conducting architecture/code reviews, building prototypes, and validating critical technical assumptions. * Convert recurring system pain points and incident root causes into durable, platform\-level fixes and operational standards across the organization. **AI Platforms \& Developer Innovation*** Design and evaluate AI\-enabled platform architectures, including tools, agent frameworks, context management, data readiness, and agent\-friendly APIs. * Establish guardrails for AI safety, latency, cost optimization, and responsible AI usage across customer\-facing and platform surfaces. * Drive AI\-assisted software development practices to improve engineering productivity, testing, and delivery velocity across Customer Tech. **Influence, Leadership \& Talent Development*** Build alignment across complex, matrixed environments, resolving deep technical disagreements among senior engineers, product leaders, and executives without relying on positional authority. * Mentor Staff and Principal\-level engineers, cultivate future technical leaders, and foster active engineering communities of practice. * Represent Customer Tech's architectural vision to executive engineering leadership, translating technical health investments into measurable business outcomes. **What We’re Looking For****Experience \& Technical Scope*** 12\+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of designing, building, and operating large\-scale distributed systems. * Proven Staff or Principal\-level technical leadership across multiple independent teams, domains, or engineering organizations. * Demonstrated scope, judgment, system adoption, and busi s, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern web infrastructure at scale. * Infrastructure \& Operations: Cloud\-native systems, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, site reliability engineering (SRE), SLOs, and observability. * AI Technology: Hands\-on experience or familiarity with generative AI APIs, agent frameworks, and AI\-assisted development tools. **Strategy, Execution \& Leadership*** Systemic Execution: Record of driving strategies from concept and architecture through implementation, production launch, and org\-wide adoption. * Business \& Metrics Orientation: Ability to tie architectural choices directly to customer metrics, conversion, latency, reliability, or developer efficiency. * Collaborative Influence: Outstanding communication skills with a history of aligning engineering, product, and business partners around shared technical direction. **Why Wayfair \& Customer Tech** This is a rare opportunity to shape the technology foundation that powers how tens of millions of customers experience home \- one of the highest\-consideration, most emotionally resonant categories in consumer commerce. You will have the scope, technical complexity, and executive access to drive system\-wide impact, modernizing engineering platforms while defining how AI integrates into modern e\-commerce architectures. Wayfair is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic and are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the application, interview, and employment process. **Assistance for Individuals with Disabilities** Wayfair is fully committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, including individuals with disabilities. As part of this commitment, Wayfair will make reasonable accommodations to the known physical or mental limitations of qualified individuals with disabilities, unless doing so would impose an undue hardship on business operations. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, please let us know by completing our Accomodations for Applicants form. **Need Technical Assistance?** For more information about applying for a career at wayfair, visit our FAQ page here. **About Wayfair Inc.** Wayfair is one of the world’s largest online destinations for the home. Whether you work in our global headquarters in Boston, or in our warehouses or offices throughout the world, we’re reinventing the way people shop for their homes. Through our commitment to industry\-leading technology and creative problem\-solving, we are confident that Wayfair will be home to the most rewarding work of your career. If you’re looking for rapid growth, constant learning, and dynamic challenges, then you’ll find that amazing career opportunities are knocking. No matter who you are, Wayfair is a place you can call home. We’re a community of innovators, risk\-takers, and trailblazers who celebrate our differences, and know that our unique perspectives make us stronger, smarter, and well\-positioned for success. We value and rely on the collective voices of our employees, customers, community, and suppliers to help guide us as we build a better Wayfair – and world – for all. Every voice, every perspective matters. That’s why we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristic. Your personal data is processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice (https://www.wayfair.com/careers/privacy). If you have any questions or wish to exercise your rights under applicable privacy and data protection laws, please contact us at dataprotectionofficer@wayfair.com.

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: ***Company \& Culture*** Welldoc is driven by a powerful mission: empowering better health across conditions through AI\-powered, personalized health tech, with a vision to be the leading clinically trusted AI tech partner across the healthcare industry. We're a team passionate about leveraging cutting\-edge science to improve lives, united by core values of collaborative innovation, accountability to excellence, customer focus, efficiency, and unwavering integrity, quality, and safety. At Welldoc, you'll thrive in a collaborative and innovative environment where your contributions directly impact our mission. Recognized as a Great Place to Work for the past five years and named to Modern Healthcare’s Best Places to Work 2026, as well as being an industry thought leader featured at SXSW and in the Wall Street Journal and Economist, we invite you to make a real difference in healthcare with us. ***Job Purpose*** Welldoc's Reporting and Visualization team is looking for an Analytics Engineer to help lead the design and buildout of our analytics data model, with a sharp focus on creating a strong, reusable consumption layer. This person will act as a thought leader on the team — translating stakeholder needs into concrete technical requirements, evaluating our current data structures, and shaping how both BI tools and AI\-driven applications consume our data. This is a high\-autonomy role for someone who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, is comfortable operating without highly prescriptive direction, and enjoys shaping strategy as much as executing on it. ***Resposibilities*** * Serve as a thought leader in the planning and execution of our new data model, with a primary focus on building a strong, scalable consumption layer. * Partner with data analysts, data engineers, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business needs into clear technical requirements for the consumption layer and downstream analyses. * Proactively identify and recommend analytics engineering work needed to support reporting, visualization, and AI use cases across the business. * Evaluate our current data structures and models, and recommend changes to improve scalability, usability, and performance. * Design, build, and maintain the consumption layer and underlying data transformations that power self\-service reporting, BI tools, and AI applications. * Leverage software engineering best practices to optimize performance of our data pipelines and automate analytics workflows. * Help evaluate additional tools and technologies for fit within our evolving data and analytics tech stack. * Support company\-wide efforts to improve data quality, accessibility, and governance, including implementing data quality checks and monitoring to ensure accuracy, completeness, and reliability. * Contribute to the improvement of data team best practices, workflows, and documentation to ensure we are building a sustainable and scalable data function. * Troubleshoot data issues and clearly communicate root causes and resolutions to internal stakeholders. Optimize the performance and scalability of data infrastructure to support growing data volumes and evolving business needs. * ***Required Skills \& Experience*** * 3\-5 years demonstrated experience designing and building data models and transformation pipelines for analytics use cases. * At least 3 years hands\-on knowledge of Databricks is required, including experience building consumption layers used by both AI tools and BI/reporting tools. * Strong ability to work independently and make sound judgment calls in ambiguous, fast\-moving situations without needing detailed direction. * A track record of translating business and stakeholder needs into well\-scoped technical requirements. * Strong software engineering fundamentals applied to data workflows (version control, testing, modular design, automation). * Experience evaluating data architecture and recommending structural improvements. * Comfort evaluating and recommending new tools and technologies as the data stack evolves. * Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work across data engineering, analytics, and business teams. A proactive, ownership\-driven mindset — someone who identifies problems and opportunities before being asked. * Welldoc operates in ISO 13485 and MDSAP regulated and HITRUST and SOC 2 Type II compliant environments. Therefore, it is expected that all employees will have either prior experience working in those environments or will be trained to understand the requirements needed to work and support those requirements and culture as they relate to individual roles and responsibilities. **Required Education** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science or Business Analytics is preferred. A Masters Degree in a relevant field may substitute for some required experience. * **Compensation \& Benefits** Welldoc offers a competitive compensation package which, in addition to salary, includes generous PTO, medical insurance, dental insurance, vision care, life and disability insurance, retirement benefits. and the opportunity to participate in health savings accounts and/or dependent care accounts. While the anticipated salary range for this position is between $110,000 \- $130,000/year with the expectation that most candidates will fall around the midpoint of the range. Exceptional candidates may exceed the range if education and experience warrant. Upon receipt of a conditional offer of employment, you may be required to complete and clear a multi\-panel drug screening process. This screening is in connection with requirements set by certain of the Company’s customers, with which you may be working in this role, and will at all times be administered all applicable laws. *Welldoc is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We offer an inclusive workplace and will not tolerate discrimination against any job candidate or employee due to age, race, religion, color, ethnicity, national origin, gender, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, membership in an employee organization, medical condition, family history, genetic information, veteran status, marital status or parental status.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: **Your work days are brighter here.** We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. **About the Team** We're an AI platform organization. We build the platform other engineering teams use to develop, evaluate, and deploy AI systems, and we build production applications on top of it — agentic solutions alongside a broad range of classical ML. The work spans the full applied\-AI stack: model and agent development, evaluation infrastructure, serving performance and cost, and the pipelines that get it all into an enterprise product. Our systems run against real customer data, so correctness, reliability, and observability matter as much as capability. We're hiring at senior software engineer to have someone own a significant surface area end to end — design through delivery and operation. **About the Role** As a Senior Software Development Engineer on the AI Foundations team, you will be primarily responsible for designing, building, and operating the software systems that host, run, and scale AI\-powered applications at Workday. Specifically, you will: Work closely with machine learning engineers to write and maintain production\-grade backend services that power AI\-driven capabilities and agent applications Design and implement APIs and service integrations that enable AI capabilities to be consumed across Workday products and platforms Build and operate data ingestion and ETL pipelines that support AI application workflows Apply distributed systems principles in production to address scalability, concurrency, fault tolerance, and performance challenges Ensure systems meet enterprise requirements for security, privacy, robustness, and compliance Own services through their full lifecycle, including deployment, monitoring, debugging, and ongoing operational improvements **What you'll do** * Design, build, and operate core services and infrastructure for AI development, evaluation, and deployment * Own a significant surface area end to end, including production health and on\-call * Turn open\-ended problems into scoped, sequenced work — for yourself and for others * Raise the bar through design and code review, and mentor engineers on the team * Partner with product, research, and infrastructure teams on tradeoffs and roadmap **About You** You are a strong technical leader with deep Python expertise and solid software engineering skills, capable of writing beautiful, well\-designed code while delivering solutions efficiently. **Basic Qualification:** 8\+ years of professional software development experience, including architecting, building, and scaling secure, robust, and efficient software systems 5\+ years of experience with Python development Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. **Other Qualifications:** Understanding of object\-oriented design principles and ability to apply them in a Python context Proficiency with advanced Python concepts, such as asynchronous and concurrent programming, generators, and higher\-order abstractions Ability to write clean, testable, and well\-structured code, with high standards for clarity, aesthetics, and long\-term maintainability Deep systems knowledge, including comfort operating in and debugging Unix/Linux environments, fluency with command\-line tooling, and understanding of practical networking fundamentals Understanding of distributed systems concepts, including concurrency, fault tolerance, and performance tradeoffs Ability to design and build well\-defined, stable APIs and service interfaces for consumption by other teams and systems Ability to build ETL pipelines that efficiently process large amounts of data using tools like PySpark. Proficiency with cloud and container platforms, including containerized workloads and orchestration systems (e.g., AWS or GCP, Docker, Kubernetes) Ability to collaborate effectively across te ting best practices and raising the engineering bar Architectural thinking skills, with the ability to contribute meaningful ideas and practical solutions in design and architecture discussions Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders **Workday Pay Transparency Statement** The annualized base salary ranges for the primary location and any additional locations are listed below. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). customer outcomes, including water savings, energy reduction, operating efficiency, compliance improvement, asset reliability, production resilience, and resource recovery. * Support the company in management. * Provide clear economic insights into technology adoption and end user value to aide in market positioning and strategy development. * Translate customer production, water, energy, labor, reliability, and regulatory challenges into clear technical requirements and solution concepts. * Advise on the integration of process technologies with instrumentation, control systems, SCADA, DCS, OPEX, total\-cost\-of\-ownership, risk, and value tradeoffs. * A strategic mindset with the ability to contribute to portfolio planning, partnerships, acquisitions, and business development. * Active participation in relevant water, wastewater, industrial, or engineering associations is preferred. **TECHNICAL SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE** * Broad understanding of drinking water, municipal wastewater, industrial wastewater, water reuse, desalination, and resource recovery applications. * Working depth across relevant processes such as activated sludge, nutrient removal, MBR, MBBR, MABR, anaerobic treatment, clarification, filtration, adsorption, ion exchange, oxidation, disinfection, UF, MF, NF, RO, EDR, evaporation, crystallization, ZLD/MLD, sludge treatment, and biosolids management. * Ability to develop process flow diagrams, mass and energy balances, treatment train concepts, design bases, operating philosophies, and preliminary equipment requirements. * Understanding process integration factors including pretreatment, hydraulics, water chemistry, fouling and scaling, residuals management, energy demand, operability, reliability, maintainability, and lifecycle cost. * Working knowledge of process instrumentation, analyzers, PLC, DCS, SCADA, historians, industrial data platforms, advanced process control, digital twins, predictive analytics, and operational autonomy concepts. * Experience with pilot testing, technology validation, process optimization, commissioning, troubleshooting, and performance assessment. * Ability to evaluate technology maturity, intellectual property positioning, implementation risk, supply chain dependencies, and scale\-up requirements. * Experience in one or more priority markets such as semiconductor, data centers, mining and metals, power generation, food and beverage, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, or municipal utilities is preferred. **ATTRIBUTES** * Customer\-centered and outcome\-oriented, with the discipline to understand the operating problem before recommending technology. * Strong systems thinker who can connect process design, automation, operations, services, economics, and risk. * Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to engage operators, engineers, customers, partners, and senior executives. * Able to simplify complex technical concepts without losing accuracy or credibility. * Collaborative and effective in a global, cross\-functional, and matrixed organization, including through indirect influence. * Commercially aware and comfortable supporting customer engagement, proposals, negotiations, and go\-to\-market planning. * Independent, analytical, pragmatic, and willing to work directly with technologies, project teams, and customer sites. * Committed to safety, integrity, inclusion, and responsible innovation. **TRAVEL** Ability to travel up to 50% of the time, including domestic and international business trips. jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: Zlayt AI is a litigation automation platform built exclusively for personal injury law. From demand letters and deposition summaries to discovery responses and case analysis, Zlayt equips law firms with intelligent tools that draft faster, think strategically, and deliver results without friction, setup, or compromise. We're an early\-stage, product\-led company building the category\-defining product for legal AI in a large, underserved niche. This is a rare opportunity to shape what the product becomes — working directly with the founding team, real PI lawyers, and real case data. **The Role** Zlayt AI is hiring a Product Manager to own the product from problem to shipped feature. You'll work directly with the founders and engineering to decide what we build, why, and in what order — then make sure it ships and actually works for the lawyers and legal assistants who use it every day. This is a builder's role, not a caretaker's role. There is no product org to step into. You'll be writing the first specs, running the first structured discovery, and setting up how product decisions get made. **What You'll Do** * Own the product roadmap: talk to PI lawyers and staff, find the highest\-value workflow problems, and turn them into a prioritized plan * Write clear specs and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from without guesswork * Work hands\-on with AI: define how features should behave, test outputs against real legal work product, and set the quality bar for what "good enough to ship" means * Run discovery and feedback loops with early customers, including Zinda Law Group as the first major client * Define and track the metrics that show whether a feature is working (adoption, time saved, output quality, retention) * Operate with significant ambiguity in an early\-stage environment, making decisions with incomplete information and adjusting quickly **Who You Are** * **A builder, not an inheritor:** You've shipped a 0\-to\-1 software product or major feature as the accountable PM — you know what it takes to build something from nothing, not just run an existing roadmap * **Technical enough to be dangerous:** You've worked directly with engineers day to day, can read a technical design, and don't need a translator to discuss APIs, data models, or model behavior * **AI\-native:** You've shipped or worked hands\-on with LLM or AI\-powered features, and you use AI tools yourself to do your own work faster * **Workflow\-obsessed:** You've built software for a demanding professional user — legal, healthcare, finance, or similar — where the details of the workflow decide whether the product gets used * **Startup\-tested:** You've worked in small, fast\-moving companies where you had to build process yourself, not step into one that already existed * **Self\-directed:** Your track record shows work you personally drove — not just team results you were adjacent to * **Experienced but still hands\-on:** Roughly 4–10 years of total professional experience, with at least 3 in product management * **Stable but not stagnant:** A track record of meaningful tenure at each stop, with job changes that make sense (promotions, acquisitions, layoffs, or clear career logic — not a pattern of short stints) **Our Philosophy** We firmly uphold the value of every individual within our team, ensuring they have the chance to build a rewarding career both financially and personally. Our firm's structure is designed to offer exceptional prospects for growth and advancement. At Zlayt AI, every team member leaves at the end of the day with the satisfaction of knowing they have diligently served our clients and positively impacted the lives of others. Join us and experience a remarkable work environment at our organization! Zlayt AI is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Senior Automation Engineer
jobs.description: What’s it like to work for Zoetis, the world leader in animal health? Zoetis means something a little different to every colleague, but at our core, our purpose ‘to nurture the world and humankind by advancing care for animals,’ is what unites us in all our roles. We’re a global animal health company dedicated to serving veterinarians, livestock producers and people who raise and care for farm and companion animals in more than 100 countries. And we’re excited to become a part of the Douglasville, GA, community as we build our newest manufacturing facility to support our growing monoclonal antibody and vaccine portfolios. **Position Summary:** We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Sr. Automation Engineer to support the management of all on\-site industrial controls systems BMS, PMS, EMS and PCS infrastructure and RLAN IT/OT architecture, both new and existing. The successful candidate will play a critical role in the development, implementation, and maintenance of instrumentation and control systems, ensuring compliance with Zoetis standards, GMP, and non\-GMP requirements. **Position Responsibilities:** * Gatekeep standards for new system architecture design, and support the installation of instrumentation and control systems, including building automation systems, data systems, process control, DCS, and utility PLCs in harmony with Zoetis standards. * Support maintaining Automation master plan for the entire site to manage and support Automation base. * Support managing the life cycle and change control process for all automation control systems at the site to ensure compliance and operational efficiency. * Provide support to maintenance teams for troubleshooting instruments and control systems. * Develop training programs for instrumentation and control systems to enhance the skills of the team. * Support managing vendors and consultants, ensuring that contracts contain appropriate technical specifications and are delivered according to requirements. * Stay abreast of developments in instrumentation and control technology and standards, applying relevant advancements to enhance operations. * Interface with users, peers, and management to ensure appropriate input and integration of local and corporate standards. * Provide technical expertise during regulatory audits to ensure compliance with industry standards. * Author, review, revise, or approve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) as required. * Support the entire implementation of essential automation infrastructure from conception to completion. * Provide support for Factory Acceptance Test and Site Acceptance Test for all automation. **Education and Experience:** * Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, chemical engineering, automation engineering, or a related field is required. Advanced technical degrees will be considered a plus. * 6 years managing automation systems experience in automation engineering, particularly in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology sectors is required. **Technical Skills and Competence Required:** * Demonstrated experience in the design, implementation, and maintenance of automation systems within a GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) environment. * Proficiency in PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) programming, SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) systems, DCS (Distributed Control System), and other automation technologies. * Knowledge of industry standards such as ISA\-88, ISA\-95, and GAMP (Good Automated Manufacturing Practice). * Familiarity with regulatory requirements, including FDA regulations, cGMP (current Good Manufacturing Practice), and other relevant guidelines governing the pharmaceutical industry. * Technical Experience leading and managing automation projects from concept through commissioning, ensuring adherence to project timelines and budgets. * Understanding of equipment and system validation processes, including IQ (Installation Qualification), OQ (Operational Qualification), and PQ (Performance Qualification). * Strong communication and interpersonal skills, as Senior Automation Engineers often collaborate with cross\-functional teams, vendors, and management. * Ability to troubleshoot complex automation issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions. * Basic understanding of IT/OT (Information Technology/Operational Technology) digital concepts, with the ability to integrate automation systems EMS, DCS, PCS and BMS into broader digital frameworks. * Life\-cycle management of Automation Systems. * Efficient Project Management skills. * Excellent written and oral communication skills for concise and practical presentations. * Implementation, testing, and qualification of automation for large\-scale projects. * Proficiency in English, both written and oral. * Computer proficiency with email; internet/online training; working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Word and Excel; familiarity with manufacturing software programs. * Demonstrated commitment to achievi the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Candidate position is site based in Lithia Springs GA (Atlanta). Must be able to sit, walk or stand for long periods of time. Repetitive motions and substantial movement of the wrist, hands, and fingers. Must be able to reach above shoulder level, bend/stoop, kneel, push/pull, and handle/grip frequently. Must be able to work scheduled 40 hours with the ability to work overtime as needed. General work hours are from 8:00 am to 5:00 pm in an office setting. Must be able to lift and carry up to 25 lbs. Use of necessary personal protective equipment is also required. Zoetis does not use Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, or other web\-based/generic email domains to communicate about job opportunities, interviews, or offers of employment. Disabled individuals are given an equal opportunity to use our online application system. We offer reasonable accommodations as an alternative if requested by an individual with a disability. Please contact Zoetis Colleague Services at zoetiscolleagueservices@zoetis.com to request an accommodation. Zoetis also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act. All applicants must possess or obtain authorization to work in the US for Zoetis. Zoetis retains sole and exclusive discretion to pursue sponsorship for the acquisition or maintenance of nonimmigrant status and employment eligibility, considering factors such as availability of qualified US workers. Individuals requiring sponsorship must disclose this fact. In addition, Zoetis does not use Google Hangout for any recruitment related activities. Any solicitation or request for information related to job applications with Zoetis via any other means and/or utilizing email addresses with any other domain should be disregarded. In addition, Zoetis will never ask candidates to make any type of personal financial investment related to gaining employment with Zoetis.

jobs.title: Software Engineer 3, Full-stack
jobs.description: JOB DESCRIPTION At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts. Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet. Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all. **About the team and the role:** We are the Customer Support Technology Team! We build the systems that power eBay’s global customer service experience. This team is focused on creating scalable backend services and APIs, user\-facing web applications, agent tools, and AI\-powered platform capabilities that improve both agent productivity and customer outcomes. We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Software Engineer to join the team in Austin, TX or Salt Lake City, Utah in a hands\-on individual contributor role. In this role, you will own features end\-to\-end across UI, services, data, and actions, while working on workflow systems, automation platforms, and user experiences that support customer service operations at scale with a strong emphasis on coding and design, with additional time spent on collaboration, code reviews, and operational excellence. **What you will accomplish:** * Build end\-to\-end product capabilities across frontend and backend systems, delivering user\-facing applications, backend services, and APIs that support eBay’s global customer service experience. * Improve agent productivity and customer outcomes by enhancing agent tools, workflow engines, and automation platforms used in day\-to\-day support operations. * Contribute to AI\-powered platform capabilities, including orchestration layers, automation systems, and intent\-to\-action workflows that help evolve how support experiences are delivered. * Increase the scalability, reliability, and performance of core systems by writing high\-quality, well\-tested code and driving continuous technical improvements across the stack. * Partner closely with Product, SRE, and multi\-functional engineering teams to review code, create design documentation, and strengthen engineering practices that support sustainable delivery. * Help the team grow by reducing technical debt, driving operational improvements, participating in a follow\-the\-sun on\-call rotation, and mentoring junior engineers or leading smaller workstreams. **What you will bring:** * 5\+ years strong full stack software engineering experience, including Java 11\+ and Spring Boot for backend development and JavaScript or TypeScript for modern frontend development. * Experience building REST APIs, distributed systems, and responsive web applications using frameworks such as React, Angular, or similar technologies. * Solid understanding of messaging systems such as Kafka, along with experience using SQL and NoSQL databases in production environments. * Familiarity with modern software delivery practices and tools, including CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, and strong testing approaches across unit, integration, and frontend layers. * Strong debugging, problem\-solving, and collaboration skills, with the ability to contribute to design discussions, code reviews, and multi\-functional delivery efforts. * Interest in or familiarity with AI\-assisted development and AI\-powered systems, such as LLMs, prompts, orchestration frameworks, agent workflows, or intent\-driven automation; experience with customer support systems, observability tools, secure application design, or state management is a plus. **Additional Details** The base pay range for this position is expected in the range below: $98,000 \- $173,600 Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a target bonus and restricted stock units (as applicable) in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO and parental leave). Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment. If hired, employees will be in an “at\-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors. Remote roles are not eligible for U.S. visa sponsorship. eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center and AI Hiring Guidelines. Apply Now Save Job

jobs.title: Editorial Director
jobs.description: MinIO is the data and memory foundation for enterprise AI. Built for the speed, scale, and economics that AI and analytics demand, AIStor and MemKV unify every layer of the data stack, from agentic and inference context memory to tables and objects across core, edge, and cloud. Trusted by 77% of the Fortune 100, MinIO is redefining how AI factories, intelligent applications, and autonomous agents secure, persist, and unlock the full value of their data. We are seeking an Editorial Director to own MinIO's editorial strategy and content marketing end\-to\-end. You are a communications leader equally at home architecting a rolling six\-month editorial strategy across owned, earned, and social media, drafting a CEO keynote, producing an engaging customer video, or crafting the narrative for one of AI's emerging infrastructure stories. This is a builder role: you will set direction, create the work, own the budget and the results, measure outcomes, and iterate fast. Reporting to our Vice President of Brand and Communications, you are an exceptional writer and editor who can translate deeply technical concepts into narratives that are clear, compelling, and credible to both technical and business audiences. You are also a skilled operator and collaborator who puts AI to work across the marketing craft, and who can confidently manage a comprehensive editorial calendar, a focused budget, and a measurement framework that ties every initiative back to business impact. You will accomplish this at the pace of one of the world's most dynamic AI infrastructure companies. **What You Will Do:** **Editorial Strategy \& Narrative Development** * Lead a comprehensive editorial strategy that aligns with MinIO's corporate brand and narrative, balancing long\-range planning with the agility to execute and reinvent as the market moves. * Translate deeply technical concepts and customer stories into compelling storylines that carry across MinIO's channels and advance the company vision, set content strategy for major corporate and product moments, and develop owned platforms that sharpen a distinct MinIO point of view. * As MinIO's editor\-in\-chief, create, maintain, and drive an editorial calendar that delivers consistent, high\-quality content across all channels, with clear accountability for deadlines and standards. * Partner with web, PR, and social media teams to drive editorial across owned, earned, and social media. **Content Creation \& Execution** * Craft exceptional content across formats: social posts, blog articles, video scripts, executive POVs, newsletters, and other assets that feed the demand funnel. * Serve as the company's brand copy editor with sharp attention to detail, producing work that reflects the MinIO brand voice and earns the trust of a technical enterprise audience. * Storyboard and executive\-produce engaging video and visual storytelling featured across MinIO's owned and social channels, including min.io. * Partner across brand marketing and communications, product marketing, and sales to translate cross\-functional priorities into content that is on\-message, on\-time, and balanced between brand awareness and GTM acceleration. * Proactively develop differentiated blog and content strategies for product launches and major announcements, acting as the connective tissue between what the product does and why the market should care. Manage content marketing agencies and contract resources as required. **Analytics, Budget \& Performance Measurement** * Own the KPIs and measurement system for editorial and content, selecting indicators that track real progress rather than activity. * Own the content budget, allocating resources across a lean bench of AI tools, content production, and paid distribution to maximize ROI. * Deliver regular, data\-driven reporting that communicates results and makes a clear case for resource decisions. * Leverage AI tools thoughtfully across the full content workflow (writing, editing, video production) to raise both the quality and the velocity of output. Continuously optimize based on performance data, bringing a test\-and\-learn mindset to every channel. **Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Internal Visibility** * Provide senior oversight over content MinIO produces while raising the visibility and value of powerful editorial across the organization. * Collaborate and partner closely with communications, product marketing, brand, and sales teams to ensure editorial and content programming is tightly integrated with company\-wide priorities. * Champion the editorial function. Help colleagues across departments understand how to engage with, contribute to, and amplify what the team is building. **Your Skills and Experience:** * 10\+ years in editorial and content marketing, including 6\+ years in a high\-growth B2B technology, AI, or infrastructure software environment. * A true builder: equally strong as strategist and executor, with a proven track record of scaling content programs and have the data to show it. * Exceptional writer and editor who can translate complex technical concepts into narratives that resonate across audiences, from engineers to executives to industry press and investors, and elevate the MinIO brand story in the process; strong attention to detail is non\-negotiable. * Deep hands\-on experience across LinkedIn, X, and YouTube, with fluency in content management systems, marketing automation, and AI\-assisted production tools. * Strong working knowledge of SEO and generative engine optimization (GEO) best practices. * Familiarity with AI, cloud computing, data infrastructure, or storage technologies. * Sound judgment, strong project management instincts, and a collaborative, proactive approach that raises the standard of the work around you. **What We Offer:** * Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * 401K with 3% Contribution * Pre\-IPO Stock Options * At least 12 Public Holidays * Flexible Time Off ##### **Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)** MinIO is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, App Ads Modeling
jobs.description: Reddit is a community of communities. It's built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000\+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet's largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com. **Reddit has a flexible first workforce!** We're looking for a Staff\-level Machine Learning Engineer to join Reddit's Ads Ranking Org. This role is part of a broader effort to enhance Reddit's ML\-powered ad ranking systems through improved model architectures, contextual embeddings, and conversion\-optimized modeling. The ideal candidate will bring strong end\-to\-end modeling expertise, a deep understanding of modern deep learning techniques, and a passion for building systems that drive measurable impact in ads marketplaces. While ads experience is a plus, strong modelers from recommendation systems, search relevance, or other performance\-driven domains are encouraged to apply. This position will sit on the App Ads Modeling team and report directly into the Ranking Org. **Responsibilities:** * Design and train advanced ML models (e.g., DNNs, transformers) to power Reddit Ads Ranking * Develop and optimize features including embeddings, contextual signals, and cross\-session behavior * Work closely with product, infra, and data teams to drive end\-to\-end model deployment and performance analysis * Mentor other MLEs and contribute to modeling best practices across the org * Shape the long\-term modeling vision across one or more domains (conversion, app ads, shopping, brand, etc.) **Required Qualifications:** * 7\+ years of industry experience, including several years in applied ML roles * Strong experience with Deep Learning architectures and ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch) * Strong background in recommendation systems, ads ranking, or similar domains * Experience working with large\-scale datasets and complex feature pipelines * Strong problem\-solving and experimentation skills * State of the Art models for Ads or Recsys experience (ex: Transformers, Recsys) * Knowledge about Recsys or Ads funnel * Track record of delivering high\-impact models in production settings * Comfort collaborating with infra and data teams on feature serving and training pipelines **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with conversion modeling, app ads, or performance/brand ads * Experience in ads marketplaces at peer companies * Publications, patents, or industry contributions in applied ML or ranking systems **Benefits:** * 100% remote opportunity (we have 4 office locations for hybrid/onsite work preference in NY, SF, LA and Chicago) * Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs * 401k with Employer Match * Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support * Family Planning Support * Gender\-Affirming Care * Mental Health \& Coaching Benefits * Flexible Vacation \& Paid Volunteer Time Off * Generous Paid Parental Leave \#LI\-AJ1 In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews. During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment\-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors. *Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve. Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.*
